lang.ability.narutorpg.1000_metre_punch.desc: The user focuses a large amount of chakra into their fist and punches the opponent, sending them at least one kilometre (1000 metres) away.
lang.ability.narutorpg.100_metre_punch.desc: A shorter version of the 1000 Metre Punch, the user concentrates their chakra into their fist and lands a devastating blow on the opponent, sending them flying to at least 100 metres away from where the user is.
lang.ability.narutorpg.100_single_punch.desc: Tsunade gathers large amounts of chakra in her hand and releases it as she punches the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.10_hit_combo.desc: Lars strikes the foe 5 times before striking them into the air with a lightning-infused uppercut. He would jump above with amazing speed and double kick the victim into an axe-handle, then charge up a lightning-infused blow down to the stomach.
lang.ability.narutorpg.16_hit_combo.desc: A very effective move, Ino uses this as a quick knock-out move on a opponent. She slaps and kicks with flower petals trailing from her hands and feet around her body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.absolute_fang_passing_: Kiba and Akamaru perform the Fang Passing Fang to send the opponent flying into the air, then they increase their spinning power to finish the opponent off by catching them in between their attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.absorption_sphere.desc: Using the Jutsu Absorption Arm, the user creates a sphere after a short moment, which can absorb multiple ninjutsu attacks simultaneously, leading to it growing in size. As the sphere itself is ninjutsu, another sphere can cancel it out.
lang.ability.narutorpg.accelerated_armed_revo: Tenten unseals several weapons from her scrolls, which Lee and Neji send at their opponent with a kick and a vacuum palm. Lee and Neji leap into the air, where Lee accelerates the rotation of Neji's Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven using the Front Lotus.
lang.ability.narutorpg.acid_permeation.desc: Utakata blows acidic bubbles from his pipe that burn anything it comes into contact with. The sheer multitude and wide-range it can cover makes avoiding it very difficult.
lang.ability.narutorpg.acidic_sludge.desc: The user spits out a small purple liquid at the target, which evaporates in acidic fashion, when in contact with the target. It is shown to be powerful enough to incapacitate Kushina Uzumaki, even though she was only hit with a small part of the liquid on her leg.
lang.ability.narutorpg.acrobat.desc: The Acrobat is a kenjutsu used by Killer B in tandem with his swords and the standard technique of his unique Disturbance Taijutsu fighting style.
lang.ability.narutorpg.adamantine_power_acala: Hashirama kicks the opponent away and raises some wood tendrils to strike the enemy down. With the opponent layed on the ground, Hashirama gathers a large amount of chakra into his right fist, jumps and drives it into his foe's torso. The impact causes the ground to break apart and a small forest to erupt from it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.adamantine_prison_wall: After using Transformation: Adamantine Staff, Enma clones himself to create a lattice box around a target. Because of the toughness of Enma's adamantine form, opponents cannot break through the box once it's formed. When this box is formed around allies, this effectively protects them from harm.
lang.ability.narutorpg.adamantine_seal_monkey: After placing fūinjutsu tags in an area, the users create a sealing barrier that takes the form of an ethereal monkey hand that cages the target. The seal requires a substantial amount of chakra to complete, and can quickly tire out the user, allowing the target to escape.
lang.ability.narutorpg.adamantine_sealing_cha: This is a sealing technique that is characteristic of the Uzumaki clan. Users produce chains made out of their own chakra, which typically emerge from their torso. Users control the chains as they extend outwards from their body, most commonly to wrap around targets and restrain them.
Kushina uses her chains to form a barrier while Minato teleports above the opponent and slams them down with a Rasengan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.adamantine_technique_c: Hiruzen jumps up high to reach his opponent, attacks his opponent with a transformed Enma twice, and finishes by enlarging him as landing the final blow on the opponent's head with the end of the staff.
lang.ability.narutorpg.aerobatic_strike.desc: The user sends the opponent in the air, where they fly blitzing at them before finishing with large beams from their eyes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.afterglow.desc: Sasuke dashes toward his opponent and quickly slashes them with his sword.
lang.ability.narutorpg.afterimage_clone.desc: Shisui uses the Body Flicker Technique, and moves around creating several afterimages. With his speed, he can move between his afterimages, and deliver attacks from each of them, each of them having mass behind them. If attacked, he moves out of the way, letting his opponent's attack go through one of his afterimages.
lang.ability.narutorpg.agonizing_thorn_techni: After punching and kicking the opponent a few times, Tobi performs the Skewering Headbutt, burrowing himself underground, and comes up from below his opponent, performing a kanchō on them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.air_gold_dust_protecti: Making use of his Gold Dust, the Fourth Kazekage raises it above him to create a thick barricade in order to block incoming aerial attacks, whilst using hand gestures to dictate the shape that the barrier adopts. This ability is strong enough to guard against even Gaara's Sand Hail technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.air_lightning_bullet.d: The user punches the opponent twice with their fist, then palms them upward to launch them high into the air. The user then jumps above them and punches them back down. Then, the user binds the opponent with large shuriken from above, then lands on them with a powerful stomp.
lang.ability.narutorpg.air_lightning_strike.d: The user punches the opponent twice with their fist, then palms them upward to launch them high into the air. The user then jumps above them and punches them back down.
lang.ability.narutorpg.air_raid_shot.desc: Kankurō's puppet, Karasu, soars into the air with the help of a special flight modification and releases a series of bombs upon the enemy that explodes on impact. An advanced version is that these bombs can be filled with poisonous gas to cause extra damage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.air_sand_protective_wa: This air defence technique creates a giant shield of sand that is suspended in mid-air by raising a great amount of sand from the ground. By gathering the best possible mineral-rich sand, the hardness of the shield is considered to be very high.
lang.ability.narutorpg.akuta.desc: Akuta is an Earth Release technique that's created from a Land of Earth's kinjutsu, which is seemingly inspired by a jutsu that was unearthed by Ōnoki. It was a technique designed by Ōnoki to protect the village from attackers while lowering the number of casualties.
lang.ability.narutorpg.alder.desc: Kimimaro rushes at his opponent, and using them as support, jumps over them, and grows bone spikes from his back, hitting them at once.
lang.ability.narutorpg.all_directions_shurike: After using the Multiple Shadow Clone Technique, Naruto Uzumaki and his shadow clones simultaneously throw shuriken at a target. Because of how many shuriken there are and how many directions they're thrown from, the target, regardless of how skilled they may be, cannot reasonably dodge all of them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.all_is_suffering.desc: Using the giant statue as a medium, each of the five smaller heads encircling the statue's main head simultaneously release a stream of a different elemental nature attack.
A certain-kill technique, the user hardens their own bones and protrudes them out of the skin, and then fires these weaponised structures from their back or from their palms at the intended target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.all_weapons_above_heav: This technique raises all the status boosts (Speed, Attack, Defence) for all characters in battle with Tenten.
lang.ability.narutorpg.allied_shinobi_forces_: The Allied Shinobi Forces Technique is a combination of many techniques devised by Shikaku Nara, using the unique abilities of the Allied Shinobi Forces to combat the Ten-Tails.
lang.ability.narutorpg.almighty_sakura.desc: Sakura gathers large quantities of chakra and summons her Inner Sakura, and releases a painful punch onto the enemy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.altering_terrain_techn: Using her diagram scroll, Fuen maps out an area and then is able to physically modify it to her will by drawing in additions to the terrain.
lang.ability.narutorpg.amanohabaya.desc: Kinshiki manifests several different bladed weapons and hurls them at his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.amaterasu.desc: Amaterasu is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu, and the highest level of Fire Release. Said to represent the , Amaterasu is the antipode to Tsukuyomi.
lang.ability.narutorpg.amaterasu_dual_layer.d: Sasuke and Itachi simultaneously use Amaterasu on the opponent, pushing them back, and then each summons their Susanoo, before shooting an arrow and a group of Yasaka Magatama, respectively.
lang.ability.narutorpg.amaterasu_flame_wrappi: The flames of Amaterasu are shaped to cover the ribs of Susanoo with the flames, surrounding the user with a shield of black fire. In addition to the damage it can inflict, this technique has the psychological effect of causing melee enemies to hesitate in attacking the user of this technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.amaterasu_lingering_fi: Sasuke has his Susanoo extend its hand holding a giant Amaterasu orb, and causes it to release smaller Amaterasu orbs, which explode on when it comes into contact with the opponent. The orbs remain as traps on the battlefield for a short while.
Using Susanoo, Indra sends Amaterasu to the sky, which then rains down on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.ame_no_ohabari.desc: Utlising his Susanoo, Itachi performs a horizontal slash with the Sword of Totsuka.
lang.ability.narutorpg.amenomihashira.desc: After cupping both hands, the user creates a barrier with a large spiralling sphere of chakra inside. The sphere will then split into five smaller versions. After which the user can launch the attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.amenominaka.desc: Using her Rinne Sharingan, Kaguya Ōtsutsuki replaces the world around her with one of her personal dimensions; everyone near Kaguya at the time will experience the same change of place. Unlike most space–time ninjutsu, where users move themselves to a destination, Kaguya moves the destination to herself.
lang.ability.narutorpg.amenosubaruboshinomiko: Using his chakra-made fishing rod, Urashiki launches a barrage of multiple hooks at his opponent to steal their chakra.
The user extends their arm outward at the target with an open palm. A purple energy burst in then unleashed in a variety of ways, including a powerful shockwave or a ball of great concussive force.

The user extends their arm outward at the target with an open palm. A massive purple ball of energy is then unleashed, followed by a immense demonic purple serpent. Its power is able to compete with the Parent and Child Rasengan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.amenotejikara.desc: Amenotejikara is a space–time ninjutsu used by Sasuke Uchiha through the power of his Rinnegan, which was entrusted to him by the Sage of Six Paths.
Sasuke throws some lightning infused kunai at his opponent. When they're about to connect, Sasuke switches place with one of them, and delivers a Kagutsuchi enhanced Chidori.
Sasuke attacks his opponent with sword slashes and kicks, uses Banshō Ten'in to pull them closer and stun them with Chidori Sharp Spear, before jumping up and throwing a kunai behind his opponent, which he switches with, and slashes them with an electrified slash from his sword.
lang.ability.narutorpg.amplification_summonin: This is a summoning technique that bestows a special ability upon a summoned creature once predefined condition has been met.
Hidan attacks the enemy many times with his scythe, then he flips in the air while cutting downwards onto the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.anatman.desc: Gaara sends a wave of sand towards his opponent, holding them in the air, then throwing them into the ground, and finally up in the air again.
lang.ability.narutorpg.anger_of_the_sky_and_t: Sakura summons a giant Inner Sakura to strike the ground with her fist, causing a massive shock wave to be sent on both sides.
lang.ability.narutorpg.animal_cursed_seal.des: This is a unique cursed seal applied by Orochimaru, still in its experimental stages, and therefore was incomplete and unstable.
lang.ability.narutorpg.animal_path.desc: The grants a Rinnegan user the ability of summoning various animals and creatures to aid it in battle. These creatures appear to be immortal, as they were killed and later summoned again. Worthy of note, summoning creatures through the Animal Path require no blood sacrifice or hand seals.
lang.ability.narutorpg.ankorodo_hiden_ninjuts: The user causes the dumplings near them to grow to enormous sizes. The constant growth makes it difficult for attacks to subdue the growing substance. Consumed dumplings will no longer grow.
lang.ability.narutorpg.annihilation.desc: Obito lands a series of punches and kicks to his opponent, all the while phasing between attacks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.antlion_ninja_arts_eph: The user creates four firefly-like chakra wings and fires out a powerful energy blast from them. Kagerō claims that this technique can be used only once in a lifetime since it consumes so much chakra that the user is left in a near-death state after performing it.
Kurenai attacks her opponent with a combination of an elbow blow and two kicks before releasing a breath of cherry blossom petals that burst at the opponent, bombarding them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.aqua_shoot.desc: The user gathers a small orb of water and kicks it towards the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.area_scanning_techniqu: By making direct physical contact with a solid surface, the user can channel their chakra through the area, allowing them to accurately scan it. From this a person can roughly map out entire structures and surroundings, as well as determine the presence and location of targets in the surrounding area.
lang.ability.narutorpg.arhat_fist.desc: This fighting style relies on Jirōbō's brute strength to carry out showy and violent physical attacks. By taking careful control of his weight and making complicated body movements, Jirōbō is able to use his entire body to break and crush targets.
lang.ability.narutorpg.arm_growth_technique.d: From the shoulders, the user is able to create an extra set of muscular arms of varying size. From these arms, the user can shield himself from ninjutsu, form hand seals, and even provide extra mobility to move about and scale terrains.
lang.ability.narutorpg.arm_of_shukaku.desc: Gaara engulfs himself in a sand barrier as Shukaku's arm bursts from an opening, striking the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.armageddon_countdown_c: After performing the hand seal, a special clock appears on the palm of one's choosing. This clock was developed by Konohagakure, only to be used by the five Kage and their most trusted assistants. It serves as a countdown to the Earth's destruction, after Toneri dislodged the Moon from its orbit.
lang.ability.narutorpg.armour_eater.desc: The user melts pieces of their armour, creating a black liquid that they can freely manipulate. The material itself is durable enough that it isn't easily pierced and, in its liquid form, can be used to encase the target and trap their body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.armour_of_sand.desc: This technique is the second part of Gaara's "Absolute Defence", his Shield of Sand being the first part. As the name implies, Gaara covers his body in a layer of sand, wearing it like armour. Although it defends him from attacks that bypass his Shield of Sand, maintaining it consumes a great deal of chakra.
Kidōmaru secretes Spider Sticky Gold from his pores like sweat until it fully covers his body. It solidifies instantly when it makes contact with the air, becoming a defensive armour as strong as steel. Kidōmaru can produce the armour very quickly, even against attacks that take him by surprise.
lang.ability.narutorpg.art_jutsu.desc: Deidara creates a giant bird of clay, and then rides on top of it and flies rapidly towards the opponent, and releases several smaller birds of clay, who fly to the ground and trigger a series of explosions towards the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.ascension_and_fall.des: Obito slashes the opponent with the Sword of Nunoboko twice, throws a projectile from the Truth-Seeking Balls and morphs them into two large hands which ensnare the opponent with purple lightning-like chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.assassination_techniqu: A sword technique used by Root members. Using their signature double-edged, tip-less tantō, the user attacks their opponent with a series of swift slashes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.assimilate_all_creatio: The Assimilate All Creation Technique enables the user to take on the properties of a nearby object, material, or substance, and any of its special characteristics.
lang.ability.narutorpg.assimilation_rock_bliz: After performing the Assimilate All Creation Technique to fuse with an object, Nagare controls the rocks that make up his "body" and pelts his opponent with the rocks able to regenerate immediately after any attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.assimilation_rock_tank: This technique is a copied version of the Akimichi clan's Human Bullet Tank technique, the only difference being that the user uses the Assimilate All Creation Technique to fuse with a nearby rock and collect the necessary mass to perform it, instead of creating it themselves by converting body fat into chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.assimilation_sand_bind: This technique is a copy of Gaara's Sand Binding Coffin by Nagare, with the difference being rock powder instead of sand. However, Nagare needs to use Assimilate All Creation Technique before he can use this technique. The powder encloses the opponent and then crushes them, killing them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.assimilation_sand_wate: This technique is very similar to Gaara's Sand Waterfall Funeral, with the exception of using rock powder instead of sand. After capturing a target with the Assimilation: Sand Binding Coffin, Nagare causes the coffin to constrict and crushes the opponent to death.
lang.ability.narutorpg.asura_attack.desc: With the body modifications of the Asura Path, the user can open parts of their body to reveal a cannon that fires a massive blast of chakra with explosive power strong enough to devastate an entire area.
lang.ability.narutorpg.asura_path.desc: The grants the user the ability to augment their own body to summon mechanised armour and various ballistic and mechanical weaponry. During his lifetime, Nagato channelled the Asura Path through the body of a ninja puppeteer.
lang.ability.narutorpg.attack_of_the_twin_dem: This technique allows Ukon to inhabit his brother, Sakon's, body, moving within it freely and emerging from Sakon at will.
lang.ability.narutorpg.auger.desc: In vehicle mode, Mecha-Naruto creates a massive drill that he uses to attack his opponents.
lang.ability.narutorpg.avalanche_dance.desc: Haku delivers a string of kicks, punches, and senbon slashes to his opponent, throws them up in the air while performing a back flip, and jumps higher than his opponent to throw senbon at them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.azure_stream.desc: Suigetsu creates a moving body of water beneath him that travels towards the opponent. He then slashes the opponent with the sword Kubikiribōchō multiple times.
lang.ability.narutorpg.ball_of_light_techniqu: The user gathers a ball of concentrated light which hovers above their palm to illuminate their surroundings, similar to a lantern.
lang.ability.narutorpg.ballistic_waterwheel.d: After the user swallows a great amount of water to make themselves into a human-sized ball, they tuck their limbs inside their clothes and use chakra to propel themselves into a powerful roll. The added water gives the user extra weight, causing more damage to the opponent and area.
Bando activates his chakra to surround him in a blazing yellow armour of pure chakra. Damage to Bando in this state is reduced greatly. His attacks are also amplified by the armour.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bansho_kokuin.desc: Madara creates a black sphere that attracts all matter to it and throws it forwards. As it goes, the sphere picks up debris, hitting any opponents on its path with it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bansho_ten_in.desc: Banshō Ten'in is a technique that manipulates to pull matter towards the user at will. It has the same five second limit as the Shinra Tensei as stated by Chōji Akimichi.
lang.ability.narutorpg.barrage_of_gentle_fist: The user delivers a series of quick blows of the Gentle Fist on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.barrier_canopy_method_: This technique allows the user to create a spherical detection barrier with the user at the centre. At the user's command, the detection barrier can expand, grasping everything in the surroundings. The users can also detect anything that moves inside the barrier space with their own "sense".
lang.ability.narutorpg.barrier_gate_five_seal: This technique requires a scroll on which a blueprint of a particular area will be mapped. When activated, it causes four giant gates to emerge north, east, south, and west of the targeted area. Afterwards, the gates form a barrier around the area.
lang.ability.narutorpg.barrier_method_formati: This is a type of where an area is defined using a number of special tags. When the area is entered by an opponent, a barrier is created. The barrier's properties vary depending on the tags used: the Sound Four, for example, use explosive tags, which allows it to serve as a sort of booby-trap.

Iruka applies three simultaneous sealing formulas on the floor, side by side. Each causes an explosion if the opponent is caught up in them, and explode on their own after a while if no opponent triggers them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.barrier_reclose_techni: A technique used by the shinobi from the Allied Shinobi Forces' Sealing Team. After performing the required hand seals, a barrier is erected to re-close an opening of an pre-existing barrier.
lang.ability.narutorpg.barrier_releasing_tech: The user places four tags marked "Release" in a diamond formation on a barrier. After performing the hand seals, the technique will break the barrier. It takes time and concentration to break stronger barriers. To increase the strength of this technique, more than one user can perform the technique in unison.
lang.ability.narutorpg.barrier_shattering_tec: If there is a barrier active, the user can see in enemy territory and shatter the barrier's source from within while his team lends him chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.barrier_talisman_armou: This technique was created by the hunter-nin of Kirigakure and according to Ao, they are the only ones who know how to cancel the technique. When a specific part of the user's body is targeted, this technique is automatically activated. The talismans move to cover the specific body part and form a barrier to protect it
lang.ability.narutorpg.barrier_toad_gourd_pri: This technique summons a small, gourd-shaped toad, called a , a unique species of toad indigenous to Mount Myōboku. By using the toad's tongue to drag in whatever it wraps around, this technique is best used to capture and isolate a victim dragging them into the toad's stomach.
The users rushes on the opponent with a barrage of punches covered in chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.baryon_mode.desc: Baryon Mode is a unique transformation accessible to Kurama with its jinchūriki. It uses all of Kurama's chakra present in its jinchūriki, resulting in the permanent exhaustion of the Tailed Beast's chakra in the user.
lang.ability.narutorpg.baryon_rasengan.desc: Naruto performs a Rasengan while in Baryon Mode.
lang.ability.narutorpg.baryon_rasengan_heaven: Naruto enters Baryon Mode and delivers a kick that sends the opponent flying. He follows up with a punch that sends them through several boulders until he catches up and kicks them straight into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.baryon_scarlet_flash.d: In Baryon Mode, Naruto uses his enhanced speed to blitz through all the opponents in the surrounding area.
lang.ability.narutorpg.baryon_tail_breaker.de: The user uses their chakra tails to deflect attacks or to deal damage, finishing with a boosted punch.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bashosen_coil_of_earth: Waving the Bashōsen down towards the ground, the user then unleashes a row of rising earth towards the opponent.
Using the Bashōsen, the user waves the fan and unleashes an enormous trail of intense flames which torrents towards their intended target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bashosen_coil_of_light: Waving the Bashōsen downwards, the user causes lightning to surge around them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bashosen_coil_of_water: Waving the Bashōsen, the user unleashes a torrent of water which chases after their opponent.
Swinging the Bashōsen, the user creates a powerful gust of wind which was powerful enough to destroy Kakuzu's lightning-mask.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bat_controlling.desc: Rinji has the special ability to produce ultrasonic waves and understand them. This way he can talk with bats, who use ultrasonic waves for communication. He is able to give them orders, like to search the area around him, and they seem to consider him a friend. He can use these bats to release powerful sonic waves.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bat_controlling_ultras: Once Rinji controls his bats, he commands them to produce high frequency ultrasonic waves that affect the mind of the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.battojutsu.desc: The user attacks the enemy with a sword at an incredible speed, causing a flash and a gust of wind upon impact, raising dust from the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.beast_human_clone.desc: An , this technique transforms a ninken into their Inuzuka partner. By doing this, the Inuzuka gains a copy of themselves that serves the same practical purpose as a shadow clone but without a shadow clone's steep chakra requirement.
lang.ability.narutorpg.beast_human_fury_kicks: In their transformed state, a Tenrō clan shinobi delivers a multitude of powerful kicks to the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.beast_human_needle_sen: In their transformed state, a Tenrō clan shinobi can shoot their hair like needles in all directions.
lang.ability.narutorpg.beast_sealing_techniqu: After creating the necessary seals, the seal formula rises up in the form of multiple chakra chains and binds the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.beast_tearing_gale_pal: This technique is somewhat of an enhanced version of the Beast Tearing Palm. It uses chakra to infuse with and condense a mass amount of wind-chakra to form a massive demonic-like claw extending from the user's hand to strike and grab a target, as well as deflect any weapon or attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.beast_tearing_palm.des: A powerful technique of wind nature chakra that can cut and slash through any material. Sora activates it by summoning chakra in his right hand, and then swipes a slicing chakra wave which appears to be controlled by Sora's will and thoughts. He is also able to use the technique in a rapid-fire, successive motion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bee_bomb_technique.des: This is a technique in which bees bombard the target with explosions detonated by the explosive tags attached to them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bee_honey_technique.de: The user summons a large number of bees that swarm over and sting the opponent. Every time a bee is injured or destroyed, it releases sticky honey on the opponent, which is strong enough to immobilise them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.beeswax_clone.desc: The user makes a clone made of beeswax and when injured enough it dissolves back down into wax.
A delivers a series of strikes to the opponent, sending them flying into the air. Then, he jumps and delivers a Lightning Oppression Horizontal Chop at the opponent — although without lightning — and smashes the opponent into the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.beigoma.desc: Mifune jumps up the air, delivers a few slashes, and finishes it with a powerful spinning slash that sends his opponent crashing into the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bell_barrier_technique: This is a technique in which Shion's bell projects a hologram around the individual that is currently holding the bell, intercepting any damage that may pose a threat to them. Miroku says that nothing could destroy it and with its properties, Shion would be fully protected.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bell_flowered_lightnin: Kakashi throws several Lightning Release kunai, which reveal hidden enemy traps and set up an electric field against opponents.
lang.ability.narutorpg.big_ball_rasengan.desc: The Big Ball Rasengan is a more powerful version of the Rasengan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.big_ball_rasengan_risi: After Naruto and his clones land a string of kicks and punches, Naruto summons a group of clones to fly up and ram the opponent in rapid succession, then quickly creates two clones to form the Big Ball Rasengan who jump off his back to reach the mid air opponent and strike them with it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.big_ball_rasenshuriken: The Big Ball Rasenshuriken is a larger variant of the Wind Release: Rasenshuriken.
lang.ability.narutorpg.big_ball_spiralling_se: The user forms two large Rasengan in each hand and slams them both on the opponent.

After performing the Multiple Shadow Clone Technique, Naruto creates several Big Ball Rasengan. The clones then charge towards the target in horizontal line formation and slam their Rasengan into the target, causing a massive amount of damage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.big_ball_tailed_beast_: While donning his Kurama chakra cloak, Naruto infuses an enlarged Tailed Beast Ball with his wind-natured chakra, before throwing it at a target, creating a great explosion upon contact.
lang.ability.narutorpg.big_truth_seeking_ball: The user can merge their Truth-Seeking Balls to form a ball larger in size. They can also merge a pair of two to have a larger sized set. In the games, merging all the balls into one have a multitude of uses.
lang.ability.narutorpg.biguro.desc: This technique allows the user to manipulate their tendrils and then sends them underground. They then appear underneath their target piercing them multiple times.
lang.ability.narutorpg.binding_smoke_prison.d: After dispersing his smoke clones, Kigiri uses the smoke made up from their bodies to wrap around the target and restrain them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.binding_snake_glare_sp: The user summons one or two large snakes which crawl out from one's sleeves, and coil around the enemy capturing them. This is a great technique for capturing someone alive, or for inflicting damage by constriction, and if the situation calls for it, the snakes can bite the victim with their poison fangs.
lang.ability.narutorpg.biting_cut.desc: Kabuto grabs his opponent with his navel snake, and pulls himself toward them, unhinging his jaw and biting them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_dream.desc: Itachi traps the opponent in a Tsukuyomi, causing them to see the ground beneath their feet to break open, plummeting them into a huge chasm. It is described as a bottomless pit of pain.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_holy_hammer.desc: The user brings forth an enlarged black rod to pin down the opponent from making any further movement.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_iron_fist.desc: Shinki creates a large hand out of Iron Sand that he can manipulate using electromagnetic fields. He can have the hands clamp around himself to protect against attacks, as well as can be used to attack a target from a distance.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_lightning.desc: Black Lightning is a legendary form of Lightning Release pioneered by the Third Raikage, who famously passed the secret technique down to Darui alone.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_needle_stab.desc: Pain runs to an opponent and stabs them with his black receiver, messing with their actions.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_passing_secret_f: Kankurō sends the opponent into the air where Kiba connects a kick. Kiba then uses his Passing Fang to force the opponent into Kuroari, allowing Kankurō to perform Black Secret Technique Machine One Shot.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_rain.desc: Nagato rains down Black Receivers and attacks, firing at enemies around him.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_receiver.desc: Black Receivers are black rods that function as demodulators for high-frequency chakra signals. Users are able to create and transmit their chakra into these receivers for a variety of purposes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_secret_technique: Shinki encases his target with Iron Sand, then proceeds to summon his puppet that bites down on the target, which results in a fūinjutsu formula that temporarily seals said target's movement as Shinki completely buries them in a casket of Iron Sand.
Kankurō uses his puppet Sanshōuo to release a huge burst of fire at the opponent.

This is a "dance of death" that Kankurō performs with puppets. He first uses Karasu, an attacking puppet, to strike at the target, causing targets to focus their attention on it. As they avoid its attacks, they are unwittingly navigated towards Kuroari, a capturing puppet, which seals them within its body.

This technique is simply the Black Secret Technique Machine One Shot technique adapted for two targets. Kankurō summons two Kuroari puppets to capture the enemies. He then uses Karasu to impale one of the victims, while an ally attacks the other.

The enhanced version of Black Secret Technique Machine One Shot which doesn't require Karasu. After making a distraction, Kankurō manoeuvres Kuroari behind the target, which then opens up its chest and fires out chakra strings that wrap around its intended target. It then pulls the target into its open abdominal cavity

Kankurō sends out Sasori, throwing the opponent up in the air. While in the air, Kankurō activates Sasori's flamethrowers, ever increasing their intensity. Then, Kankurō finishes it by having Sasori perform a slashing motion with the flames.
Kankurō withdraws Sanshōuo from storage and causes it to spit fire onto the opponent while being guarded by its armour.
Kankurō hides Sanshōuo under ground, and when it is positioned under the opponent, it emerges and captures the target inside of it.

Kankurō has Sanshōuo tackle the opponent from underneath the ground, immediately after which Karasu catches the opponent mid-air and carries them into Kuroari. The puppet then triggers an explosion, but not before splitting its parts to sustain itself from damage.

Kankurō uses this technique with Karasu, Kuroari and Sanshōuo. First, Sanshōuo slams the opponent in the air, then Karasu slashes them several times. After this, the near-unconscious foe is carried by Kuroari in front of Sanshōuo, who opens its mouth to reveal a cannon of sorts, which blasts the opponent in the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_spider_lily.desc: After trapping the target with the Shadow Sewing Technique, the user can then manipulate the shadow to bring them closer to themselves. This technique can be used to draw multiple enemies into the range of Inoichi's Mind Disturbance Dance Performance Technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.black_tornado.desc: The Kurosuki Family members pile up one on top of the other, five in one pillar, and then send out their gloves' retractable blades and hold out their arms. They then proceed to spin, creating a black tornado-looking attack. The speed makes the attack so powerful that the blades can easily cut through stone.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blade_concealed_in_gla: The user traps their target inside a genjutsu in which the user proceeds to use a kunai to deliver a swift slash while the opponent is fully immobilised.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blade_of_wind.desc: Baki emits chakra from his fingertips, creating an invisible sword out of wind that he attacks opponents with. Because opponents can't see it, and because of how precise Baki can be with his attacks, there is little opponents can do to defend against this technique.
Baki covers his hands with the Blade of Wind, delivers a barrage of punches to the opponent, and then finishes them off with an uppercut which creates a large gust of wind throwing the opponent into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blade_of_wind_hurrican: Baki creates a large hurricane using his Blade of Wind technique that draws enemies into the hurricane, violently slashing them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blasting_ice_crystal.d: Haku firsts traps the opponent's feet to the ground by freezing ice onto them. He then uses a specific hand seal which causes the chunks of ice at the opponent's feet to grow into one large chunk, freezing the target completely. Quickly jumping back, he throws several senbon at the frozen opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blastsword_consecutive: Wielding his sword into the ground, Jinpachi performs two slashes with the weapon, and while they are disoriented, jumps up and finishes with an explosion of the sword's explosive tags.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blastsword_earth_ruptu: Jinpachi thrusts his sword into the ground, creating a series of powerful explosions, breaking the ground under the enemy's feet, and then, while they are disoriented, he finishes with a blow of the sword.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blastsword_technique_b: Unravelling a large length of the explosive tag roll from the Shibuki, Jinpachi sends it towards his enemy in a circular motion cutting off any escape route and engulfing them in a wide-spread explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blaze_release_dragon_f: The user spews dragon shaped flames coated in black flames.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blaze_release_flame_fo: The user spews normal flames covered in black flames, which surround the user and damage anyone that is near the flames.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blaze_release_great_fi: The user launches a fireball at the opponent, with the black flames enveloping the orange-coloured fire for increased substantial damage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blaze_release_honoikaz: The user first surrounds themselves with Amaterasu before proceeding to shape them into spikes, impaling anyone within their immediate vicinity.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blaze_release_kagutsuc: Blaze Release: Kagutsuchi is a technique which applies shape transformation to the black flames of Amaterasu, allowing the user to manipulate them at will. In Sasuke Uchiha's case, while Amaterasu is cast from his left eye, he uses his right eye to manipulate the flames.
Sasuke creates a sword of black flames and swings it, unleashing a wave of controlled flames towards the opponent.
Sasuke attacks his opponent with a lightning-chakra infused sword, throwing them upwards, and causes Amaterasu spikes to erupt from the ground, hitting them in the air.
Sasuke focuses the flames of Amaterasu at his opponent, shaping them into several spikes, damaging his opponent and knocking them back.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blaze_release_susanoo_: An application of Kagutsuchi through Susanoo, whereby Sasuke produces weapons made from the orb of black flames held in his Susanoo's secondary right hand.

Jūgo applies his senjutsu chakra to Sasuke's Susanoo. Sasuke extends his Susanoo's sword to several times the size of the Susanoo itself, and converts it to black flames, delivering a long-reaching, downwards slash.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blaze_release_yasaka_m: Utilising the orb of black flames in his Susanoo's third hand, the user is able to rapidly produce a number of magatama projectiles, which are composed entirely of the flames. Upon impact, victims are forcefully thrown off of their feet and quickly incinerated.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blazing_lightning_kuna: The user throws fire and lightning infused kunai at their opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blazing_shuriken_dance: A cooperation technique used by Sasuke and Sakura. Sakura throws a series of shuriken that have been inflamed by Sasuke's Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blinding_bubbles_techn: Utakata blows bubbles, surrounding the opponent's face with them. Once popped, the bubbles create a puff of red powder that momentarily blinds the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blinding_wide_sand_for: The user spreads sand particles throughout the area, creating a that disrupts the enemies' ability to sense targets. However, the technique appears only able to work on targets focused on.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blocking_technique_abs: A highly advanced sealing technique granted by the Preta Path, that conjures a see-through barrier around the user's body that is capable of absorbing any chakra, regardless of any shape or nature transformation, and dispersing it within one's body by spinning the chakra within one's body in the opposite direction.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blood_dragon_ascension: Blood Dragon Ascension is a technique that involves the ability of manipulating blood, exclusive of the members of the Chinoike Clan. Through this ability, the user forms a dragon of blood with eight heads similar to the "Yamata no Orochi", which all have the ability to regenerate.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blood_dragon_bullet.de: A lesser version of the Blood Dragon Ascension, Chino uses the blood around her to create a single Blood Dragon which she sends towards the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blood_needle.desc: The user manifests needles made of their own blood from either hand. Upon production, they can be launched as a massive barrage. The force behind these needles are strong, able to plough through the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.blood_transformation_t: Using the Ketsuryūgan's ability to manipulate a target's iron-rich blood, the user can expand the blood in the target's body. Doing so, it will cause the body to morph into a much larger version, effectively disguising the target to be unrecognizable from their true form.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bloody_mist_absorption: The user swipes their blood across Samehada, creating a contract. The blade unleashes a thick red mist on the battlefield, gradually and continually absorbing chakra from all opponents' open wounds.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bloody_mist_sword_art_: The Bloody Mist Sword Art: Bone Mutilation is a technique unique to Kirigakure.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bluntsword_spin_strike: Jinin first spins the ax part of his sword, attacking the enemy, and then spins the hammer part, finishing him off.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bo_shadow_clone_techni: The user throws a Bō staff at the enemy and increases their number for an effective attack. The technique does not require the use of additional weapons, since the shadow clones are not illusory, but have a real threat of injury.
lang.ability.narutorpg.body_alteration.desc: Gozu can change parts of his body in a manner that is reminiscent of the Akimichi clan's Partial Multi-Size Technique to increase the strength and range of his attacks. Using this ability on his legs also gives him much greater linear speed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.body_controlling_techn: This is a technique that can be used to control someone's body through direct eye contact. When used, the caster's iris and pupil shrinks and the veins in the sclera become more prominent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.body_elimination_techn: Knowing full well that a shinobi's corpse is a treasure trove of information, this technique is used by Anbu to completely destroy the bodies of those caught or on the verge of death. This technique leaves no trace of the user's body behind whatsoever.
lang.ability.narutorpg.body_flicker_technique: The Body Flicker Technique is a high-speed movement technique.

Shisui creates several afterimages, each of which attacks the opponent with a chakra-enhanced tantō, and finally Shisui himself, moving with lightning speed, finishes the attack by slicing through them with a fiery blade.
lang.ability.narutorpg.body_fluid_shedding_te: A technique that allows Kabuto to liquefy his body and the snakes he controls at will, which he created after examining and altering the Hōzuki clan's Hydrification Technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.body_oxidation_techniq: While in smoke form, an Iburi can enter a target through their nostrils and mouth. Once inside, every part of their body can be attacked from the inside by the smoke, causing great pain, and even death.
lang.ability.narutorpg.body_pathway_derangeme: This is a high-level form of medical ninjutsu that only Tsunade has been shown to have mastered. Tsunade creates an electric field by giving her chakra the properties of electricity. When she strikes a target with her hand, the electricity pours into their nervous system and rearranges their body's signals.
lang.ability.narutorpg.body_recreation_techni: Kabuto uses specially-developed snakes to execute the process of recreation and multiplication of another being's cells to create a living clone of them—a process which requires the DNA of the intended target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.body_revival_technique: The is a high-level medical ninjutsu, and Shinnō's signature technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.boil_release_flower_re: The user manipulates their chakra, creating corrosive vapour that can be released from the ground at various spots. The user can then cause explosions from that vapour in each of these spots.
lang.ability.narutorpg.boil_release_skilled_m: The user creates a cloud of mist which they release from their mouth. This mist is highly acidic in nature, capable of melting bodies, and even chakra-based defences and barriers, nullifying them. Even Sasuke Uchiha's Susanoo was affected, despite being considered an "absolute defence".
lang.ability.narutorpg.boil_release_steam_exp: The user releases a massive cloud of boiling steam surrounding them, burning whatever or whoever is nearby.
lang.ability.narutorpg.boil_release_unrivalle: Boil Release: Unrivalled Strength is a ninjutsu fighting style used by Kokuō and its jinchūriki.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bojutsu_three_section_: Tenten summons a long staff. This staff can split into three parts separated by metal chains and can be used offensively or defensively.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bolting_blossom.desc: Sasuke slashes the opponent following that, he and Sakura deliver punches to the opponent in the air and then kick the opponent down to the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bomb_setting_huge_succ: Tobi goes underground, and strikes his opponent from below, sending them flying. He then reaches the spot they'll land and sets a bomb, which goes off as his opponent lands.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bone_pellet.desc: Kimimaro fires three to five sharp bone spikes at the opponent. He shoots three at close range and five at mid-range.
lang.ability.narutorpg.booby_trap.desc: Booby Trap * In anime and manga, Kiba Inuzuka creates a trap in the form of a living creature, which is stuffed with kunai. After the victim approaches the trap, it explodes, firing at the unfortunate.
lang.ability.narutorpg.boruto_rush.desc: Boruto creates four shadow clones to attack his opponent, delivering a series of open palm strikes and kicks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.boruto_stream.desc: By utilising Wind Release, the user can accelerate their movements, creating an effect similar to tunnel vision. To reach higher speeds, the user gains aid from others to perform the technique on them by propelling them from their feet. This technique can also be used on an ally to increase their speed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.boruto_stream_rasengan: User uses Boruto Stream with shadow clones, but instead of hitting with a fist, they strengthen the attack with the Rasengan, breaking through the enemy's defence and suppressing them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.boruto_strike.desc: Boruto creates four shadow clones, one of which launches itself at the opponent, kicking them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bouncy_bouncy_techniqu: The Bouncy Bouncy Technique is a variation of the Sexy Technique. Using the skills Naruto had taught them, Konohamaru, Moegi, and Udon transform into three beautiful women: Konohamaru will transform into the night on the town ; Moegi into the beach going ; Udon into the nurse .
lang.ability.narutorpg.brace_yourself.desc: Kushina hits her opponent with a frying pan a few times. Then she jumps and crashes into the opponent, striking them with a devastating punch.
lang.ability.narutorpg.branding_punishment.de: Hidan swings his scythe at the opponent, pulling them closer, then spinning around and throws them with his scythe. He finishes with a forceful kick that sends the opponent into the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.brilliant_fluttering_w: Transformed as Chōmei, Fū swipes at her opponent with her non-wing tail, followed by a horn attack, and finishing with a sweep of her entire abdomen.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bringer_of_darkness_te: The user places a hallucinatory darkness on a target's eyesight, causing them to see nothing but black; Tō no Sho likens the sensation to being at the bottom of a deep hole. Because the target cannot see, they are very vulnerable to attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.broadaxe.desc: Using his Sage Transformation, Jūgo forms an axe on his arm, which has proven to be durable enough to block giant swords and chakra blades without damage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bubble_clone_technique: With the Bubble Clone Technique, Utakata creates a clone of himself by using his Soap Bubble Ninjutsu with his bubble pipe. When hit, the clone pops like a bubble.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bubblegum_ninjutsu.des: Using chakra as a catalyst, the user manipulates their bubblegum to achieve a variety of effects. This technique can be used as spheres to hover upon, trap an opponent inside, or create various explosions. The impact from even the tiniest sphere is capable of knocking an opponent unconscious.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bug_bite.desc: While in her transformed state, Fū attacks the enemy with a powerful glancing blow as a kick, seemingly biting them in the process.
lang.ability.narutorpg.bunmawashi.desc: The user swings their manriki-gusari and attacks the opponent with great speed and force. Its attack power is enough to knock a hole in the ground or break a thick tree in half.
lang.ability.narutorpg.burial_arm_attack.desc: Kawaki shrinks himself and instantly appears at full size in front of the opponent, slamming his modified arm down and bringing out thorns from his flesh from the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.burning_legs.desc: Pakura strengthens her feet with the power of Scorch Release, delivering fatal blows to her opponents using taijutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.burning_passion.desc: Sitting on Ponta, Sabu leaps into the air and slashes at his opponent with his axe. Ponta then rams his opponent with his stomach and begins tearing at his body with his claws, delivering a final blow with such force that afterimages of his claws are visible in the air.
After concentrating chakra into their right hand, the user propels the opponent over a long distance. When the move is performed, Guy's hand seems to have an orange glow, which is possibly due to chakra concentration.
lang.ability.narutorpg.butterfly_bullet_bombi: When an Akimichi enters Butterfly Mode, fat in their body is converted into densely concentrated chakra. As the chakra leaks from their backbone, it becomes visible through friction with the shoulder blade, taking the appearance of butterfly wings.
lang.ability.narutorpg.butterfly_mode.desc: The Butterfly Mode is a heightened transformation of the Akimichi clan.
Ino creates an illusion in which countless butterflies surround the opponent. The opponent sinks into the ground, giving her the chance to place an explosive tag on their face before cutting off the illusion, revealing that all the butterflies were exploding tags that all detonate alongside the original.
lang.ability.narutorpg.by_brute_force.desc: Kisame swipes horizontally at his opponent with Samehada, shavering at them with it as they fall back down by pulling Samehada towards himself, and finishes them off by punching them straight to the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.byakugan.desc: The is a kekkei genkai dōjutsu that originated from the Ōtsutsuki clan, making it the oldest kekkei genkai. After the Ōtsutsuki settled on Earth, the Byakugan became more commonly associated with the Hyūga clan, direct descendants of the Ōtsutsuki.
lang.ability.narutorpg.c0.desc: The highest form of Deidara's explosive clay and his , C0 is a suicide-bomb technique used as a last resort. Deidara reveals a mouth on his chest, which is stitched up. After undoing the stitches, Deidara feeds it a large ball of clay.
lang.ability.narutorpg.c1.desc: The most basic and versatile form of explosive clay.
lang.ability.narutorpg.c2.desc: One of Deidara's specialities that requires the use of both of his palm mouths, creating a large dragon. The dragon itself is capable of flight, and, while Deidara is safely on its back, the dragon can spit out smaller clay figures that attack the opponent like guided missiles.
lang.ability.narutorpg.c3.desc: Deidara's most powerful large scale bomb, that once activated becomes an enormous statue that Deidara drops on his target from above. Its explosive power was great enough to potentially destroy an entire village.
lang.ability.narutorpg.c4.desc: A truly fearsome technique created by Deidara to counter the Sharingan and the genjutsu it produces.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cactus_genjutsu.desc: Using a nearby cactus' pollen, the user places anyone who comes in contact with it under a strong genjutsu that is hardly noticeable due to the technique's inconspicuous execution. In this genjutsu, the victim has the impression to cross an area over and over again while in reality, it does not move at all.
lang.ability.narutorpg.caged_heat_arson_priso: Momoshiki directs pieces of rubble at a target. By tensing his fingers, Momoshiki can heat the rubble remotely, causing it to cling to targets when it contacts them and inflict severe burns. By clenching his fist, he can make the rubble detonate, creating enough force to break through Susanoo.
lang.ability.narutorpg.calamity_flame.desc: As the opponent is running towards Itachi, he focuses the flames of Amaterasu on the opponent causing them to burn and fall to the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.calling_on_tears_techn: The user creates a wave of sound by crying that can incapacitate anyone who hears it. The frequency of the sound waves can be used to trigger explosive tags.
lang.ability.narutorpg.calorie_control.desc: Calorie Control is a hiden utilised by the Akimichi clan and forms the basis of all their clan techniques.
lang.ability.narutorpg.car_mode.desc: This is the mode in which Mecha-Naruto takes the form of a vehicle. While in this mode, its head could produce multiple blades which can then easily slice through large trees. It could also launch these blades as a shuriken.
lang.ability.narutorpg.carbon_armour.desc: This jutsu allows Deepa to completely encase himself in a two toned full body armour made of his hardened carbon abilities, as a last resort. It allows him to harden his fists from carbon into diamond. Deepa stated that the technique isn't perfect and had a few flaws but didn't elaborate.
lang.ability.narutorpg.carbon_control.desc: This jutsu, allows the user to freely manipulate carbon. For external sources, the user is able to remotely control the said carbon, shaping it into a myriad of shapes, and levitate it freely.
lang.ability.narutorpg.carbon_ring.desc: The user creates a ring of carbon cubes that rotates very quickly around their body, protecting them from various attacks. In addition, they are capable of attacking with a ring, throwing it at the enemy at high speed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.carbon_whip.desc: The user creates carbon whips on their hands that extend a considerable distance, allowing them to attack with sweeping blows. Thanks to the sharp ends, the whip can pierce the enemy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.carpet_bombing.desc: Deidara throws clay spiders at the opponent while he is lifted by a small clay bird.
lang.ability.narutorpg.casualty_puppet.desc: Developed by Orochimaru, this technique allows the user to partially absorb a freshly-killed corpse, transforming it into an extension of the user's body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cat_chakra_claw.desc: This form of chakra flow is unique to the ninneko. It can enhance the striking power of the cat's claws to the point where it can easily cut through metal.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cat_claw.desc: While in her transformed state, Yugito slashes the opponent with a powerful and quick swipe, using the extended nails on her hands.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cat_claw_foot.desc: Yugito zig-zags around the fighting area and then kicks the opponent into the air then slams them to the ground with a clawed kick.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cat_covering.desc: The Cat Covering is a Hiden technique from the Izuno Clan, allowing the user to fight with cat-like reflexes and abilities while enveloped in chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cat_fire_bowl.desc: Yugito elbows her opponent and begins spinning, turning into Matatabi. Clawing forward, she sends out several fireballs, which converge on her opponent, resulting in an explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cat_flame_roaring_fire: While transformed as Matatabi, Yugito forms a large fireball from her mouth and shoots it at the target. It's powerful enough to turn a large building into rubble and melt concrete with one shot.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cat_food_clone.desc: The ninneko creates a decoy of itself made out of cat food, which dissolves when struck. It apparently must be built beforehand, which the user switches places with when they wish to use it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cat_genjutsu.desc: The user uses a genjutsu where the whole place changes inside the target's mind. A new scenery and offensive ninneko are created illusory to fight the victim inside their head.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cat_god_possession_mon: Passed down in the Izuno Clan, the user uses a scroll to bring forth the chakra shroud of a giant cat. This technique displays prodigious strength, capable of smashing a massive stone boulder with a single blow.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cat_surprise.desc: While enhanced by her Cat Covering, Wasabi slashes at the ground, kicking up a dust cloud which acts as a smokescreen to set up other attacks by her team-mates.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cell_activation_techni: This technique was engineered by Tsunade after observing Kabuto Yakushi's Yin Healing Wound Destruction technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cellular_regeneration_: While in a transformed state, Jūgo extends a needle-like protuberance from the palm of his hand, places it into a target while proceeding to quickly absorb their flesh and blood, converting them into his own cells and restoring his stamina and body.

As the originator of Orochimaru's Juinjutsu and the possessor of a unique clan ability, Jūgo is able to give his flesh to those that are compatible with said cursed seals, thus healing any injuries they may have received.
lang.ability.narutorpg.certain_kill_ice_spear: A technique in which several large ice spikes emerge from below to impale anything in their vicinity. The rate at which this occurs is so sudden that it's considered to be a certain kill. When used inside an enclosed area like a cottage, it leaves very little room for escape.
lang.ability.narutorpg.certain_kill_treasured: The user launches their jōhyō at the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cha_barrage.desc: Sakura attacks the opponent four times, and then with the help of Inner Sakura, she delivers twenty fast and powerful punches. She then kicks the opponent twice, sending them flying away.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chain.desc: The user can cause their arm to stretch, covering distances much greater than their own body, allowing them to do many things like retrieve their fallen allies or throw their opponents around.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chain_pull.desc: Obito lands a couple physical attacks, slams his opponent with his chains twice, then teleports behind and above them to deliver a downwards spinning kick.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chain_rope.desc: Obito lands a couple physical attacks, warps behind his opponent to deliver an upwards kunai slash, throws them up in the air with his chains, and once again warps behind them to deliver an upwards spinning kick.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chained_heaven.desc: Obito phases through his opponent, binding them in chains and throwing them up in the air. He then teleports above his opponent and punches them back down.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chained_prison_explosi: After Hanzō restrains his opponent with his kusarigama, he traps them in a sphere of exploding tags before adding fire to it, then it explodes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chains_twin_fangs_slas: Using their Kunai Blades, connected by chains, Izumo and Kotetsu slash the opponent, who is immediately bound by the chains, causing them to become immobilised.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_absorbing_snake: The user restrains the target with special black snakes that steadily absorb their chakra. The grip of the snakes will increase if the target tries to use their chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_blade_straight_: First the user holds the bladed weapon horizontally. Then after infusing chakra into the blade and further expanding its length.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_blade_wind_swor: The user slashes the opponent with numerous waves from their chakra blades.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_burning.desc: Naruto creates four shadow clones that circle the area and detonate, making a large explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_control_bind.de: The user places a seal on a person. When the target gets near a sealing tag, the target will be secured by red chakra threads, binding them in place. The technique can last for hours on its own. It can also be released by a Seal of Confrontation.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_disguise.desc: The user must first prepare the technique, causing a complex anachronism that the user creates in one's chakra changing their perspective to others.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_draining_seal.d: A fūinjutsu designed to drain chakra. By placing the seal on the target, the chakra drained is transferred to the user. It was used to absorb the remaining remnants of Orochimaru's chakra that was inside Anko Mitarashi's cursed seal.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_edible_creation: By using their Rinnegan, the user can absorb a target’s chakra and transform it into chakra pills that can be eaten to grant themselves immense power, extended youth, as well as access to their target’s abilities.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_enhanced_streng: A special type of taijutsu that uses the refined chakra control and concentration required in medical ninjutsu to enhance one's strength to monstrous levels. This is done by storing chakra into one's hands or feet, and releasing it onto the target with pinpoint timing.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_enhancing_music: Playing on his ocarina, Menma can somehow affect his target's tenketsu, boosting their chakra flow.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_entity.desc: A technique passed down in his family, Gekomatsu creates chakra copies of shinobi living or deceased, such as Jiraiya and Orochimaru. Only those who possess the special chakra beads can see the created chakra entities.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_ghost_technique: With his dōjutsu, Ranmaru is able to cast a genjutsu involving the creation of silhouettes or illusory beings as a means of distraction. The entities are so realistic that they even have their own chakra pathway system, which can fool even the "all-seeing" Byakugan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_hair_trap_techn: After cutting her hair, Ino infuses the strands with her chakra to trap anyone that comes into contact with them. Once immobilised, they are an easy target for her to cast her Mind Body Switch Technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_levitation_tech: This technique allows the user to levitate using their chakra, it also allows the user to manipulate objects out of their reach, in a similar way to telekinesis.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_liquid.desc: By pressing his middle fingers into his palm with his other fingers stretched out, Jako can reveal special spray cannons built into his wrists. These cannons can "liquidise" his chakra and then shape it into weapons such as whips or swords.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_lock_on.desc: This technique allows the user to scan an area in search of particular targets, quickly discriminating between known and unknown chakra signatures.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_needle.desc: Hinoko shoots a chakra needle from her fingertips, that will always hit the target. She can alter the properties of the needle to have different effects on the target once they're hit, such as by revitalising, paralysing, or killing them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_scalpel.desc: This medical technique forms one's chakra into a small, sharp blade. This can then be used for highly accurate incisions necessary for surgeries and anatomical dissections.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_scalpel_cruelty: Kabuto attacks his opponent with his chakra scalpel from behind two times and then attack once in front of them. He then briefly kicks his opponent backwards after immobilising them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_scalpel_destruc: Kabuto moves towards his opponent with tremendous speed. After disabling them the chakra scalpel on the chest, he grabs his opponent by their shoulders, disabling them with the chakra scapel. With them momentarily disorientated by this, Kabuto quickly gets behind his opponent and delivers a series of diagonal strikes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_scalpel_sever.d: Kabuto creates two larger than usual chakra scalpels, and delivers a spinning vertical attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_scalpel_snake_c: Kabuto burrows underground and uses his chakra scalpels on the opponent's legs, making them immobile. Orochimaru then summons a large snake that crushes the opponent from above.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_shock_slash.des: The user swings their blade, releasing a blade-like chakra that has the power to easily cut through hard earth rock.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_shockwave_slash: The user rapidly slashes the opponent with a sword, creating a strong force of chakra, which sends powerful shockwaves at all directions, that are capable of cutting through multiple opponents in quick succession.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_slicers.desc: This technique can create up to five fast jets of purple-blue chakra running through the ground in all directions, making it very difficult to evade. The jets are difficult to avoid but they do not cause fatal damage to their targets. They can, however, seal the chakra of anyone they hit for a time.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_suppression_tec: This technique allows the user to suppress their or their allies' chakra to the point that it becomes completely undetectable. This makes it impossible for sensor type shinobi to track them via chakra. As noted by Shikamaru Nara, this technique is very useful in allowing one to infiltrate an enemy's ranks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_sword_great_int: Shizune uses Tonton to hit the opponent, giving her enough time to use her two chakra swords to slash and kill the opponent. The slashes leave two big marks on the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_threads_fuma.de: This is a murder-suicide technique. The user creates threads of chakra that are used to connect the user's heart to another person's. As long as the two are connected, any internal damage done to one will also be done to the other. This ultimately means that, if one person dies, so will the other.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chakra_transfer_techni: This technique allows the user to transfer their chakra to a target. The amount of chakra transferred depends solely on the user.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chaos_fan_dance.desc: Temari kicks the opponent in the gut which launches them into the air. She then throws her Giant Folding Fan to slice the opponent, after which she disappears. She then reappears behind the opponent, grabs her fan and jabs the opponent in the gut, slamming them into the ground with the fan at the same time.
lang.ability.narutorpg.character_bind_techniq: The was a technique developed by Shiranami. By pointing his finger out at a target and writing the proper kanji in the air, this technique produces a variety of effects.
lang.ability.narutorpg.charge_konohamaru_army: Konohamaru, Moegi, and Udon each hold out a ball with an explosive tag attached to it. They then proceed to charge at the opponent, and trip, in turn dropping the balls which roll over to the opponent and detonate.
lang.ability.narutorpg.charge_konohamaru_plat: Konohamaru begins by landing a Rasengan on the opponent, with Mitsuki stretching his arm to pull them back. Boruto creates three shadow clones, and the four kick the opponent up, allowing Sarada to pummel them back to the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.charging_bullet.desc: Naruto creates a shadow clone that throws him towards the opponent, with the original creating more shadow clones that shoot upwards at them.
Sakura slams her fist into her opponent with tremendous force.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cherry_blossom_clone_t: Kurenai creates a clone made of cherry blossom petals. These clones are primarily utilised to assist in Kurenai's taijutsu and genjutsu techniques rather than taking damage meant for her.
Although it may appear to be a simple case of superhuman strength, this is actually an application of the precise chakra control that is used in medical ninjutsu. The user gathers a dense concentration of chakra in their fist that they release on contact with a target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cherry_blossom_profusi: Sakura jumps into the air and uses all her chakra to manifest a gigantic fist. As she then propels herself back to the ground, Sakura uses all her might to smash her fist into the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cherry_blossom_tearing: Sakura delivers a chakra-enhanced punch to the ground, unleashing a wave of chakra that tears through the ground as the impact travels across the field.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cherry_blossom_violent: Sakura strikes the ground with the Cherry Blossom Impact, creating a massive shockwave, before she jumps into the air. She then uses the Heavenly Foot of Pain to deliver the final blow, resulting into a humongous crater and deformation of the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cherry_blossom_wild_da: The user rushes at the opponent with Chidori's speed, delivering chakra-enhanced punches from several angles, the last of which is replaced by the actual Chidori.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chibaku_tensei.desc: Chibaku Tensei is a technique used through the Deva Path of the Rinnegan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chibaku_tensei_heavenl: Sasuke manifests his humanoid Susanoo and fires arrows at his opponent, stunning them. Sasuke goes on to manifest his Complete Body Susanoo, and creates nine Chibaku Tensei satellites, which he sets on fire and makes crash down on his target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chibaku_tensei_kirin_t: Sasuke traps the opponent in Chibaku Tensei covered in the flames of Ameterasu and forms two Kirin to destroy the sphere.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori.desc: The Chidori is a high concentration of lightning chakra channelled around the user's hand.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_chakra_blade.d: Sasuke elbows his opponents, followed by sword strikes and knee attacks, before slashing them up the air and swiping down at them with Chidori Sharp Spear.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_cry_of_the_thu: Sasuke slashes the opponent upward with his sword and rushes through with Chidori when they land.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_current.desc: Chidori Current is a ninjutsu that was developed by Sasuke Uchiha while he was training with Orochimaru.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_current_black_: Using his Six Paths Chakra, Sasuke uses his black coloured Chidori to channel it into the ground and erupt eight streams of flowing electricity.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_fall.desc: Sasuke expels a Chidori into the air. He moves extremely fast in a zig-zag pattern, such that he leaves after-images. He attacks the opponent with only one strike. This technique, combined with Sasuke's speed, makes it extremely difficult, if not impossible to avoid.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_katana_crescen: Wielding his lightning-infused sword and using Body Flicker Technique, Midnight Blade swiftly delivers a powerful slash to his opponent with his electrified sword, leaving a trail of lightning behind that can strike a single target or multiple targets at once, as it hits all those nearby.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_light_sword.de: Sasuke uses his chokuto sword to channel an extremely powerful Chidori. It appears to have an even greater range than Chidori Current, making it more effective in battle.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_lightning_stri: Sasuke jumps up in the air and attacks with a series of sword slashes before slamming his opponent down with a Chidori.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_senbon.desc: A variation of the Chidori that uses shape transformation to create countless sharp senbon that are fired at the enemy in quick succession. By increasing the amount of chakra used, the number of senbon increase proportionally.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_sharp_spear.de: The original Chidori gained its power by shaping it into a form sufficient for an electrical discharge and using it together with the user's own "thrust".
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_sharp_spear_he: Sasuke lands a series of sword attacks on his opponent, finishing with an upwards strike that sends his opponent up in the air. While they're up, Sasuke sends a few Chidori Senbon, and finishes with Chidori Sharp Spear, splitting the spear into multiple ones after it pierces.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_sharp_spear_li: Sasuke thrusts at his opponent with a Chidori Sharp Spear in a downward angle, collecting lightning chakra at their feet, paralysing them, then swings it upward, slashing them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_star_crusher.d: The user traps their opponent inside a Chibaku Tensei, using the gravitational core and the surrounding rubble. The meteor then begins falling from the sky, catching itself on fire in the process.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_thunder.desc: A variant of Chidori, it is a lightning storm Chidori that devastates the area.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_thunderclap.de: Sasuke performs a Chidori while his body is in mid-air and then releases all the lightning chakra to create a lightning bolt to strike his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chidori_true_spear.des: Sasuke starts off by dashing at his opponent with a Chidori in his hand. As he strikes his opponent, he uses Shape Transformation to extend the Chidori into a lightning spear that impales and hurtles the opponent into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chimera_technique.desc: The Chimera Technique is a kinjutsu that was developed by Hiruko, a missing-nin of Konohagakure, in order to compensate for his lack of natural special abilities.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chopping_punishment.de: Hidan jumps into the air and brings his scythe downwards onto the opponent. Then, he spins around and kicks them in the gut. He ends it with three spinning slashes from his scythe.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chubby_go_round.desc: After performing Super Multi-Size Technique, a giant Chōji begins to spin with his arms out, punching the enemy repeatedly.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chubby_megaton.desc: After performing Super Multi-Size Technique, a giant Chōji punches the ground twice before punching the ground on both his sides.
lang.ability.narutorpg.chunk_slash.desc: Suigetsu punches his opponent in the gut, causing them to fall to the ground. He then steps on top of them and delivers a single strike with his Kubikiribōchō.
lang.ability.narutorpg.circle_wild_dance.desc: Fū spins with his tantō, hitting the opponent several times.
lang.ability.narutorpg.claw_creation_techniqu: This technique allows the user to temporarily enhance the normal growth of the nails on both their hands and feet, causing them to grow considerably longer in a short space of time as a result. It also seemingly enhances the durability of the nails, allowing them to even clash against swords without breaking.
lang.ability.narutorpg.claw_of_shukaku.desc: After fully possessing Gaara, Shukaku slashes the ground with its claws, releasing an upward sand stream.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clawing_swift_wolf_fan: Kiba and Akamaru rapidly bolt around and slash the opponent before leaping forward from opposite sides for a crossing pass slash and bite.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clay_clone.desc: A highly convenient technique, characteristic of Deidara. Above most other "clone techniques", this clone has the double role. It acts as a substitute and a trap for capturing the enemy. Made from clay, this clone can take attacks and capture the enemy by taking them into its own body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clethra.desc: Kimimaro slices downward with his bone sword, which is extended to twice the length of his normal bone sword, at the opponent's mid-section.
lang.ability.narutorpg.climbing_sparrow.desc: Sai, whilst in close range with release from his scroll two medium sized ink birds, first lifts the opponent off the ground, being lifted further by the second.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cloak_of_invisibility_: The user covers themselves with a cloak that has a colour and pattern matching the nearby surroundings, concealing their presence by seamlessly blending in. The user can then gather intel from their position or wait for an opportunity to stage an ambush on unsuspecting targets.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_body_blow.desc: Naruto and four shadow clones work together to deliver a physical attack from a distance. There is no set pattern, steps, or method to how this is done, instead relying on Naruto's characteristic unpredictability to be devised in the moment.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_combo.desc: Sakura summons Inner Sakura and both deliver a series of strikes. Sakura starts with a kick, Inner Sakura punches from behind, the real Sakura punches the opponent in the air where Inner Sakura then hits the opponent aside.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_flicker.desc: Shisui sends out two shadow clones that rush to the opponent, with the real Shisui following with a slash.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_flying_arrow.des: Naruto creates two clones who grab each other, while Naruto grabs them both. Naruto starts spinning around to gather sufficient speed, then releases the clones at the target in a shuriken-like fashion to strike them.
The user creates a shadow clone, intending for their opponents to attack the clone at close range. After a certain amount of time has passed, the clone detonates, creating a large explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_ladder.desc: After landing a string of hits with his shadow clones, sending his opponent into the air, Naruto finishes with an upwards kick after using two clones as stepping stones to reach his opponent in the air.
