lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_lasso.desc: After creating two clones, and using a short combo, Naruto has his clones hold each other's legs as he pulls and guides them to mimic a lasso, hitting the opponent with a spinning attack, upwards attack and downwards attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_snakes.desc: After implanting Orochimaru's DNA, Kabuto used some of his cells to develop a large amount of tiny snakes that multiply at a rapid rate and can merge into either a clone of another living being using a genetic sample or a larger serpent for combat. They also have incredible regenerative abilities.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_snakes_serpent_t: Kabuto slams his hand on the surface of water containing his specially-developed snakes and emits dark-red lightning, which causes the snakes to take on the form of a giant blue snake with a red mouth and no eyes. The snake then rams and pushes the enemy underwater in an attempt to drown them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_spinning_heel_dr: After creating several shadow clones, Naruto and his clones launch themselves into the air and begin to somersault. They then come spinning down, slamming their heels onto the target's shoulders and head.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_technique.desc: This is a basic technique that every shinobi can use. In fact, Konohagakure's Ninja Academy prevents students from graduating unless they master this technique, and it was for this reason that Naruto Uzumaki failed three exams in a row. For this technique, users create one or more of themselves.
lang.ability.narutorpg.clone_trap.desc: The Clone Trap is a technique that uses an earth clone to restrict an opponent's movements.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cloth_binding_techniqu: The user uses a giant roll of cloth to tightly wrap up the intended opponent, completely immobilising them, thus preventing them from moving or using any techniques.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cloud_style_crescent_m: The user swings their sword in a single, large, crescent moon-shaped arc, which occurs with such ferocious velocity that the technique can be employed in situations where only a very limited time to react is available. The swing can be used to counter attacks from multiple opponents simultaneously.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cloud_style_deception_: Using the Body Replacement Technique to feign being attacked, the user takes advantage of their opponent's momentary shock, and charges forward with a lateral sword slash.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cloud_style_flame_behe: The user first imbues their blade with fire, before slashing in the direction of the desired enemy, resulting in the creation of large arcs of intense flame that follow the trajectory of the previous swing.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cloud_style_flying_swo: Samui jumps back with a swing of her tantō, releasing a large ball of electricity that hits the opponent, then attacks with a lightning-infused tantō, and then finishes off with a horizontal attack, slamming the opponent hard into the ground with her tantō.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cloud_style_front_behe: The user swings their sword in a single quick and powerful cutting motion to attack an enemy in front of them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cloud_style_reverse_be: The user does a powerful spin, generating the momentum needed to slash at any opponents behind them. The user can also utilise this spinning motion to trick an enemy that's in front of them. The enemy is fooled into thinking the user will attack them, but instead the user attacks the targets behind the user.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cloud_style_rising_dra: Samui charges at the enemy, attacking them with a chakra-enhanced tantō, then throws them into the air and spins like a top, cutting through their flesh, before finishing them off with a horizontal attack, driving the enemy hard into the ground with her tantō.
lang.ability.narutorpg.club_technique.desc: Tenten unseals her club from her scroll and attacks the opponent, swinging it from right to left, then thrusts it at the opponent's gut twice, and finishes with a side swipe.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cocoon.desc: With the help of Chōmei, the user creates a cocoon that allows them to suppress chakra absorption from outside sources, providing additional defences at the same time. The cocoon is highly durable and can only be pierced with a chakra blade, and only when hit in its weak-spot, which can be found via the Byakugan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.coercion_sharingan.des: With a single glance of the Sharingan, this technique forces a nightmarish genjutsu on the victim, overpowering them and bringing them to their knees. Even the usually emotionless Sai was deeply affected by this genjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.coiling_around.desc: Giant snakes can coil around their prey and strangle it, no matter how big it is.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cold_attack_of_the_dem: Zabuza creates a water dragon, which Haku freezes and launches it at the opponent, trapping them in an ice pillar. Haku jumps between the surrounding ice pieces, attacking the imprisoned opponent. Zabuza finishes it with an upwards slash along the ice pillar, splitting it in half and causing it to crumble.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cold_needles.desc: Shizune attacks her opponent a few times, then she spins around and hits them with a chakra scalpel. She finishes them off with several senbon.
lang.ability.narutorpg.collaboration_ultimate: Deidara creates his C2 clay dragon, which Sasori coats in Iron Sand with the Third Kazekage puppet, also giving it a spiked tail, which it uses to slam on the opponent. It is then detonated by Deidara, resulting in a huge explosion with iron sand.
lang.ability.narutorpg.colour_course_change.d: This technique is used by Fūka to switch her consciousness between the several bodies she has access to. She needs to do this because of her Execution by Kiss technique: since a single body couldn't handle so much chakra, she had to use several to distribute all the chakra she had sucked during her life.
lang.ability.narutorpg.combination_art.desc: Sasori, with the Third Kazekage puppet uses Iron Sand World Method while Deidara adds his clay spiders on the needles that explode on the opponent, leaving the opponent poisoned.
lang.ability.narutorpg.combination_secret_tec: The user and a teammate or more can team up and perform a special attack together on the opponent. Moves executed vary depending on the game.
lang.ability.narutorpg.combination_transforma: This is an advanced version of the Transformation Technique, where two or more users combine into one form in order to gain that form's physical abilities.
lang.ability.narutorpg.combined_killing_art.d: Using his clay, Deidara creates several explosive spiders and throws them in the air as Sasori uses the Third Kazekage puppet to make shards of Iron Sand blades that carry the spiders to the opponent. The opponent is forced into the ground where the spiders detonate.
lang.ability.narutorpg.combo_attack_shinra_te: Nagato begins with a palm attack, followed by two slices with chakra disruption blades, a volley of shuriken, more spinning strikes with chakra disruption blades, and ends it with a Shinra Tensei.
lang.ability.narutorpg.combo_small_birds.desc: Sai uses his Super Beast Imitating Drawing to release a barrage of small birds at his opponent.
Sakura punches her opponent with the Chakra Enhanced Strength, sending them flying in the air for a long distance, then she appears behind them and stops their flight with a powerful kick to the face.
lang.ability.narutorpg.coming_of_the_lightnin: A cooperation ninjutsu used by a Lightning Release and Fire Release user. The Lightning Release user traps the opponent with an electrical current, shocking the opponent. The Fire Release user then burns the opponent, causing an explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.complete_body_susanoo_: In his complete Susanoo, Shisui leaps into the air and drills down on the opponent with its sword.
lang.ability.narutorpg.compression_rasengan.d: The Compression Rasengan was created by Boruto Uzumaki in his quest to defeat Deepa.
lang.ability.narutorpg.concealed_sand_picture: The Concealed Sand Picture Cat is a sensory technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.concealment.desc: The user burrows underground to strike the opponent at their feet. Kabuto Yakushi utilises Chakra Scalpels in an attempt to cut his target's tendons.
lang.ability.narutorpg.conch_cannon.desc: After Kandachi performs the necessary hand seals, the Conch King fires a number of needle-like projectiles from its body pores.
lang.ability.narutorpg.conch_whip.desc: After Kandachi performs the necessary hand seals, the Conch King uses one or more of its chakra tongues to whip or restrain the opponent. The user can also pump their chakra into the Conch King increasing the tongue's length and speed. It is shown that repeated hits with the tongue can eventually kill the victim.
lang.ability.narutorpg.concussive_chakra_cann: Bando grabs the opponent and slams them into the ground so hard they bounce into the air. Then he attaches his cannon to his left arm, and charges a powerful chakra blast, firing it at the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.confinement_barrier.de: A type of barrier ninjutsu utilised by the Konoha Barrier Team. After using themselves as the perimeter for the barrier, a barrier is erected and then takes on a dome shape capable of even trapping the Nue.
lang.ability.narutorpg.confusing_claw_instant: Yugito rushes towards her opponent, hitting them with a series of clawed stabs and kicks, hits them a few more times while zig-zagging, and finishes it with a two-handed stabbing attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.continuous_tailed_beas: The tailed beast or transformed jinchūriki fires multiple uncompressed Tailed Beast Balls in rapid succession at the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.contract_seal.desc: When the user implements this fūinjutsu on a summoner, it removes any direct control the summoner has over a summoned creature. Close contact appears to be required for the implementation of the seal. Minato Namikaze used this technique to wrest a Sharingan-controlled Kurama from Tobi's control.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cooperation_tailed_bea: A Tailed Beast or jinchūriki joins together with another Tailed Beast or jinchūriki to form a massive combined Tailed Beast Ball. The more that are involved in forming the ball, the larger the size.
lang.ability.narutorpg.copy_ninjutsu.desc: Guy performs Dynamic Entry with Kakashi using his Sharingan to copy it. Kakashi applies lightning chakra to his Dynamic Entry, causing the technique to engulf the opponent in flames.
lang.ability.narutorpg.coral_palm.desc: While in his transformed state, Yagura strikes the opponent with a powerful blow, causing a large formation of coral to quickly grow from the initial point of contact. This then rapidly solidifies and restricts the enemy's mobility, as the substance continues to grow, eventually covering their entire body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.coral_ripples_rising.d: Yagura slams the end of his staff down on the ground, generating a long row of coral spikes to rise out of the ground, and once they reach the opponent several feet away, several large coral spikes impales them from below.
lang.ability.narutorpg.coral_rising_attack.de: Yagura places his hand on the ground and summons coral from underneath the opponent, which launches them up into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.corpse_clone_technique: The Corpse Clone Technique is a kinjutsu that allows the user to assume the identity of their victims. By opening their mouth wide, akin to a snake, the user will consume the target's living brain. After which, the user gains the victim's memories, abilities, and can take on their physical likeness perfectly.
lang.ability.narutorpg.covert_cut.desc: Kakashi pulls and pushes his opponent around, positioning himself behind them before stabbing them with a kunai.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crane_wing_formation.d: After jumping into the air, the ninken attack the enemy from a circular formation reminiscent of a crane's wings. After surrounding the opponent(s), the hounds then bite the target's limbs rendering them unable to react as they plummet to the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crane_wing_formation_e: The Crane Wing Formation is a collaboration technique used by seven members of the Suicide Corps after activating the sixth gate.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crazy_butterfly_kick.d: Converting calories into chakra, Chōji knees and elbows his opponent, lands a spinning kick, and throws them up in the air with a few punches, where Chōji jumps and delivers a downwards kick, similar to Dynamic Entry.
Converting calories into chakra, Chōji jumps up in the air, punches his opponent, delivers a couple of spinning kicks, and finishes with a powerful punch, sending his opponent crashing down.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crazy_hair_technique.d: In Sage Mode, Jiraiya lands a kick and a punch on his opponent before hitting them four times with his extended hair.
lang.ability.narutorpg.creation_of_all_things: The Creation of All Things Technique was a technique possessed by Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki that allowed him to turn fantasy into reality. The process he used first employed the administration of imagination and the spiritual energy that underlies the Yin chakra to create physical forms from nothingness.
lang.ability.narutorpg.creation_rebirth.desc: The Creation Rebirth was invented by Tsunade with the resolution to protect the lives of her comrades. By releasing a large amount of chakra at once, the body's cell division is forcibly stimulated.
lang.ability.narutorpg.creative_destruction.d: While riding a giant clay bird, Deidara releases an ocean of spiders that approach the opponent. Much to the opponent's surprise, Deidara has also released enough birds that form a dome.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crescent_moon_rasengan: The Crescent Moon Rasengan is a more powerful version of the Rasengan used by Naruto in Naruto the Movie: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crimson_earth.desc: Using the large mechanical drill on his right arm. Toki fires it in the direction he desires with such force that it can literally change the geography of the affected area. He used this technique to create a fork in the river which he used as a choke point where he can attack his targets.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crimson_flash_collidin: While in Baryon Mode, the user punches the opponent with their immense strength to send them a large distance away.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crimson_impact.desc: Naruto slams down on the opponent from above, with a surge of red chakra rising upwards after the attack lands.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crimson_iron_cannon_bl: Mangetsu summons four swords of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist, after which Kabutowari delivers a powerful blow, Nuibari impales the target and binds them with wire strings, and Kiba is paralyes them with a stream of lightning.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crimson_leaf_dream.des: Kurenai attacks her opponent with a triple combo attack dealing an elbow strike and two kicks before fading into a mist in front of the opponent and then appearing again behind them in a pink mist and striking them with a kunai in the back which then sends the opponent into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crimson_lotus_lightnin: Kakashi electrifies a fire tornado created by Obito, which is sent toward their opponents.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crimson_mist_barrier_t: By summoning a thick wall of mist, the user can impair sight for all within it. It also masks any sound from being heard outside of the mist.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cross_lariat.desc: A and Killer B cross their arms and ram the opponent with Lightning Release: Lariats.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crow_clone_technique.d: This is a clone technique utilised by Itachi Uchiha.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cruelty.desc: Obito teleports himself above his opponent and crashes down onto them, stabbing them with a kunai.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crushing_collision.des: The Ten-Tails slams three of its tails on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crushing_rage_rasengan: While in Sage Mode, Naruto creates two shadow clones, one that tackles the opponent to the ground, and the other to help him form the Rasengan. After forming the Rasengan, Naruto jumps at the opponent with it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crushing_snake_constri: Orochimaru puts the opponent into a genjutsu which has snakes appear beneath the opponent to constrict them and with Orochimaru's command, they crush the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cry_of_the_raijin.desc: The user brings forth a wave of thunder bolts on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_armour.desc: This technique allows Guren to cover her skin with a thin sheet of pink crystal that improves her defence against physical attacks. This armour can also aid her to perform stronger physical attacks. The crystal is transparent and can only be noticed by light reflecting off it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_barrier_techni: Malice creates a crystal barrier. Anything within the confines of the barrier is kept in suspended animation and constant chakra is necessary to keep the victim in the crystal barrier. If the user is somehow weakened and the targets who were sealed still have enough chakra, they can manage to escape.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_giant_hexagona: Guren creates a giant jade-green crystal shuriken, resembling a snowflake, and throws it at the enemy. Despite its sharpness, it wasn't able to penetrate the Three-Tails' shell.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_hexagonal_shur: Guren creates pink crystal shuriken in the shape of snowflakes to launch at the target. The user can make them spin to increase their lethal power, and can burst into multiple shards with enough force to easily pierce through trees.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_release_crimso: Guren creates a dome of pink crystal to surround a target. It is highly durable from both external and internal attacks, and can be used to either protect or trap a target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_release_crysta: Guren sends out a wave of chakra, which then turns into an almost impenetrable red crystal wall, given the fact that it repairs itself when damaged. Only Shino's enhanced insects were capable of weakening the wall enough for Kakashi to finally destroy it with his Lightning Cutter.
A technique similar to Guren's Crystal Release: Crystal Pentagonal Prison, where she instead sends a wave of pink crystal particles through the air to encase her target(s) in crystal.
This technique allows Guren to create a large and sharp blue spear-like crystal surrounding her forearm, which she can use to impale her target.
Guren creates long, sharp pink crystals that shoot at the target at extremely high speeds with pinpoint accuracy. She can also create smaller versions of pink crystals to trap her target.

Guren completely encases her opponents in pink crystal using the surface beneath them. When shattered, the bodies of the victims disintegrate along with the crystal particles. It is shown through examination with Shino's kikaichū that those affected by the technique are covered in a frostbite-like pattern.
Guren creates a ring-shaped pink crystal wheel and has it rotate vertically around herself, allowing her to move at high speed, even above water.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_release_growin: Guren creates pink thorn-like crystals that she can manipulate to continuously grow towards her target's direction.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_release_jade_c: Guren materialises a blue crystal blade on her forearm to engage in combat. It has proven to be durable enough to block shuriken and kunai. If need be, she can create a crystal blade on each forearm.

By creating five large pink crystalline pillars around the user, this technique can be used to enhance the potency of other techniques. It was used to greatly amplify Yūkimaru's ability to the point that he could summon the Three-Tails, although with assistance from Kabuto's medication.
After planting red crystal seeds, Guren can cause them to bloom at will. These flower-like constructs will rapidly grow and into a massive barrier in order to trap whatever is within its perimeter.

Guren outstretches her arms in a position where her hands are open, and materialises a pink chakra-like energy, before converting it into a large jade-green mirror. The mirror takes the shape of a snowflake, and Guren can use it to perform the Jade Crystal Clone Technique.

This technique, which seems to be Crystal Release: Crystal Pentagonal Prison on a smaller scale or a minor version of it, allows Guren to completely encase a single target in a compact mass of pink crystals. If the crystals are shattered, the victim disintegrates along with the crystal particles.

This technique allows Guren to encase a large area in red crystals, thus crystallising everything within it. This technique was first used in Guren's battle with the Three-Tailed Beast, but to no avail, as it broke out shortly after.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_release_shurik: Guren surrounds herself in pink crystal particles, condensing them into numerous shuriken that continuously revolve around her as she launches them at high speeds.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_release_string: After using the Pressure Points of Harm and Death technique, Guren encases herself in a prism of transparent blue crystal. The prism can hover in the air, but seems to be immobile.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_release_tearin: The user crystallises a material in the area, and then turns it into a pink Chinese-like dragon with several pink horns and jade-green eye irides. It can be used as a means to travel or to attack a target. Several dragons can also be made and manipulated at once.
lang.ability.narutorpg.crystal_release_the_go: Guren places her hand on a surface, creating a long stream of sharp blue crystals to bind and pierce a target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.culminated_feelings_wi: Naruto and Sasuke jump high into the sky, manifesting their Kurama cloak and Complete Body — Susanoo, respectively. Sakura completely releases her Strength of a Hundred Seal, and jumps even higher into the sky, gathering a massive amount of chakra in her fist.
lang.ability.narutorpg.curse_mandala.desc: After performing various hand seals, the user is able to perform an ancient ninja art that is only known to a few generations of the Fūma clan. The technique traps the victim in a pyramid-like chakra cage which will slowly constrict as the user moves his hands closer together.
lang.ability.narutorpg.curse_technique_body_c: A jujutsu technique which requires both the user and their opponent be standing within a Jashin symbol, as well as obtaining the victim's blood and using it on their puppet. Afterwards, the puppet and victim become connected, allowing any damage done to the puppet to be shared with the connected individual.
lang.ability.narutorpg.curse_technique_death_: The Curse Technique: Death Controlling Possessed Blood is the exclusive jujutsu technique of Hidan and his primary method of killing his opponents under Jashinism.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cursed_doll.desc: The user instills their chakra into a doll which absorbs chakra of a nearby individual and takes human form.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cursed_sand_puppet_tec: With the help of pre-existing sand, the user creates a great number of sentient sand puppets and sends them to fight the opponent. The puppets, however, aren't that sturdy and can be easily taken out with one blow.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cursed_seal_killing_sh: Jūgo slams down on the opponent from above and uses a stronger Piston Fist which creates a huge black shockwave.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cursed_seal_of_earth.d: The Cursed Seal of Earth is one of the strongest of Orochimaru's cursed seals, the other being its counterpart: the Cursed Seal of Heaven.
The Cursed Seal of Heaven is one of the strongest of Orochimaru's cursed seals, the other being its counterpart, the Cursed Seal of Earth.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cursed_strength.desc: In his cursed seal level two form, Sasuke dives into the opponent, launching them into the air where Sasuke strikes them with a Chidori that creates a growing cloud of lightning.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cursed_tongue_eradicat: This cursed seal is given to all members of the Anbu subgroup Root by Danzō Shimura, to ensure no information about him or the organisation fell into the wrong hands. After Danzō died, the seals disappeared from all the Root members.
lang.ability.narutorpg.cypress.desc: Kimimaro repeatedly attacks the opponent with alternating attacks with a longer than usual bone sword coming out of each hand.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daihakoten.desc: The user can summon large black cubes which are capable of interfering with the abilities of Sensor Type individuals. The cubes themselves are very heavy, usually being dropped from above to crush anything below.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daikokuten.desc: Daikokuten is a technique of the Kokugan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daikokuten_collapse.de: Kawaki piles the opponent with, at the most four cubes on top of them, with the intent of crushing them unaware.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daikokuten_disaster.de: Isshiki uses Daikokuten to bring forth fire, water, and lightning and manipulates them into a swirling vortex in front of the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daikokuten_divine_desc: The user brings out large stone columns to pin down the opponent from above.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daikokuten_falling_sta: Isshiki brings out large cubes, showering them down in the surrounding area.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daikokuten_karma_flame: Isshiki uses Daikokuten to bring forth contained flames for a surprise attack when facing an opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daikokuten_shokatsu.de: Kawaki fires a shrunken rod at the opponent, impales them by enlarging the rod, which immobilizes them long enough for him to drop a large cube on top of them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daikokuten_sukunahikon: Isshiki brings out two of his cubes and enlarges them, using their increased size to crush the opponent between them. Naruto was only able to break free from the crushing force of the cubes through the use of Baryon Mode.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daikokuten_triple.desc: Kawaki brings out three cubes, sending all of them towards the opponent.
With his Shikotsumyaku, Kimimaro pulls from his body a bone, such as an upper arm bone, that he's modified to use as a sword. With it he repeatedly stabs at his target, doing so rapidly enough to create the appearance of afterimages.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_clematis_: The user concentrates all their Shikotsumyaku powers into the creation of a single bone weapon, which is made as hard as possible with a considerable amount of chakra.
When Kimimaro enters the second level of his cursed seal, his spine grows longer to give him a tail-like appendage. For this technique, Kimimaro removes that spine to use as a weapon.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_crescent_: The user and two of their shadow clones attack a target from different directions with a bladed weapon. As they move towards their target, the attackers usually leap through the air in a formation reminiscent of the crescent moon, hence the name.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_false_cle: Kimimaro pulls out two bone swords, and then dives onto the opponent, slashing twice. He then unleashes a flurry of stabs, knocking the opponent back. He finishes by dashing behind the opponent, unleashing bone spikes all over his body and impaling the opponent.
Sasuke, whilst in the Level 2 cursed seal, attacks his opponent with a series of slashes with his katana before flying into the air above them and releasing a fireball down upon them to finish them off.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_genji.des: Kimimaro slashes the opponent with his bone blades, shoots numerous finger bullets at them, and finishes the opponent by jumping in the air and releasing numerous bones from his back which can go in any direction, with the piercing bones then piling on the downed victim before they break apart and Kimimaro lands back o
Sasuke attacks to the opponent with horizontal cuts of his sword. After a few seconds when he sheathes his sword, the cut expands as a wind gust.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_larch.des: When Kimimaro is about to be attacked with taijutsu, he sprouts sharp bones from all or parts of his body, ideally causing the attacker to skewer themselves. The stronger and faster the attack, the greater the damage that will be done to the attacker.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_rising_dr: Tenten jumps and then spins at high speed, throwing multiple weapons at her opponent in the process.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_seedling_: While underground, Kimimaro produces as many as ten thousand blades of bone that sprout from the earth. Because of how quickly the bones appear from the ground, how wide an area they cover, and how high into the air they extend, this technique can do extensive amounts of damage, killing indiscriminately.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_shikigami: By converting her chakra into paper, Konan transforms her body (and clothing) into numerous sheets of paper; the initial creation and dispersal of the paper can mesmerise opponents.
Using her paper wings, Konan launches a vortex of explosive tags at her opponent that detonates upon contact.
After using Dance of the Shikigami, Konan traps her opponent in a vortex of paper while she creates a spear of paper and launches it.
Konan throws paper roses around the enemy(s) which burst into petals and create a giant tornado, consuming them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_sickle_bl: Putting some distance between himself and his opponent, Hanzō swings his kusarigama high up in the air, and brings it down on his opponent.
Hanzō delivers a series of side slashes with his kusarigama, then uses it to bring his opponent close to him, and spins it upwards, slashing his opponent and throwing them up in the air.
Hanzō spins his kusarigama and delivers a series of slashes to his opponent, and finishes it by jumping forward, landing a powerful slash that knocks his opponent far back.
Hanzō jumps up in the air and lands several hits with his spinning kusarigama, finally throwing his opponent back down.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_sword.des: Orochimaru slashes the opponent numerously with the Sword of Kusanagi.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_of_the_willow.de: Kimimaro produces long, hardened bones from his body that can easily puncture opponents, dealing serious damage. There is no set way in which the bones are used for this "dance": Tō no Sho likens his movements to the branches of a willow, swaying in the wind.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dance_performance_seco: The user spins around at high speeds, appearing like a small twister. While doing so, the user will launch a large barrage of kunai to several targets at once.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dancing_blade_risk.des: The user performs a quick dash towards his opponent, slashing them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dark_cloud.desc: Boro is able to unleash a dark mist that eats away at the bodies of those exposed to it either through physical contact or by inhaling, sapping their strength and gradually rendering them paralysed.
The user produces powerful black and blue flames. The flames can be unleashed in large and rapid barrages, able to incinerate their surroundings.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dark_medicine.desc: A technique that makes use of chakra snakes to perform surgery in order to kill a target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dark_release_inhaling_: Hiruko uses this technique through his Chimera Technique in order to forcibly extract the physical and spiritual energy of another ninja, even from a considerable distance. He can either absorb the chakra into the upper square of the mark on his left hand or his mouth.
Hiruko converts the chakra absorbed from the Dark Release: Inhaling Maw technique into light blue flames, turning it back on his enemies with amplified strength to blow them away. The flames are expelled through the lower square of the mark on Hiruko's left hand.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dark_sealing_method.de: In order to help an individual advance their cursed seal to its second level, the Sound Four use the Four Black Fogs Formation.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dark_smoke_sphere.desc: By using his wrist launcher, Kihō bombards the enemy with a barrage of small smoke grenades, exploding and creating a thick cloud of smoke.
lang.ability.narutorpg.darkness_wave.desc: Shinnō unleashes a black, widespread wave of dark chakra at the opponent with a wave of a hand or a thought. The force is strong enough to dispel several shadow clones.
lang.ability.narutorpg.daytime_tiger.desc: The Daytime Tiger is an incredibly fast punch and, contrary to its appearance, purely taijutsu in nature.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dead_demon_consuming_s: The Dead Demon Consuming Seal is a sealing technique developed by the Uzumaki clan to call upon the power of the Shinigami. Considered the ultimate sealing technique, its very existence is so secret that even Orochimaru knew nothing about it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dead_soul_technique.de: The user performs surgery on a corpse to temporarily make its heart beat again. The user then uses their chakra to both control the body's movements and to hide all signs of the surgery, creating the appearance that the body is a live person.
lang.ability.narutorpg.death_technique_heart_: Kabuto forms two chakra scalpels, one blue, the other purple, then rapidly slashes the opponent and then using the power of Orochimaru's remains, Kabuto enlarges his purple chakra scalpel and slices the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.death_technique_return: Kabuto first summons three corpses in his image from his scroll. The first corpse goes underground, appears behind and kicks the opponent towards the other corpses, who also attack the opponent with their chakra scalpels.
Zaku Abumi uses chakra to generate energy within his elbows, which he emits from a hole in his palm using a tube implanted in his forearm.
lang.ability.narutorpg.decapitating_reciproca: Zaku first thrusts his hands into the ground, softening it under the opponent's feet, causing them to fall and get their feet stuck, and then jumps up and finishes off the stuck opponent with Decapitating Airwaves.
lang.ability.narutorpg.deep_crimson_spiral.de: Unsealing a Rasengan from his Rinnegan, Momoshiki amplifies the chakra giving it a red colour and to increase its size to a giant scale, which rivals Boruto Uzumaki's own amplified Rasengan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.deer_butterfly_seal_bi: Chōji charges forward while Shikamaru immobilises the opponent with his shadow. Chōji jumps up and stomps on their opponent with an enlarged leg.
lang.ability.narutorpg.delicate_illness_extra: When a person has been afflicted by a pathogen or toxin, this medical ninjutsu can be used to draw out the agent and heal the damage. The cause of the illness is first determined by perceiving disturbances in the patient's chakra. Then, using a chakra scalpel, an incision is made near the affected part.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_flute_floating: Tayuya plays her flute and releases three sound-contained spheres that gravitate towards them and burst upon contact.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_flute_illusion: Tayuya plays her Demonic Flute in order to control the three Doki. The tune she plays determines their overall behaviour, as well as how each individual Doki moves, attacks, and works with each other.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_flute_phantom_: This genjutsu is performed with a flute. Because it is transmitted via sound, it is effective against long ranges, working even on those whose location the user does not know. Whoever hears the flute is subjected to an illusion of their limbs being bound, preventing them from being able to move.
Using her Demonic Flute, Tayuya summons the materialised spirits she stores in her Doki, without summoning the Doki themselves. The spirits chase the opponent, stunning them if they hit.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_flute_three_su: While in her second stage cursed seal, Tayuya traps her opponent in a genjutsu with her flute, and while they're immobilised, her Doki attack her opponent from below.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_cajol: Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour is a speech-induced genjutsu of Gengo's creation. It allows the user to put their opponent under an illusion using only words and speech.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_danci: Kurenai gathers a gust of cherry blossoms around and sends three bundles of the blossoms as projectiles towards the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_desce: This technique causes the illusion of a tremendous ball of fire falling from the sky into a designated area. The targets involved in the illusion literally feel the ball's hot temperature getting closer.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_doubl: This technique places an illusion within another illusion created by the user. When the target dispels the first illusion, they will not realise that a second is in place.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_false: This technique layers an illusion over a location, causing it to look like a different location. Because of how wide an area the illusion can be placed over, that in turn makes it easy to trick others: any who enter the area will be affected by the illusion and see the false location.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_flowe: Kurenai traps the opponent in a flower bud, and detonates it in a flowery explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_flyin: Kurenai casts the opponent under her genjutsu, making the opponent confused. Asuma then strikes them with his Flying Swallow, knocking the opponent out.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_hell_: This technique subjects targets to visions of their greatest fear, regardless of whether or not they're aware that they're afraid of it. This "fear" can be something that the target is actually scared of or merely the one image that they least want to see, and makes them feel real.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_illus: Kurenai activates a genjutsu which appears as if time has slowed down, allowing her to attack the opponent however she wants until the technique wears off.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_linge: Kurenai creates an illusionary clone that charges towards the opponent, jumps and then explodes in a cloud of cherry blossom petals.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_mirag: This genjutsu traps a victim in a powerful illusion, with no necessary eye contact; similar to Ephemeral, however, direct eye contact can still be applied when using this technique. When used, the genjutsu projects a torrent of crows, leaving the opponent at the user's mercy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_mirro: When a genjutsu is used on them, the user quickly decrypts the genjutsu with their Sharingan to understand how it works. They then perform an identical genjutsu on their attacker, causing a . Since most genjutsu are used to confuse victims, this reversed genjutsu deals predominantly mental damage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_nail_: The user, while in Tsukuyomi Mode, summons large white spikes to impale any opponent within the barrier from above.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_shack: Firstly, this technique requires the use of the Genjutsu: Sharingan. The opponent is caught in the illusionary world created by the user, and the victim is tormented with the sensation of having spikes driven through them, taking away their body's freedom.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_steam: A , whereby Gengetsu, in tandem with his Giant Clam, is able to manifest realistic mirages by manipulating the light reflecting off the steam that it produces.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_toad_: This is a sound-based genjutsu sung by toads, their most powerful genjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_trans: Kurenai brings out numerous flower petals, which are actually explosive tags after undoing her genjutsu, igniting them when the opponent is up close.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_tree_: The target experiences the illusion of a tree coiling around them, preventing them from moving. Because targets are immobile yet still conscious, this technique is a useful way to perform interrogations.
After using Demonic Illusion: Tree Binding Death, the tree that trapped the opponent explodes.
After using Demonic Illusion: Tree Binding Death to trap the opponent with an illusionary tree, the target is pierced by multiple kunai.
A two-fold attack whereby Kurenai first ensnares the opponent in a genjutsu, binding them with trees and then Asuma, using his Chakra Blades finishes them with his Flying Swallow.
Kurenai places the opponent in a genjutsu where they are trapped in a tower as Kurenai places explosive tags all over it, causing it to crumble upon their detonation.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_illusion_tripl: Itachi places the opponent in a genjutsu where Itachi and a clone slash them numerous times.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_mirror_clone_t: Using Ice Release, Haku leaves behind a clone of himself, which disperses into an ice mirror, with a reflection of his likeness inside. If an opponent touches it, they get frozen over.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_mirroring_ice_: This technique is performed with the "cursed" kekkei genkai of the Yuki clan. Haku creates several large mirrors out of ice, which he surrounds a target with. By entering one of these mirrors, Haku's reflection will appear in all of them.

After the victim is trapped in Haku's ice mirrors, he attacks the victim at high speed like he does with the Demonic Mirroring Ice Crystals technique. During this, the dome starts to float in the air. After that, a clash of blue light explodes inside the dome, damaging the victim greatly.
Haku creates a single ice wall that he can use to push back his opponent or defend against attacks for a short time.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_mirroring_thin: Haku vanishes and reappears in any location desired, then creates a single ice mirror. Haku will then leap into the mirror from the rear and come out from the front, slashing the opponent with a senbon.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_rush.desc: Naruto harnesses a large amount of chakra and delivers a series of powerful claw slashes to the opponent. He then punches them into the air where he bats them back to the ground.
Through the Outer Path, the user is able to manifest chakra chains, which bind anyone they touch. According to Obito, this binding power is far greater than that of Nagato's Outer Path. The chains possess a cursed seal that suppresses the power of tailed beasts, and also cause a great deal of pain to their victims.
lang.ability.narutorpg.demonic_statue_of_the_: The Naraka Path grabs the opponent by the throat, and summons the King of Hell, who pulls the opponent into its mouth, bites them, and spits them back out.
Obito grabs the opponent and teleports them into Kamui's dimension. The Demonic Statue of the Outer Path then crushes the opponent with its palm.
lang.ability.narutorpg.desert_attack_destruct: Gaara, whilst using the floating sand, manipulates his sand to create a large powerful pillar of sand to erupt from the ground beneath the opponent with intense ferocity, sending the opponent flying into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.desert_attack_heavenly: Gaara, whilst on the floating sand, manipulates his sand to create a large arm of Shukaku that flies towards the opponent and smashes into them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.desert_hand.desc: The caster uses their sand to create gigantic hands or claws, which can be used for multiple purposes including crushing, capturing or restraining enemies and other targets. The brilliance of this technique is in the strength and sheer size of the constructs which rivals that of a tailed beast.
lang.ability.narutorpg.desert_layered_imperia: Using a large quantity of sand, the user covers the enemy with several successive layers of the material, before compressing it into the form of a huge pyramid which serves to imprison the target upon its completion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.desert_suspension.desc: Gaara uses sand to create a platform capable of supporting his weight, which he keeps suspended in the air with his chakra. One of the simpler purposes for this technique is as a defence, lifting Gaara out of reach of attacks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.desert_wave.desc: The user shapes their sand into a wall to protect against attacks or to block an enemy's path. While initially appearing more curved, Gaara's usage eventually was shaped to appear more structured like a stonewall.
lang.ability.narutorpg.destroying_chaotic_sna: Anko jumps back while swinging her arms towards the enemy, summoning numerous snakes that form two tornado-like rotating columns that crush the enemy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.destroying_smell_smoke: Kigiri can produce an extremely thick smokescreen which immediately makes the opponent cough and blinds them, it also covers up the scent of the user and his allies. He may then attack at free will. The caster and those who have been specially trained for it can see clearly through the smokescreen.
lang.ability.narutorpg.destruction_of_evil_se: This is a collaboration technique whereby eight people simultaneously perform the Tiger hand seal, forming a large sealing formula with a jinchūriki at its centre. The formula then begins to glow and suppress the tailed beast's chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.destructive_beauty.des: Deidara creates a large clay bird that dives towards the ground and detonates, irrespective of whether the opponent is present there or not.
lang.ability.narutorpg.destructive_jinrai.des: The user throws a ball of blue lightning that electrifies the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.destructive_shock.desc: As they conjure their avatars, Sasuke slashes the opponent while Naruto shoots a Tailed Beast Ball, the latter lastly leaving the opponent engulfed in the flames of Amaterasu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.deutzia.desc: Kimimaro swipes at his opponent with one of his bone swords, throwing them behind himself, and delivers a second bone sword swipe, throwing the opponent up in the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.deva_path.desc: The grants the user the ability to manipulate attractive and repulsive forces with objects and people. These techniques, however, cannot be performed in rapid succession; the amount of time required to recharge after use varies depending on the scale of the technique used, five seconds being the basic minimum.
lang.ability.narutorpg.deviate_sword.desc: Mifune punches his opponent in the stomach, and while they're stunned, he strikes down with his sword in a guillotine motion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.devouring_barrier_sphe: At some point, the user of this technique will set up an array of barrier tags, which are camouflaged by surroundings. If the target is not aware of the camouflaged tags, the presence of the target will ignite the trap automatically. Once activated, a dark red chakra sphere will form, trapping the target inside.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dharma_power_barrier_a: Six green poles emerge from the ground, erecting a barrier from all sides and above to repel all incoming attacks. As an extra protection it can also unleash a barrage of senbon, from the hexagram-like seal on the crown of the barrier at the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dharma_power_seal.desc: A fūinjutsu that can be used in collaboration with Dharma Power Sealing Technique: Sen no Rikyū to seal a tailed beast inside a person, making them a jinchūriki. The seal itself takes the form of Japanese calligraphy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dharma_power_sealing_t: With the help of a musical instrument and a fūinjutsu formula on their chest, the user produces a stream of chakra that forms into many purple-coloured chains that are launched from the formula into the target. The chains move very fast, able to bypass Gaara's Shield of Sand, which is known for its speed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dharma_power_silhouett: With the help of the sound of an instrument, the user animates an opponent's shadow, forcing it to strangle and suffocate the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.discharge_lightning_ca: A cooperation ninjutsu used by a Water Release user and Lightning Release user. The Water Release user creates a large puddle of water then, the Lightning Release user electrocutes the opponent, causing an explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.disturbance_taijutsu.d: Disturbance Taijutsu refers to Killer B's unique fighting style.
lang.ability.narutorpg.divine_might_thousand_: Kakashi throwing multiple lightning kunai forward while simultaneously using Kamui on the target. The target was sucked into the Kamui dimension and continued to fall, with Kakashi's lightning kunai continuously piercing and electrocuting the target, finally ending the target in an explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.divine_retribution.des: Obito jumps up in the air, strikes his opponent with three kunai slashes, and kicks them, sending the opponent crashing to the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.divine_sword_sword_of_: The user initiates the attack by striking the opponent with multiple Truth-Seeking Balls. Utilising the flight ability acquired through Six Paths Senjutsu, the user soars above the adversary and channels their power into transforming their shakujō into the formidable Sword of Nunoboko.
lang.ability.narutorpg.diving_snake_attack.de: Orochimaru jumps into the air above his target and releases from his sleeves several snakes that fall down at the opponent attacking them. He then lands and finishes with attacking the opponent with the Sword of Kusanagi.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dog_wall_formation.des: Akino, Bisuke, Guruko, Pakkun, Shiba, Ūhei and Urushi all jump into the air forming circle around Bull. This forms a blockade obstructing the opponents vision as well as enabling them to manoeuvre in the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dojutsu_inferno.desc: It is activated by Itachi's Sharingan, although in the second Heroes game it would be activated by his Mangekyō Sharingan, which would cause the opponent to be consumed by a large pillar of black flames. After the attack ends Itachi's Tsukuyomi Mode is activated.
Itachi activates his Tsukuyomi through Mangekyō Sharingan to bind his opponent in an illusion where Itachi disappears and a black hole appears in the sky.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dojutsu_prison_flame_a: User paralyses opponents with the Sharingan and creates a huge ring of fire, into which it sucks in everyone who is nearby and burns it down.
lang.ability.narutorpg.don_t_let_your_guard_d: Kushina goes in for a hug, but misleads the opponent by throwing them over her head and slamming them into the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.double_black_panther.d: After creating a shadow clone, Darui and his clone both use the Lightning Release: Black Panther technique to attack the target simultaneously.
lang.ability.narutorpg.double_dynamic_entry.d: A collaboration technique where two users perform the Dynamic Entry together to attack the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.double_heavenly_foot_o: Tsunade hits the opponent into the air and Sakura kicks the opponent to the ground where they both deliver a Heavenly Foot of Pain, resulting in deformation of the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.double_human_bullet_ta: Two Akimichi clan members attack from both sides of an opponent with the Human Bullet Tank, crushing, and grinding anything caught in the middle.
lang.ability.narutorpg.double_rasengan.desc: Jiraiya immobilises the opponent with his Earth Release: Swamp of the Underworld while Naruto throws his Rasengan at them. Jiraiya catches his Rasengan with another one and create a great explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dragging_punishment.de: Hidan throws his scythe at the opponent, slashing them while it spins, and brings the opponent in front of Hidan, who then finishes with a kick.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dragon_cat.desc: Fukurokumaru swings a huge gold bar, dealing a powerful blow to his opponent, sending them flying into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dragon_flame_wild_danc: Itachi and Shisui slash the opponent with their blades covered in flames and finished them by expelling dragon shaped fireballs from both sides.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dragon_life_reincarnat: This is a reincarnation technique which uses Ryūzetsu's kekkei genkai. After forming hand seals, the user’s hands begin glowing white. The user then places their hands over the target, similar to the Mystical Palm Technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dragon_spying_techniqu: A technique that allows Shiranami to see through the eyes of the dragon mural and spy on others. He can not only see what's going on in the inside, but also listen to their conversation.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dragon_tail_foot.desc: Zabuza slashes the opponent in half and then spin kicks the remains away.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dramingo.desc: Transformed as Son Gokū, Rōshi begins banging on his chest, stunning and damaging his opponent with the shockwaves created.
lang.ability.narutorpg.drilling_bee.desc: Obito sends out his Truth-Seeking Balls to shape them into large tendrils that emerge beneath the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.drilling_crimson_blade: Towa takes out his blade and activates the tattoo on his right arm to channel his chakra into it. Towa runs toward the opponent, slashing them upwards into the air and then appears above them, and delivers a sharp, drilling slash down upon them, impelling the opponent to the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.drilling_hand_of_sage_: Hagoromo gathers senjutsu-enhanced lightning into his hand to thrust at the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.drilling_needles.desc: Komachi throws several needles, pushing the opponent back, while Towa appears behind the opponent and turns his tattoo into a drill and attacks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.drilling_sky_dancing_f: Temari generates a huge wind cyclone that emits from her Giant Folding Fan, then swings the fan to make a sweep with the cyclone, levelling a large area around her.
lang.ability.narutorpg.drooping_flower.desc: Kurenai attacks the opponent with an elbow strike, followed through with two kicks and a slash with a kunai before finishing with a low sweeping kick that generates a ring of cherry blossom petals around her.
lang.ability.narutorpg.drop_kick.desc: A delivers a powerful single-legged drop kick that sends the opponent flying. It was powerful enough to send Killer B flying through several of Kumogakure's structures.
lang.ability.narutorpg.drowning_bubble_techni: By blowing his bubble pipe, Utakata produces a considerable amount of soap bubbles of various sizes, which are then used to trap an opponent's head in one to subsequently drown them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.drowning_water_blob_te: After liquefying a portion of his body, Suigetsu manipulates the resulting water to surround his target's head, preventing them from breathing in order to either: render the victim unconscious or ultimately kill them if the suffocation is sustained.
lang.ability.narutorpg.drunken_fist.desc: This is a style of taijutsu that is only possible while the user is very drunk. Because they are intoxicated, users move irregularly and erratically: they attack with no warning and defend with unconventional motions.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dummy_balloon.desc: Mecha-Naruto releases three dummy balloons of himself, that explode upon contact with the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dust_cloud_ignition_te: This is a cooperation ninjutsu where a Fire Release user engulfs the opponent in flames which is then supplemented by a Wind Release user, increasing the range and power of the flames.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dust_cloud_sandstorm.d: Gaara creates a sandstorm around himself that can strike multiple opponents, as well as protect him from harm.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dust_release_detachmen: Dust Release: Detachment of the Primitive World Technique is a Kekkei Tōta utilised by the Second and Third Tsuchikage.

Mū creates an array of stone pillars, striking the opponent. Then, he creates the upper part of a Stone Golem, punching the opponent, finishing the opponent by using a cylinder-shaped Dust Release: Detachment of the Primitive World Technique on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dust_release_split_det: After Mū splits himself to make an identical clone, one of the halves throw the opponent up in the air, and vanishes from sight. The other half appears in the air, and both halves shoot a Dust Release attack, catching the opponent in the middle of it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dust_wind_technique.de: Temari uses her Giant Folding Fan to generate a gust of wind that layers the surrounding area in a blast of sand. This layer of sand that accumulates on the nearby trees makes it difficult for others to get a good footing. The initial gust can also temporarily blind opponents by lodging sand in their eyes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dustless_bewildering_c: The Dustless Bewildering Cover technique utilises water vapour to bend the light around the user essentially making them invisible.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dying_wail_fist.desc: Sakon rushes at great speed at the opponent to deliver a barrage of quick punches.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dynamic_action.desc: The user flips towards the opponent and attacks with a series of punches and kicks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dynamic_entry.desc: This is a flying kick directed at an opponent, typically their face.
lang.ability.narutorpg.dynamic_marking.desc: While spinning through the air, a ninken starts urinating, scattering the urine across a wide area. Any opponents that the urine sprays are likely to be confused, embarrassed, and, if it gets in their eyes, temporarily blinded until they can flush it out.
lang.ability.narutorpg.early_sacrifice.desc: Itachi jumps over his opponent while balancing himself over the opponent's shoulder (allowing him to dodge an attack should it happen). Once landing, still holding onto the opponent's shoulder, Itachi throws them over himself onto the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.early_summer_rain.desc: Mifune slashes his opponent repeatedly, and stabs them several times, and finishes it with a single stab, during which he flows chakra through his sword Kurosawa, extending it. The final stab knocks the opponent far back.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_cutter.desc: Zabuza kicks his opponent, delivers a series of slashes with his Kubikiribōchō, then elbows and punches them. He then finishes it with a powerful downward slash that knocks his opponent back.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_dragon_bullet_te: A cooperation ninjutsu between a Water Release user and an Earth Release user in which water and earth are mixed, creating a mud dragon that strikes the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_grudge_fear.desc: The Earth Grudge Fear is a secret kinjutsu of Takigakure which transforms the user's body into something similar to that of a rag-doll, held together by hundreds of thick black threads.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_grudge_fear_fina: Kakuzu throws the opponent in the air and merges his Fire, Lightning, and Wind masks to create a huge blast in which the target is caught.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_added_we: A technique which enhances the targets gravity at the user's discretion. The enemy's mobility is diminished, as the person is crushed by gravity — and in some cases exhibit petrification-like symptoms and then began to crumble.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_antlion_: This technique causes the ground and everything on and around it to be sucked in towards the middle of a large pit, much like the method an antlion uses to catch prey. Upon being dragged to the centre, the victim will then be sucked underground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_barrier_: The user creates a dome of earth around a target or targets, trapping them inside. The walls of the dome have chakra flowing within, which quickly repairs any damage that its prisoners may do to it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_bedrock_: This technique allows the user to control multiple sections of rock and move them around their opponent. The user then forms two gigantic sections that crush the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_bog.desc: Mū creates a disk-shaped bog, which he throws at the opponent to knock them back.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_bottomle: The user turns the ground around a target into deep mud, causing the target to sink into it until reaching their neck. The mud is very thick, making it difficult for the target to free themselves.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_bullet_r: The user sends a huge rock at the opponent, causing them to fall back.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_demonic_: Due being to empowered by Strengthening Prescription: Chakra Injection, Gitai creates an enhanced version of his Earth Release: Hardening Technique. Unlike the previous version, the user creates an armour of rock that encases their body with more demonic- looking, extended arms, that are darker in colour.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_devourin: This technique allows Hiruko to control stones and rocks in the area to attack the enemy, forming several enormous jaws made out of the earth that will swallow and crush the enemy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_double_s: While lurking underground, the user grabs a target and drags them into the earth, leaving only their head above the surface. Because victims are rendered unable to move in this state, they are easily subjected to torture or decapitation.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_drone.de: This technique allows the user to take remote control over rocks, levitating and moving them around.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_dropping: The user creates a giant, boar-shaped, earthen lid high in the air that falls on the target, trapping them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_dust_sto: The user slams their hands on the ground, generating a large amount of soil, which is manipulated and launched towards the opponent as a fast wave with crushing force.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_an: This technique condenses the soil and rock in the area to sprout out in the form of large spikes which attack the target from separate directions in an attempt to skewer the opponent, making it harder to evade.
The user creates a dragon made from the ground to attack the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_co: A technique that causes the surrounding earth to rise up over a target, creating a cavern. The user can leave either leave an opening to allow attacks to enter through the exit, cutting off any way of the target to avoid the being hit or close it up completely to prevent escape.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_cr: The user gathers chakra in their fist and jumps into the air and punches down on the ground, causing it to burst up around the user.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_dr: After creating a mud source, the user creates a dragon-like head to shoot mud balls at an opponent. To be more threatening, the user can combine this technique with a fire technique to make the mud balls become searing hot.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_fl: By flowing concentrated chakra from one's palms into the flowing underground, one can tear the earth apart, creating large chasms. The length, width, direction, and curve of the chasm are shaped and fashioned by the user.

The user transforms the surface underneath their opponent into a muddy river that sweeps them off their feet and carries them down stream. This technique can also be used as a medium for the Earth Release: Earth Dragon Bullet technique.

This technique lets the user condense mud or stone from the ground and shape it into spikes that protrude from the ground in order to skewer the target. The spikes cannot penetrate targets of greater density. In the anime, this technique can also produce a single spike, allowing it to be used as a makeshift knife.
The user creates and rides a wave of earth that can branch off to attack from a distance. The user can also use it to skilfully manipulate the terrain around them and their opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_ma: Using chakra and great physical strength, the user lifts a huge volume of the nearby earth. The mass of dirt is so large as to cast a shadow over the user's opponents and potentially frighten them away. When the user throws the earthen lump, it causes serious destruction at the place of impact.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_pi: This technique causes the ground to explode at the users location, damaging and blowing away all opponents in range.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_qu: The user alters the atomic structure of an earthen material, converting it to glass. Doing so negates the effects of Lightning Release, which earth is ordinarily weak to.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_sh: Jirōbō slams his hands to the ground. The strength of this slam is great enough to rip open a section of the earth in front of him and leverage it up into a wall, similar to a . This wall of earth shields Jirōbō, usually from projectile attacks, but it can also be used against approaching physical strikes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_sp: The user flows earth-natured chakra through all or parts of their body, causing it to become noticeably darker, all while increasing their defensive power to become as hard as diamond.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_st: This technique makes a gigantic rampart rise up beneath the user's feet, by shaping the ground and increasing the amount of earth with chakra. Depending on what the user imagines, the shape of the rampart can be anything from level ground to a steep, needle-like mountain.

This technique allows the user to create a protective wall out of earth. One method of doing this is for the user to convert chakra in their body into an earthen material that they spit from their mouth; the more skilled the user, the greater the volume of earth that can be created.

This is a cooperation ninjutsu whereby several Earth Release users simultaneously perform hand seals and then expel a stream of mud from their mouths, which solidifies into multiple columns of earth. These grow upwards from the ground and together, form a hard, defensive wall.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_earth_wa: The user slams their palm onto the surface below their feet, making it move, akin to waves. This technique is said to require a considerable amount of chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_erupting: Jirōbō while using his superhuman strength in his Cursed Seal Level 2 form, lifts up a gigantic lump of the ground and throws it forward at the opponent where he strikes the earth structure with a powerful punch, shattering it and causing the fragments to bombard the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_fighting: The user causes several columns to emerge from the ground, creating a maze. Its size and complex patterns can disorient opponents, and by memorising its layout, the user can take advantage and attack from blindspots. If an opponent is in an open area, the user can also attack them directly with a column.
After the hand seals are formed, a large fissure, spanning a considerable distance is formed. Unsuspecting victims will then fall deep into the earth.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_fist_roc: By encasing their arm in rock, the user can deal a powerful hardened punch against an opponent while being protected from direct contact with their target. If necessary, the weight of the rock can be increased to further increase the punch's destructive power.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_floating: Ōnoki uses the earth to create large floating rock cubes to toss at the opponent. The rock cubes spin around Ōnoki, doubling as a protection against other attacks. The user can also adjust the size of the rocks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_flying_t: After slamming his hands on the ground, Iō sends a multitude of rocks from the ground to fly at the target. If need be, Iō can use this technique in conjunction with sealing tags to restrict an opponent's movements.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_golem_te: This technique allows the user to create a large, humanoid creature composed of rock that can either be expelled from the user's mouth, or formed from a pre-existing source of earth. Depending on the user, the golem can be formed instantly.

Mū creates several rocks and uses them to strike the opponent. Then, he forms a hand of the Stone Golem, which trips the opponent and forms into a full-body golem, punching the opponent and sending them flying.

Mū creates an array of stone pillars, striking the opponent. Then, he creates the upper part of a Stone Golem, punching the opponent and finishing them off by creating a full-body golem that slams its hand down, flattening the target to the ground.
Mū slams his hand to the ground and creates a Stone Golem. The golem then claps its hands together with the opponent in between them, crushing them in the process.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_gravel.d: The user upturns the earth around a target, then condenses it around them, immobilising and trapping them. The user can reverse the technique if they so wish.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_great_mo: This technique grants the user the ability to freely lower or raise the terrain within a specific area surrounding them, in a similar manner to its parent technique, albeit on a much larger scale. This allows them to create giant holes or elevations in the ground, one of which was large enough to trap the Ten-Tails in.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_ground_b: After forming the necessary seals, the user creates two walls of earth which trap the opponents in between them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_hardenin: By utilising earth-based chakra, the user encases their body in surrounding rock creating an armour. This casing can also be used to create extendible weapons to strike a target with.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_hiding_i: This technique allows the user to camouflage themselves with the earth around and move freely through earth surfaces undetected.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_hiding_l: This technique changes earth into fine sand by channelling chakra into it, allowing the user to dig through it like a mole. This effect goes around the body (not just the hands), making it just large enough for a person to move through.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_iron_fis: The user creates a circular arena surrounded by tall walls which emerge from the earth. The field is then completely changed, becoming a large trench with the soil exposed, not leaving any trace of the original vegetation. If the walls are damaged, they disappear in a puff of smoke, but the terrain remains altered.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_light_we: Contrary to its counterpart, this technique reduces one's gravity, making it much lighter. The atmosphere, along with their body, can be lightened in order to take flight and increasing their manoeuvrability. With enough practice, the user can control their flight through the sky with specific bodily movements.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_lithic_p: Earth Release users create a cube out of solid stone together which is at first split into four parts, trapping anything inside. After forming the snake hand seal, two parts of the boulders will move towards each other with the intention to crush the opponents inside.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_moving_e: This technique grants the user the ability to lower or raise the ground in the surrounding area, allowing them to create giant holes or elevations in the ground. The size of the affected area as well as the depths that it is lowered or raised to is also up to the user.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_mud_body: A technique that transforms the user's body into a mud. The user could form the mud into a makeshift arm, which can stretch a considerable distance, and could form the mud into a wall to protect an ally. The user could also shoot a multitude of mudshots from all directions.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_mud_spor: The user summons a river of mud, which if mixed with water, can speed up the flow and increase its power.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_mud_wolv: A trap technique that is activated when one comes into contact with the user's chakra. Upon doing so, pre-existing mud will form into wolves and attack. Despite being damaged, the wolves will simply reform, keeping the enemy occupied while the user makes a getaway.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_mudslide: The user punches the ground causing the earth to rise underneath them, which releases a wave of dirt.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_multiple: Like the parent technique, it creates a reinforced wall of earth to be used as a defensive mechanism.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_mutabili: This technique is a combination of the Summoning Technique and an Earth Release technique. The user summons a large amount of rock from a giant canyon to be used for other techniques. The user can channel his chakra into the earth to alter the formation, aiding them in sneak attacks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_opening_: With this technique, the user can bring up on the surface something that is deep underground. The targets are launched in air with great strength and speed, the result of which has the appearance and nearly size of an erupting volcano. It can force a large number of soldiers hidden underground to resurface all at once.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_practice: This is a rudimentary Earth Release technique used by shinobi of Iwagakure. After forming the necessary hand seals, the user places their hands on the ground and creates a solid wall to serve as a defensive barricade, manipulating pre-existing earth to rise up and take form.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rending_: While submerged beneath an enemy, the user launches themselves out of the ground to launch an attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_resurrec: The Earth Release Resurrection Technique: Corpse Soil is a jutsu that reanimates the deceased using bodies made of dirt and soil. Kazuma described it as the ultimate Earth element resurrection technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_reverse_: The user condenses the nearby earth around a target, shifting it around their bodies to encase them at various levels. This thereby immobilises and traps them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rising_r: Ōnoki claps his hands together and then unleashes two huge rocks to send the opponent flying backwards.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_bri: By jabbing his jō into an earthen surface, Iwabee can collect rocks around it, making it various melee weapons such as a hammer or spear. In addition to increasing the weight and strength of the blows from his weapon, the user can also strike the ground, creating a long-reaching shockwave.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_col: From a higher ground, the users cause rocks formations to break apart, falling down on their opponents and crushing them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_dro: The user unleashes three huge rocks to smash into the opponent, crushing them in the process.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_gun: The Earth Release: Rock Gun Technique is a technique which bullet-sized bits of rock are expelled from the user's mouth with great speed and force. After they are fired, the chunks expand into huge boulders. Orochimaru stated that when used collaboratively, this technique can most likely destroy a mountain.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_ham: Using his skills of Earth Release, Ōnoki creates a huge rock to hammer the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_lod: This technique destroys the equilibrium that allows a cave to remain standing. By removing the supporting spot, such as a single rock, even the most solid cave becomes fragile and ultimately collapses. A favourite tactic of Iwagakure-nin is to lure opponents into a cave and to then perform this technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_pil: A technique that makes use of the rock terrain by creating multiple rock pillars that emerge from beneath the target and trap them.
This technique lets the user create a few rock pillars that will protrude from the ground to skewer the target. The rock pillars will even pass through obstacles to reach their target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_sec: This technique allows the user to take a small chunk of rock and turn it into the shape of a staff. The user can then use it as a melee weapon or throwing weapon. A variation of this technique allows the user to create several staves and launch them at the target, but with less accuracy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_she: The user surrounds themselves with earth, taken from the immediate vicinity and creates a formation of rock that is capable of protecting both the user and others in close proximity, if desired.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_shu: Ōnoki levitates four huge rocks and spins them like shuriken before hurling them at the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_tat: Ōnoki manipulates several flat wide slabs of stone to attack the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_rock_tra: By slamming their hand into the ground, the user causes a path of large rocks to emerge from the ground and strike the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_sand_dan: After performing the required hand seal, the user lays their hands onto the sand, making it move like a wave which sheds everything above it. Due to the change of the landscape, it can be used to defuse traps or barriers which are installed on it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_sandwich: Earth Release: Sandwich Technique: the user fires a projectile. Learned from rank 3.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_shadow_c: The user creates a shadow clone made of mud. Unlike most clone techniques, after being struck, the clone can reform itself.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_stamping: Gitai, by extending one of his arms, stamps the target with a scorching rock mark, which becomes implanted in the target. After it is implanted, the mark begins glowing, and explodes, destroying the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_sticky_e: A portal opens up in the sky, spewing down a large amount of mud onto the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_stone_lu: The user creates what resembles a precious gem using Earth Release. In the Sasuke Retsuden novel, these gems are described as being formed using chakra alone. In the manga adaptation, Sasuke Uchiha is depicted altering an existing rock into a gem.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_subterra: A technique that transforms the earth surrounding the user into a fluid, allowing them to close in on the enemy with high speed by swimming underground. Since being under the ground is a blind spot, the target has no warning; allowing the user to launch a surprise attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_super_fi: The user jumps into the air and, creating a stone fist, attacks the enemy with force with a blow from top to bottom. The force of the blow is such that it easily splits the ground underfoot, and the speed of the fall leaves a streak of light behind.
