lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_swamp_of: The user creates a swamp by changing the ground beneath a target into mud, which the target sinks into. The mud is infused with chakra to make it sticky, ensnaring the target and preventing escape.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_tearing_: This is among the more basic techniques taught in Iwagakure. By placing the palm of their hand on the ground, the user breaks up and shifts the local earth. The better the user's chakra control, the greater the amount of earth that will be broken up.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_tracking: By utilising overpowered earth-based chakra, Gitai sends multiple tracking projectiles, which moving on the earth surface, to the target and will exploded. This technique is capable of causing a landslide due to damaging the earths surface, even the solid rock.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_tunnelli: This is a technique that allows the user to create tunnels in the ground, which can be used for infiltration purposes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_ultra_ad: A more advanced version of the Earth Release: Added-Weight Rock Technique, in which the user drastically increases the weight of their target, but to a much greater extent than that of the original ability. Under certain circumstances, the technique can be used to increase the force behind attacks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_ultralig: This technique is a more advanced version of the Earth Release: Light-Weight Rock Technique, in which the user drastically decreases the weight of their target, but to a much greater extent than that of the original ability.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_release_undergro: This technique allows its user to silently emerge from an earthen surface, moving as a fish does underwater. As or after they've emerged, users are often well-placed to perform assassinations or guerrilla attacks.
The user creates a landslide of earth that moves towards the target at a fast pace.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_shattering.desc: Jiraiya strikes the opponent repeatedly with one fist while hopping on one leg and then appears behind them to strike them with his palm sending them falling to the ground and finishes by slamming his heel on them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_splitting.desc: Sakura punches the ground using the technique, Cherry Blossom Impact, causing many rocks and the opponent to fly up in the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_tearing_erupting: Hagoromo sends out electricity to the ground, causing chunks of it to rip up, and flames to erupt from the cracks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.earth_tearing_foot.des: Isshiki quickly shrinks himself and reappears in the air to send a strong kick to the ground, causing chunks of earth to damage the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.echo_technique.desc: Suien uses this technique to amplify his voice to a very high-pitched sound, making it loud enough to be heard throughout all of Takigakure.
lang.ability.narutorpg.echolocation_technique: By plucking the strings of her bow, Seiren can track targets by listening for the echoes they produce. Kagura compares it to how dolphins and bats navigate their surroundings. Other sounds, such as thunder, can interfere with it, throwing off her perception.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_branches_techniq: This is Orochimaru's greatest and strongest snake-related technique. Using the "power of reincarnation" possessed by the White Snake as an intermediary, he can transform into a giant white serpent with eight heads and eight tails.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_gates.desc: The Eight Gates are eight specific tenketsu along the chakra pathway system.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_gates_released_f: This is a heightened state that is achieved by opening all Eight Gates. The user opens their body's eighth gate by puncturing themselves just above the heart, causing a bloody steam (resembling a flaming red aura) to start emanating from their pores, hair, and eyebrows.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_aerial_: Hinata runs at the enemy at full speed before jumping and hitting one of the foe's vital organs. Alternatively, she may jump from a high distance and palm the foe continually until all chakra points blast.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_aiki_pa: Hinata poses with her arms defensively, via being a counter/reversal. Upon the opponent hitting her, she then grabs the opponent and sends them flying away straight up into the air with an arm-waving flourish. She then strikes her falling foe with a powerful hit with her palm.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_breachi: The user activates their Byakugan and attacks the opponent with their Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven. They then use their Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm, making the opponent travel in the air with great damage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_four_sk: Neji uses his Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm thrice on his opponent, sending them crashing into a plateau of stone, before using it again to collapse the plateau on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_grid_pa: The user slams their hand on the ground, creating a network of grids which inflict pain on the victim.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_lion_pa: Instead of a shapeless "vacuum shell", Hinata forms a lion-shaped shroud of chakra, identical to the one created by the Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists. It is used to attack the opponent from a distance, blowing them off their feet.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_mountai: A more powerful variation of Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm. The user hits the target at close range with a powerful wave of chakra emitted from their palm, which sends them flying back, causing severe damage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_one_hun: The Eight Trigrams One Hundred Twenty-Eight Palms is a technique of the Gentle Fist fighting style. It is essentially a seventh step to the Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms, doubling the previous barrage total and at twice the speed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_palms_g: This technique is simply a larger, more powerful version of the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_palms_r: This is a secret taijutsu of the Hyūga clan's main house, traditionally only known by the head of the clan and the clan's heir. Neji Hyūga, a member of a branch house, was able to learn this technique through mere observation, a testament to his genius.

This technique is simply a larger, more powerful version of the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven seen only in the video games. Its colour is also different, being orange instead of blue or, in Hinata's case, pink.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_palms_s: Neji traps the opponent into the zone of the Eight Trigrams and delivers several palm attacks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_palms_t: After hitting the opponent into the air with the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven, Hinata continues her assault with several more hits and then a final concentrated hit with both her palms that sends the opponent flying away from her.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_palms_v: First, Hinata hits her opponent, throwing them in the air, then she jumps high in the sky and performs a giant Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven, creating a massive rotating sphere of chakra that crushes the enemy into the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_sealing: The Eight Trigrams Sealing Style is a fūinjutsu of the Uzumaki clan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_sect_pa: Hinata uses a two-handed Gentle Fist as the initial blow on the opponent, then does the same for a total of five extra times from all angles while dancing around, before dashing in front of them and charging chakra within her palms and striking her foe with a palm wave, draining their chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_sixteen: The Eight Trigrams Sixteen Palms is a manoeuvre of the Gentle Fist fighting style. It is essentially a halved version of the already halved Eight Trigrams Thirty-Two Palms. This technique is used to close off the flow of chakra through sixteen chakra points of an opponent's chakra pathway system.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_sixty_f: This is a secret taijutsu of the Hyūga clan's main house, traditionally only known by the head of the clan and the clan's heir. Neji Hyūga, a member of a branch house, was able to learn this technique through mere observation, a testament to his genius.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_spirit_: Neji uses his Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms, but only eight to sixteen times and sends the opponent flying with his palms. Hinata then attacks with her Eight Trigrams Stream Palm Wave, but the last two hit and the chakra wave and Neji finish with a strike of concentrated chakra in his fingers.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_thirty_: The Eight Trigrams Thirty-Two Palms is a manoeuvre of the Gentle Fist fighting style. It is essentially a halved version of the Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms, but seems to be no less effective.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_three_h: This technique allows the user to strike all 361 chakra points of the opponent, paralysing them with each blow and instantly killing them upon the final hit.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_twin_li: An improved version of Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists, used by Hinata after she obtained the chakra of Hamura Ōtsutsuki. This technique is increased in both strength and potential from its predecessor and, unlike the parent technique, the chakra of this technique is purple-coloured.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eight_trigrams_vacuum_: Hinata sends her three lion-shaped shroud of chakra at her opponent blowing them off their feet.

This technique is similar in practice to Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven, but has a specific target rather than a general area. To perform it, the user precisely pinpoints the enemy's vital points with the Byakugan and releases a high-speed palm thrust.

This technique is a variation of the Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm where either two Gentle Fist users, or a single person using both hands, sends a powerful wave of compressed chakra from either palm simultaneously and with great force towards an opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eighty_gods_vacuum_att: The Eighty Gods Vacuum Attack is a kekkei mōra taijutsu utilised by Kaguya Ōtsutsuki.
lang.ability.narutorpg.elbow.desc: After covering himself in his Lightning Release Chakra Mode, A thrusts his elbow at his opponent with extreme force. This technique was strong enough to send Jūgo, who was in his full Sage Transformation, crashing into a wall, disabling him from fighting any further.
lang.ability.narutorpg.electric_eye_laser.des: Mecha-Naruto detaches his arms, trying to catch an opponent who is a considerable distance away, by controlling them remotely.
lang.ability.narutorpg.empty_cicada_shell_tec: This is a ninjutsu used by Jigumo that allows the user to project their voice from any direction. This is generally used to confuse their opponents about their actual position when talking to them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.empty_crash.desc: By utilising the Partial Multi-Size Technique, the user smashes the ground with their enlarged fist, causing debris to fly from the ground into the air. The user then jumps into the air and swings their enlarged fist into the debris, and sends them flying towards their target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.empty_flaming_prison_o: Ichi summons snakes that surround the enemy in large numbers, creating a kind of prison, after which San sends his bird towards them, dropping its exploding feathers on the prison, creating a massive explosion that destroys the enemy along with the prison of snakes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.enclosing_technique.de: Using this technique, a wide variety of objects and even living things can be stored within scrolls, and can be released when the scroll is opened or meets a specific condition.
lang.ability.narutorpg.engraved_tsukuyomi.des: A variation of the Tsukuyomi used by Nanashi Uchiha. By reflecting the light of her Sharingan off of the moon, similarly to the Infinite Tsukuyomi, the user is able to brand all those caught in the light of their eyes with a blemish in the shape of their Mangekyō Sharingan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.enma_summoning_adamant: Hiruzen summons Enma to slash the opponent with his claws until he launches them into the air. He then dives onto them and transforms into a staff that Hiruzen uses to slam the opponent into the ground from midair.
lang.ability.narutorpg.ensnaring_exploding_fl: Obito lands a couple punches, followed by a hit with his gunbai, a gust of wind, another set of hits with the gunbai, which lift the opponent up in the air, and as they fall, Obito throws kunai with explosive tags attached, which explode upon impact.
lang.ability.narutorpg.ephemeral.desc: This technique allows Itachi to put his opponent within a genjutsu by using his finger as a medium. This induces the genjutsu. When the technique was used on Naruto Uzumaki, crows flocked from Itachi and turned into shuriken after he performed the ram seal which bombarded Naruto, and then attempted to put him to sleep.
lang.ability.narutorpg.erupting_dust_sand.des: Gaara performs an uppercut, creating a pillar of sand that launches the opponent into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.erupting_falling_stomp: After throwing his opponent into the air, Han jumps up and stomps them into the ground using his Steam Armour to increase his attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.erupting_formation_bod: Han releases steam from his armour that damages the nearby opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.erupting_interment_dus: Gaara manipulates his chakra to generate multiple small pillars of sand to rise up from the ground beneath the opponent and lift them into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.erupting_propulsion_fi: After increasing their chakra temperature to the boiling point, the user releases boiling steams from his body and delivers a steam-enhanced punch that sends his opponent flying far away.
lang.ability.narutorpg.erupting_revolving_arm: Han delivers a series of strikes, and while aided by his steam, he spin kicks, kicks down, and lands several punches on his opponent as he spins, hitting them upwards.
lang.ability.narutorpg.erupting_revolving_foo: Han delivers a few punches, hits the opponent up, jumps up into the air, and does a spinning downward kick that's accelerated by his steam to the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.erupting_strong_foot.d: After increasing his chakra temperature to boiling point, the user releases boiling steam from his body and delivers a powerful kick to his opponent with enhanced force via Steam Armour. This attack has enough force to generally send his opponent reeling backwards.
lang.ability.narutorpg.erupting_thrust_cannon: Han jumps into the air, and while spinning, lands a kick, a punch, and a steam blast on his opponent, sending them crashing to the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eruption_legs.desc: The user rushes towards the opponent with a kick and follows with an upward kick boosted by their body modifications on their legs.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eternal_lightning.desc: Indra sends out a large ball of electricity, which hovers above the opponent and strikes down bolts of lightning.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eternal_rival_ultimate: Kakashi uses his Sharingan to copy Guy's Dynamic Entry, and then the two of them perform it together.

Kakashi and Guy both attack their opponent with Dynamic Entry. Kakashi reveals his Sharingan and Guy opens the Gate of Wonder, after which the two simultaneously send out a giant-sized Lightning Release: Lightning Beast Tracking Fang and Daytime Tiger.
lang.ability.narutorpg.evasion_technique.desc: Using her dōjutsu, Yome is easily able to see attacks coming, allowing her a better chance to dodge or launch a counterattack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.evening_elephant.desc: The Evening Elephant is a high-level, forbidden taijutsu that can be performed by those who have opened all Eight Gates.
lang.ability.narutorpg.evening_shower_heavenl: Sarada kicks her opponent away, moves herself to where they'll land, and kicks them up in the air. She jumps up above them and proceeds to perform a Lion Combo on them toward the ground. She proceed to throw a Great Fireball and finishing it with a Cherry Blossom Impact on them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.event_recording.desc: This is an unnamed ability possessed by Black Zetsu that allows it to record events that it has personally witnessed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.evernight.desc: Obito makes several rapid movements towards a target while simultaneously readying his sword. Once he reaches the target, he slashes them once.
lang.ability.narutorpg.evil_deeds.desc: Obito goes intangible, rushes at his opponent, and at the last moment, materialises himself, slashing his opponent with a kunai.
lang.ability.narutorpg.evil_disturbance_waltz: Clad in Susanoo, Madara hurls his chakra sword at the opponent, swirling like a shuriken. During his battle with Hashirama Senju, Madara had cloaked Kurama in his Susanoo, and pierced through the beast's Tailed Beast Balls for a more damaging result.
lang.ability.narutorpg.evil_greatness.desc: Orochimaru first punches the opponent in the face and knocks them back. He then wraps the opponent with countless snakes which creates a dome around them and holds them. He then jumps and stabs them with his Sword of Kusanagi, finishing them off.
The Evil Releasing Method is a direct counterpart to the Evil Sealing Method. It is used to release technique-induced seals on a person rather than sealing it. Compared to the Evil Sealing Method, the Evil Releasing Method requires far less preparation.
lang.ability.narutorpg.evil_sealing_method.de: This technique suppresses the power of a cursed seal. Because applying cursed seals in the first place requires a great deal of skill, suppressing one with this technique also requires a great deal of skill.
lang.ability.narutorpg.evilest_assassins.desc: Itachi creates a water clone to punch and hold the opponent. Kisame slashes them into the air while using the remains of the destroyed water clone to summon a water shark to strike the opponent. The opponent falls in the wake of Itachi's Tsukuyomi in which the opponent withers away as though they were water.
lang.ability.narutorpg.exclusive_summoning_ze: Shinnō summons the Zero-Tails, then fuses with it and unleashes a massive attack with his shadow arms, trying to crush the enemy. However, the fusion is time-limited, and Shinnō is unable to perform more than two attacks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.execution_by_kiss.desc: This ability allows Fūka to absorb all of an opponent's chakra and techniques by kissing them, giving her multiple elemental affinities, as well as enforcing the ones she already has and gaining access to all of her victim's elemental techniques. After absorbing her opponent's chakra, she could steal their soul.
lang.ability.narutorpg.existence_beheading.de: Mifune performs a powerful strike, quickly drawing his sword and cutting through his opponent. His opponent only feels the attack as Mifune resheaths his sword.
lang.ability.narutorpg.expansive_truth_seekin: The Expansive Truth-Seeking Ball is a kekkei mōra used by Kaguya Ōtsutsuki. It is composed of all five elemental nature transformations as well as Yin–Yang Release.
lang.ability.narutorpg.exploding_circle.desc: Hanzō performs a spin with his kusarigama, releasing a circle of exploding tags in the process, which then explode on impact with his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.exploding_dragon_strik: Tenten opens one of her scrolls and releases a large flaming dragon that explodes upon contact.
lang.ability.narutorpg.exploding_flame_shot.d: By creating a spark from their hands, this technique allows the user to throw multiple balls of flames, which are able to either cause fiery explosions on impact or set the target on fire.
lang.ability.narutorpg.exploding_human_techni: This technique was created by Chino after the Fourth Shinobi World War, who used information within minerals springs that came into contact with White Zetsu as a reference to structure the technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.exploding_insect.desc: The user blinds the enemy with a smokescreen to scatter larvae that if inhaled, will grow inside their bodies into a spider-like parasite that explodes, killing the host. The insect's growth depends on how much chakra the host is using and a massive amount of chakra can speed up the growth process.
lang.ability.narutorpg.exploding_mucus_shot.d: The user sprays yellow acidic paste on the ground, which can raise up to create a wall-like formation, capable of either damaging a target or providing effective coverage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.exploding_sand_boulder: Gaara condenses his sand into many floating boulders. Once formed, he can use them both as projectiles and as explosives, setting them off both at will or when an opponent gets near them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.exploding_sasumata_att: Gamaken attacks the opponent using his Sasumata, which causes explosions.
lang.ability.narutorpg.exploding_tree_spear.d: Danzō unleashes roots that sprout from his arm to attack the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosion_ice_mountain: Mizore uses his Retractable Cable Arm to launch his metal hand to grab the opponent, spin them in the air, and launch them to an ice mountain that breaks and parts of its ice fall down on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosion_release_defe: The user creates a small explosion in their palm. If properly timed and angled, it can be used to send thrown kunai back at the enemy. Gari has also used this to cut the length of binding cloth that Maki used to restrain Pakura.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosion_release_impa: Gari punches the ground, the explosion causing the earth to upturn, unbalancing his opponents.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosion_release_inst: Gari concentrates the maximum explosive element in his fist, and when he strikes an opponent's body, it does not explode, but completely incinerates them in an instant.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosion_release_land: After establishing direct contact with their opponent through a simple punch, the user utilises Explosion Release to subsequently generate an enormous explosion from the opponent's insides. This explosion is powerful enough to completely obliterate an opponent far larger than the user.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosion_release_quic: Gari creates an explosion under his foot, which greatly increases his speed and increases the impact of his kick on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosive_bubble.desc: After Utakata blows dozens of bubbles, they make their way towards opponents. Upon popping, they create bright yellow and white flashes along with variably strong explosions that knock back the enemy and everything nearby.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosive_clay.desc: Explosive Clay is the characteristic skill of Deidara, first used during his career as a terrorist bomber, and later as a member of Akatsuki.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosive_clay_dolls.d: Deidara releases a glob of explosive clay from both his hands that he forms into deformed human-like figures. Deidara then uses them to fight his opponent in close combat.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosive_clay_snake.d: Using explosive clay, Deidara creates snakes and sends them to slither towards the opponent and explode on contact.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosive_clay_twin_bi: Deidara creates a clay owl and eagle, that explodes on impact with an opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosive_flower.desc: Ino throws a bouquet of flowers with explosive tags hidden in them, which detonate upon making contact with the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosive_great_ball_r: Konohamaru brings out a giant explosive ball from a scroll and kicks towards to the opponent, exploding momentarily.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosive_landmines.de: After creating the C2 Dragon, Deidara has the clay dragon spawn numerous clay mines and has his partner bury them underground, thus allowing unsuspecting victims to walk on the mines which then explode. These landmines explode automatically when they're stepped on. As such, they're not under Deidara's control.
lang.ability.narutorpg.explosive_parachute.de: Shikamaru sends out three parachutes with explosive tags attached, which float toward the opponent and explode.
lang.ability.narutorpg.extinction_still_water: Itachi first attacks using the Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique, then pelts the enemy with a barrage of kunai, and finally finishes them off with a powerful sword strike.
lang.ability.narutorpg.extreme_decapitating_a: This is a stronger version of Decapitating Airwaves, having greater power, range, and coverage angle. Using a large amount of chakra, Zaku Abumi emits a high-pressured mixture of sound waves and airwaves from the holes in the palms of his hands into the area ahead of him.
lang.ability.narutorpg.eye_mind_reading.desc: Eye Mind Reading is a technique that allows the user to read another's mind.
lang.ability.narutorpg.face_copying_technique: The user becomes a near-perfect copy of another. In addition to appearance, it also makes them copy their target's scent, chakra signature, and general personality. The technique is considered to be a flawless Transformation Technique as even the copied person's allies won't be able to tell the difference.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fairy_tale_destruction: This is a cooperation ninjutsu with Naruto farting and Sakura getting enraged (summoning her Inner Sakura), it does major damage to the opponent and also poisons them because of Naruto's Fart.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fairy_tale_get.desc: Inner Sakura appears and Sakura rushes forward with her fists raised, pushing and hitting the target multiple times. Afterwards she finishes with a kick.
lang.ability.narutorpg.falling_aerial_blossom: Kurenai vanishes in a gust of cherry blossoms and then reappears in the air in front of the opponent, throwing explosive tags at them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.falling_chain.desc: Obito jumps up in the air, lands a kick and two punches, and finishes by throwing his opponent back down with his chains.
lang.ability.narutorpg.falling_fire_scatter.d: Sasuke, whilst in the cursed seal Level 2, flies through the opponent and then into the air, where he releases a series of small fire shots that rain down upon the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.falling_vortex_interme: Gaara manipulates his sand to create a small body of sand in mid air and cause it to come crashing down into the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.falling_wrapping_thrus: In his four-tailed form, Naruto leaps into the air and wraps his tails around himself. He then crashes to the ground, spinning like a piledriver. This move can block close-range techniques.
Temari waves her Giant Folding Fan, sending a whirlwind towards her opponent. Upon it reaching her opponent, she waves her fan again, which causes the whirlwind to throw her opponent upwards.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fang_beheading_fang.de: Kiba and Akamaru combine into a giant two pointed drill that runs through the opponent, launching them into the air where Kiba strikes the opponent with one of the drill points and running through them, throwing them aside.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fang_heaven_wolf.desc: Kiba and Akamaru hit the opponent with Fang Passing Fang, sending them airborne and criss-cross to further damage the opponent in the sky.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fang_insects_fang.desc: Kiba and Akamaru perform Fang Passing Fang with Shino covering himself with his kikaichū and attack the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fang_passing_fang.desc: An Inuzuka and their ninken companion both perform the Passing Fang, whereby they rotate their bodies and deliver a series of rapid body blows to a target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fang_rotating_fang.des: The user and their ninken partner roll at a ferocious speed in a buzz-saw like shape, and deliver many powerful beast-like attacks when contact is made with the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fang_s_rush.desc: Ameyuri Ringo utilises Kiba in combination with agile spinning movements, sweeping through her targets while rotating around herself, hitting all enemies around her.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fang_violent_fang.desc: Like the original version of Fang Passing Fang, Akamaru becomes Kiba through Beast Human Clone but instead of jumping off his back and then attacking, Akamaru jumps from Kiba's back towards the enemy and uses Passing Fang to launch the enemy into the air, then he and Kiba do the same several times on the airborne enemy
lang.ability.narutorpg.fang_wolf_fang.desc: After an Inuzuka and their ninken combine into a Double-Headed Wolf, they begin spinning extremely rapidly towards their target. Because of how fast they spin, they are not able to see while using this technique, necessitating that targets be marked beforehand so that they can be tracked by smell.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fangs_of_lightning.des: By drawing together his twin swords, Raiga can send an electrical essence into the clouds, allowing him to create lightning strikes in any desired location.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fangs_of_the_monkey_ki: Hiruzen charges at his opponent, landing a kick in their gut, then he enlarges and extends Enma in his staff form. Enma manifests himself at the end of the staff and attacks the opponent with his fangs.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanned_calamity_flames: After shooting fire onto the opponent, Tobi uses his gunbai to strengthen the flames, which creates a vortex of fire that knocks them into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanned_flame_great_fir: The user fans their gunbai to unleash three fire whirls that blast the opponent.
Madara fans his gunbai, surrounding himself with six fire whirls that rotate around him.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/a_crystal_reflec: The technique is similar in style to the Demonic Mirroring Ice Crystals technique of the Yuki Clan. However, utilizing the Jade Crystal Labyrinth and its reflective properties, the user casts a generic genjutsu that changes the appearance of the crystal in a subtle manner.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/absolute_darknes: It is a Genjutsu developed by Junsui after learning the Bringer of Darkness technique combined with his Senses manipulation genjutsu. This technique is basically an enhanced form of the parent jutsu.

Zettai-teki na Yami : Sekai no Kage (絶対的な闇:世界の影, Absolute Darkness: World of Shadows) is a jutsu developed by Nigini, it allows him to create a large dome where the sense of sight wont work, only the user has the sense of sight, so basically, Nigini can create a world where he is the one with vision and everybody insid
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/all_seeing_darkn: This technique is the strongest genjutsu of Kogomei Nara. Using natural energy, with Yin and Yang chakra, she creates a miniature moon, then covers it in her Shadow Forest technique, causing it to emit not light, but darkness. This darkness ensnares anything it covers in a genjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/allied_shinobi_f: The is a combination of many unique abilities of the Allied Shinobi Forces to combat the Ten-Tails. The Allied Shinobi Forces Technique is focused on three primary goals; disrupt the opponents sensory abilities, restrain the Ten-Tails, and combat and remove Madara and Obito Uchiha from play.
The is a combination of many techniques devised by Shikaku Nara, using the unique abilities of the Allied Shinobi Forces to combat Demonic Statue of the Outer Path.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/amatsukami.desc: Amatsukami (天津神, Amatsukami) is a Mangekyō Sharingan technique that doesn't require eye contact granted to the Mangekyō of Sigma Uchiha. It is said that this technique is the "Pathway of Peace" (,) the antipode to Amenotokotachi — a powerful , and Amaterasu — a powerful , both fellow Mangekyō techniques.
Acknowledged by Ryun Uchiha as the "most terrible corruption of Ninshū" (忍宗の戦慄汚職, Ninshū no Senritsu Oshoku), it is an ability developed by Seireitou Hyūga which serves as the foundation of his dark methods as a criminal lord that seeks to bring the Sengoku Rebirth to fruition.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/ambience.desc: Ambience is a special genjutsu used by Fukkatsu. Unlike most genjutsu, this illusion does not affect victims through sight or hearing, instead it affects them through smelling. By infusing their scent with chakra, the user can cast an illusion to whoever smells the scent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/amenokoyane.desc: The Amenokoyane is a visual technique employed by Densetsu. The last time this jutsu was even heard of was during the warring states period. The Genjutsu was a particularly fierce one because when cast, a victim would not be able to break out of it unless he knew of the jutsu, or saw it being cast.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/amenonaemasu.des: Amenonaemasu is a powerful Genjutsu technique of the Mangekyō Sharingan Dōjutsu and noted to be one of the most powerful Genjutsu in existence. It is accessed in Kama Uchiha's left eye and Heiwa Uchiha's right eye.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/amenowakahiko.de: Amenowakahiko is a powerful Genjutsu Dōjutsu utilized through Kama Uchiha's right Mangekyō Sharingan eye. The user projects an illusion at the target, which affects all senses.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/anaesthetic_tech: This unnamed anaesthetic technique demonstrated by Kuukoyo is a genjutsu that can make a person sleep soundly. It was used on Takatsuke Uzumaki to stop him from trying to fight Riyan Uchiha and his Tatsu while invading Konoha. Though, at the time she utilized this jutsu, Takatsuke was already unconcious.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/angelic_illusion: Angelic Illusion: Tengoku ( あんげぃｃ いっぅシオン： 天国, Angelic Illusion: Tengoku) is a the ultimate Genjutsu of the Angelic Illusion branch, a branch of genjutsu created by Coming Soon. Who taught it to Soru Kurama.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/antithesis.desc: Using his hand as a medium, Shintai is able to place a large number of people under a subtle genjutsu, and since his enter lower arm is being utilized as a medium, any kind of gesture such as pointing, a flick of a wrist or finger-snapping can trigger this; making it highly undetectable and greatly decreasing the chanc
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/arasushin.desc: Arasushin (荒らす真, Arasushin; Literally meaning "to invade reality") is the power residing within the eyes of Shura Uchiha —the son of the infamous Sayuri Uchiha. It is a of the highest caliber; other illusionary techniques are said to dull in comparison.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/arudainai.desc: Arudainai (在る堕以内 [アロディニア] Arudainai; Literally meaning "Degenerating into less than being") is the name coined by Makoto Suehiro for the form of combat that Yaeka Sakamori employs whenever she attempts to truthfully harm someone.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/ascending_buddha: The Ascending Buddha is a technique long since forgotten by shinobi, a once feared initiator for one of the most powerful Genjutsu in existence. The user can begin the technique by summoning a huge statue which has laid hidden in Mount Myōboku for ages, bringing it into the battle.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/autumn_fall.desc: The Autumn Fall (落葉飘零, Rakuyō Hyōrei) is a sleep inducing genjutsu and works similar to . The user caused large amount of leaves to fall down from the sky. Anyone who sees enough of these leaves fall, they will fall into a deep sleep.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/bad_mercy.desc: Bad Mercy is Genjutsu crafted by Amena Shiranami to exploit her enemies’ emotional vulnerabilities. Amena uses this to apply her targets into a vivid illusion where they witness their own allies turning against them, begging for forgiveness as Amena’s silhouette looms over them with a sadistic grin.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/banga.desc: Banga is an extremely powerful genjutsu created by . When the users activates Banga the target is trapped in a dream like reality and a unique book/manga/novel materializes in front of the user.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/barrier_style_ge: By performing the correct sequence of hand seals for precise chakra control, the user can perform a B-rank ninjutsu which combines barrier ninjutsu and genjutsu which creates a large circular barrier in which hides whatever hides within it from but can sense anything interacting and/or entering the barrier.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/batsu.desc: Batsu: the user affects everyone nearby. Learned from rank 3.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/benediction_of_a: This genjutsu is a rare move that works on two folds reversing a genjutsu and also casting one. Its original design was to dispel genjutsu. For the first half the opponent must successfully capture Raido within a genjutsu. Regardless of the style whether it is auditory, or visual.
Benzaiten (Tsuna) is a technique which is seemingly derived from the very powerful , invented by Tsuna Uchiha. Banzaiten unlike Tsukuyomi doesn't require eye contact, but captures those within the vicinity. This technique allows Tsuna to open the route of his target(s) mind and manipulate their memory.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/blade_concealed_: The user traps their target inside a genjutsu in which the user proceeds to use a kunai to deliver a swift slash while the opponent is fully immobilized.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/blade_regalia_of: Upon manifesting both Junketsu and Senketsu, Yoshida executes a sword technique that requires exactly 369 strikes to the body. To begin the attack, Yoshida activates his Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan and catches the opponent in Tsukuyomi.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/bladesong_techni: Bladesong Technique is a signature technique of Tōjirō Ryōgi, which utilizes the practitioner's blade as a medium for inflicting . The technique is activated by across the surface of a blade, which is then emitted into the surrounding environment as a high frequency pulse.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/blue_lotus_datur: The Blue Lotus Datura Seal (青ロータス作用封印, Aorotasu Genkakusayōfūin) is a Genjutsu and Fūinjutsu created by Yua Shimura as a way to seal the Seven-Tails. The sealed entity, within it's vessel, is constantly being subdued rather than one exceptionally powerful seal keeping it dormant for long periods of time.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/blue_lotus_style: Doujinn transports the victim to a mist covered lake, where they see him holding a blue lotus. Suddenly, the lotus splits and the petals spin around the victim. Doujinn then takes one of his blades and strikes with slow but elegant blows cloaked in Freezing Release chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/brain_hypnosis_i: There are 2 ways Aoi Uchiha can do this technique. The first way is by eye contact with his Sharingan, Aoi uses this technique and centers it around the brain, then what this genjutsu does is close off all the points in the chakra pathway system that enter the brain.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/bringer_of_brigh: The technique creates a very bright white light which blinds the eyesight of everyone except the user. The user can use this to gain the upper hand, or to make a hasty retreat, or to set up for a more complicated attack without fear of interruption.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/bringer_of_darkn: Bringer-of-Darkness Technique {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Bringer-of-Darkness Technique.png |named=Yes |kanji=黒暗行の術 |romaji=Kokuangyo no Jutsu |english tv=Genjutsu: Infinite Darkness Jutsu |other names= |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu= |jutsu rank=A |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Suppleme
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/bringer_of_natur: Bringer-of-Nature Technique is a powerful genjutsu developed by Asuna Kurama during her time in the . This technique is primarily evoked in conjunction with Asuna's Phantom Projection Technique as she creates projections of the different nature transformations.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/brutal_mind_affe: An advanced genjutsu utilized by the members of the Kurama Clan, by weaving the needed hand seals, the user can influence the sensation of their victim’s recently experienced pain. To be precise, they can manipulate where the pain has been felt and move the feeling to another area of the body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/bubbled_existenc: Using the palm of his hand as a medium, Shūrin casts a genjutsu. After directing their palm outwards towards his target, bubbles and foam start emerging from Shūrin's body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/burning_blood.de: This technique, originally developed by Yokōkaze Fuyutama to be used as an interrogation method, allows the user to inflict a painful illusion upon their victim. Requiring Sharingan eye contact as an initiation this genjutsu will assault a target with a burning sensation throughout their cardiovascular system.
Using a nearby ' pollen, the user places anyone who comes in contact with it under a strong genjutsu that is hardly noticeable due to the technique's inconspicuous execution. In this genjutsu, the victim has the impression to cross an area over and over again while in reality, it does not move at all.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/cat_genjutsu.des: The user puts the opponent in a genjutsu where the whole place changes inside the opponent's mind. A new scenery and skilled cats are created illusory and although it is not real, they can fight against the victim.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/chakra_ghost_tec: With , the user is able to cast a genjutsu involving the creation of silhouettes or illusory beings as a means of distraction. The entities are so realistic that they even have their own chakra pathway system, which can fool even the "all-seeing" Byakugan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/chakra_pressure_: Chakra Pressure Genjutsu is a technique used by Raido to take complete control of the opponent's bodies. To use he must, physically exert the force of his chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/chaotic_illusion: Demonic Touch is another 'physical' Genjutsu, which involves the user needing to touch the target(s). The Genjutsu makes it seem as if the user is lost within a hellish realm, and the mental pain they feel actually impacts the bodies internal organs.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/coercion_sharing: Coercion Sharingan {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Coercion_sharingan.png |named=Yes |kanji=威圧写輪眼 |romaji=Iatsu Sharingan |literal english=Coercion Copy Wheel Eye |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Genjutsu: Sharingan |jutsu classification=, Dōjutsu, Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive |jutsu range=Short |users=
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/crimson_leaf_dre: Kurenai attacks her opponent with a triple combo attack dealing an elbow strike and two kicks before fading into a mist in front of the opponent and then appearing again behind them in a pink mist and striking them with a kunai in the back which then sends the opponent into the air.
Curse of Hatred is a powerful genjutsu that is casted on the user. When used they lose their sense of humanity and go berserk. The user's presence becomes so ominous and evil that even a tailed beast can be unnerved by it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/curse_technique_: This technique is a Curse Technique, and is limited to the worshippers of Jashin within the Jashin Cult. This Jutsu is a Curse Technique unique to Zuie, limiting it to her alone. By using the approiate hand-seals, Zuie will cast the genjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/cute_ladies_in_t: Cute Ladies in the Clouds is a Genjutsu technique created by Kazuhiko Kajimoto. This technique was created to tease Kentarō. He ended making this a primary technique when he is in trouble The Genjutsu seals the target in a mental world where he ends up in a hot spring with a bunch of attractive ladies.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/dance_of_the_fal: Dance of the Fallen Leaves is a technique developed by Koyone Takamori, which simultaneously employs the practitioner's and prowess. The technique is activated when the user is seemingly struck by an attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/dance_of_the_moo: Dance of the Moonless Sky is a technique which combines the user's and prowess. Unlike most genjutsu, which ensnare victims through sight or sound, the illusory effect of this technique is activated when the victim's body or equipped items come into physical contact with the practitioner's sword.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/dance_of_the_pow: Dance of the Powdered Snow is a simple, yet potentially overwhelming, technique that employs the practitioner's and abilities simultaneously.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/dance_of_the_ris: Dance of the Rising Sun is a simple technique that combines a rudimentary level and proficiency in order to disorient and disrupt opponents. This is accomplished by simultaneously engaging an opponent with a precise barrage of sword strikes and generating unexpectedly bright flashes of illusory light.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/dark_hazard.desc: The user makes a single glance at the target, the target finds them in a dark room with the greatest fear. In order to end the genjutsu, the target can either stab themselves or commit suicide.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/dark_night_in_th: Dark Night in the Rainy Season *Name: *Type: A-rank, Offensive, Short to Mid-range (0-10m) *User(s): Aiko Saru *Hand Seals: Half Tiger *Debut: None The target is put under the illusion of being in a pitch black room while rain slowly fills up the room. Plays on the fears of drowning, inevitable death, and slow death.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/dark_release_eye: Usable only during the night, when the moon is present, Kaasage uses chakra stored by his Inhaling Maw to create an orb of black energy that resembles a star in his palm. Kaasage throws the orb into the sky where it appears to consume the moon.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/daze.desc: Daze is Juro Uchiha's own Genjutsu, and one of his signature techniques. Unlike most Genjutsu, Daze is unique in a key manner—it works upon touch. Any form of contact the user makes on another opponent puts the opponent in a powerful Genjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/death_circus.des: A lethal genjutsu that often comes by surprise to those who have never seen it. The genjutsu power is mostly from the element of surprise. Unlike most genjutsu that sffect the visual and auditory senses, this genjutsu focuses on capturing all five of the human senses.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/demonic_curse_mi: This is a very powerful genjutsu, known as one of the most powerful non-Sharingan genjutsu in the world. This technique is one of Otoshi Nagare's signature techniques and makes him very well known as a deadly opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/demonic_flute_ba: The user places a target under a genjutsu using their Demonic Flute that involves the victim being subjected to high pitch screeches. The target will feel as if their eardrums are bursting.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/demonic_flute_ph: Demonic Flute: Phantom Sound Chains {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Mateki - Mugen Onsa.png |named=Yes |kanji=魔笛・夢幻音鎖 |romaji=Mateki: Mugen Onsa |english tv=Demon Flute: Chains of Fantasia |viz manga=Musical Genjutsu: Chains of Fantasia |jutsu rank=B |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementa
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/demonic_flute_vo: Using the Demonic Flute, the user casts a genjutsu on a target, which makes the victim hear sounds, voices or whispers based on the user's choice. This can be used to distract, confuse or psychologically torture the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/demonic_illusion: Demonic Illusion could refer to any of the following genjutsu: * Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour * Demonic Illusion: Descending Hell Technique, or Demon Illusion: Fire Jutsu. * Demonic Illusion: Double False Surroundings Technique, or Genjutsu: Double Optic Delusory. * Demonic Illusion: False Surroundings Techniq

Initially, Kemuri creates a large amount of thick smoke chakra that can cover an area. Once the stage has been set, she begins her illusion, creating a tale that is tailored to the target, one that penetrates the walls they have created in their mind.
Making the hand seals for the illusion, Zaikyou submerges the opponent into a desert like area with a touch of the hand.

Inojin fixates himself onto a single target, putting them under a genjutsu, in which Inojin draws 100 quadrupedal beasts of different shapes and sizes. Upon contact with the opponent, the creatures splatter, covering their target with a heavy and sticky ink-like substance.

After performing the required hand seals, this genjutsu seizes command of the target's sense of perception. Once trapped in the genjutsu the target's attacks seemingly bend around the user almost as if refusing to connect with their intended victim.
Once the jutsu is cast, the illusion traps the target in a world entirely submerged in water.
The Demonic Illusion: Banquet Technique is an ocular reality-bending Genjutsu that requires the Sharingan Kekkei Genkai.

Demonic Illusion: Barrier of Moonlit Night (魔幻・月夜結界, Magen: Tsukiyo Kekkai) is the Mangekyō Sharingan technique awakened within the left Mangekyō of Nasuka Uchiha. This technique is literally barrier genjutsu. First, Nasuka either flashes her left eye or weaves the Tiger, Phoenix signs.

It is a powerful murasaki sharingan illusion that uses the essence of Yin to enclose the victim in a basilisk nest-like cosmic, the victim is eaten by a serpent that plays with the target in its lair, it not only dies in the illusion, but also really dies.
Using their Kyōgan, the user appear to turn himself into a giant monster that devours the target pulling them into a world of darkness.

Demonic Illusion: Beast Tamer Technique (魔幻・猛獣使いの術, Magen: Mōjūdukai no Jutsu) is a well-known Genjutsu. Its purpose is to restrain the target in its place using pain. Once the hand seals are performed, the technique will take place.

The Demonic Illusion: Bell Cricket Technique is a genjutsu created by Kirie. It projects a high-pitched tone over a wide area, overloading the hearing of anyone in range and knocking them unconscious.
This technique uses the Ketsuryūgan to subject an opponent in a genjutsu where they will witness a appear above them and believe that they are being sucked in.

Demonic Illusion: Black Nirvana * Name: Demonic Illusion: Black Nirvana (Magen: Kuro Nehan) literally "Genjutsu: Black Nirvana" * Type: A-Rank, Supplementary * Range: - * Classification: Genjutsu * Handseals: None.

After you perform the hand seals, the illusion may take effect against your opponent or not because the opponent may not look at you. If the opponent did happen to look at you, the illusion takes effect and brings your opponent to the illusion.

This jutsu gives the victim a nightmare of them standing over their dead loved ones with their blood on their hands. The image is shaky and resembles a dream with a high pitch scream in the background.

A that is not used solitary but rather to augment or sustain an already-existing one, developed by Shisui Uchiha. When the victim of said pre-existent illusion remarks he is in fact under the effects of one, he will attempt to break it.

Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Sai Trapped.png |kanji=魔幻・蠱惑の甘言 |romaji=Magen: Kowaku no Kangen |literal english=Demonic Illusion: Cajolery of Glamour |game names=Evil Illusion: Enhancing Flattery |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu= |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu

Demonic Illusion: Casting Emotions is a that alters the target's emotions. Upon weaving the appropriate hand-signs, the illusion takes effect. Through , the user is able to channel false emotions into the target's subconscious which allow the user to manipulate how the target reacts to certain stimuli.
A genjutsu that causes the target to see a large demonic hell hound, the hell hound will then give chase to the target and will not stop until the target has been captured.

A powerful genjutsu created by Kamu Shinsen, it has the ability to confound even the most skilled shinobi. Kamu uses this genjutsu in two situations: if the opponent is with a team or if he is alone. If he is with a team, he separates the members of the team and casts the genjutsu on his target.
The genjutsu can be performed by eye contact alone. The main use of this genjutsu is to have the target believe their blood has been replaced with ravening maggots.

The Demonic Illusion: Crimson Demon Divination Mirage (魔幻: 紅邪鬼魔法 蜃気楼, "Magen: Kujakumahō Shinkirō") is a powerful multipurpose medical genjutsu that fools the body into attacking itself, essentially producing within them an [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Autoimmune_disease autoimmune disease].
Demonic Illusion: Crimson Labyrinth (悪魔のイリュージョン：クリムゾンの迷宮 Labyrinth of Crimson: Illusion of Devil) is perhaps one of Soru's most infamous techniques. As well as one of his most flexible as well.

This causes the victim, or victims, to hallucinate dark shapes moving in the corner of their sight, which will promptly disappear when focused on. By doing so the practitioner is able to break an opponent's concentration at the task at hand, weakening them at the same time.

Although Raido hates genjutsu, this particular one is among his most deadly. When used by an opponent it allows them to believe they have more chakra and than they naturally do which can lead to fatigue on the target as they are led in a false sense of security.

Demonic Illusion: Depth Haze (魔幻・かすみ, Magen: Kasumi) is a simple utilized by those of the Kurama Clan. Upon casting the technique, the user manipulates the target's . The technique was designed to be used in conjunction with other techniques and fighting styles.

Demonic Illusion: Descending Hell Technique {{JutsuInfobox |image=Demonic_Illusion_Descending_Hell_Technique.png |named=Yes |kanji=魔幻・地獄降下の術 |romaji=Magen: Jigoku Kōka no Jutsu |english tv=Demon Illusion: Fire Jutsu |game names=Demon Illusion: Hellfire Jutsu |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu range=Mid

Demonic Illusion: Dirge of The Exiled is a collaborative technique created by the Gleeful Twins as a way to mentally subdue their opponents in a powerful, double genjutsu. First, Tsukai casts Demonic Illusion: Descending Hell Technique, creating a massive fireball in the sky.

A unique and perplexing jutsu Raido discovered and created in his battle with Kohana Uzumaki While battling her, he learned that you can recalibrate the auditory sense of the human ears by readjusting the amount of decibels they receive and reflect if back and disrupt the flow of sound.

Demonic Illusion: Double False Surroundings Technique {{JutsuInfobox |image=Double False Surrondings.PNG |named=Yes |kanji=魔幻・二此処非の術 |romaji=Magen: Nijū Kokoni Arazu no Jutsu |english tv=Genjutsu: Double Optic Delusory |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Demonic Illusion: False Surroundings Technique |jutsu classification=G
Utilizing his special smoke bombs that contains extracts of the blue hallucinogenic flower as a medium, Shintai can simply put his target(s) under this subtle but effective genjutsu.

Demonic Illusion: Dream Eater Technique {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Dream Eating Technique.png |literal english=Dream Eater Technique |english tv=Dream Eater Jutsu |viz manga=Dream Feasting Jutsu |game names=Dream Eater Jutsu |other names=Banquet of Spirits |jutsu rank=A |jutsu classification=Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, K

One of the most powerful genjutsu, the user dispels a colorful mist with a loud noise that covers up a huge area. Once the mist is affects any of the target's five senses (seeing, feeling, smelling, hearing, tasting it), the target is then taken to a place where their wildest dreams are chilled.
A simple genjutsu that can give someone the impression he is drowning. Even if he is fighting for his life and swims towards the surface, it looks to him like his is getting farther from the surface.

Using her ability to create smoke, Kemuri makes a light, almost insubstantial smoke that is almost undetectable. By mixing it into the air that the opponent breathes, the genjutsu packed smoke can find its way into the opponent's body.
This illusion is a rather simple, but highly effective paralysis-type illusion. While rarely given a name, Yaeka has done so for her own entertainment.
This is a powerful illusion that can put a target inside a dream-like limbo for an extended period of time, while completely suppressing his chakra.

Demonic Illusion: Emotions Manipulation (魔幻・感情手捌き, Magen: Kanjoutesabaki) is a vigorous Genjutsu well-known in Kirigakure, yet it has its fair share of users scattered around the shinobi world. This technique was feared during the second shinobi war.
Demonic Illusion: Endless Torments The user is able to cast a very strong illusion, which in terms of strength and difficulty of recovering from this technique is equal to tsukuyomi.

Demonic Illusion: Eternal Hell is the most powerful genjutsu in Kuukoyo's arsenal. Compared to most of her other genjutsu, Eternal Hell is different because it remains unbroken as long as Kuukoyo decides to keep it up or the victim manages to gather enough willpower to break through the illusion.

Douko activates his Sharingan and covers his sword in a special chakra. He begins to slice around his opponent, creating pockets of chakra. As it begins to turn into total darkness, the pockets of chakra turn black and open into eyes, showing a Sharingan. The victim becomes shocked, and passes out.

The Demonic Illusion: Ethereal Body Imperial Sending is a boundary-dismantling technique developed by Princess Minabe.[citation needed] Upon kneading the chakra necessary to activate the technique, the user weaves a Seal of Confrontation and removes the boundaries between reality and illusion within their personal spac

Demonic Illusion: False Armament ---- The False Armament technique is a simple, yet useful, genjutsu in which the user creates the illusion that they (or someone else) are armed with a weapon when they, in fact, are not.

Demonic Illusion: False Being Technique {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=|image=Demonic Illusion False Being Technique.jpg |kanji=魔幻・居る非ずの術 |romaji=Magen: Oruazaru no Jutsu |literal english=Demonic Illusion: False Being Technique |english tv=Genjutsu: Sensory Delusory |other jutsu=Yes |related jutsu= |jutsu classificat

Demonic Illusion: False Surroundings Technique {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |tabber2=Yes |image1=False Surrondings 1.png |caption1=Those affected perceiving to be on the 3rd floor... |image2=False Surroundings 2.png |caption2=...but this a merely an illusion... |image3=False Surrondings 3.png |caption3=...as they are actually

A unique technique indeed. Soru's, Demonic Illusoin: Fear Incarnated is one that uses the targets own mind. Soru begins by casting an illusion that releases a special chemical in his targets brain. The chemical causes fear within the human body.
Shikadai fixates himself onto a single target, putting them under a genjutsu, in which the opponent experiences a very realistic feeling of sleep deprivation.
It is a Genjutsu created to affect the senses of the target, or their sensitivity. For instance, the user can manipulate the five senses of the target which are Sight, Hearing, Touch, Taste, Smell.
Kurenai traps the opponent in a flower bud and detonates it in a flowery explosion.

lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/flower_blade_gin: The Flower Blade Ginjutsu is a technique developed by Happosai Hanju. It is a Genjutsu technique that works off the sound of Happosai drawing and re-sheathing his sword. Before battle or in the middle of it Happosai will create hand seals for the Genjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/flower_ninja_art: Flower Ninja Art: Mirror Flower Water {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Flower Ninja Art Maximum Cutting.JPG |kanji=花忍法・強化裁 |romaji=Hana Ninpō: Kyōka Sai |english tv=Flower Ninja Art: Mirror Flower Water Move |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Flower Ninja Art |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/foreseeing_mind_: The Foreseeing Mind's Eye Technique is a jutsu created by Gen Nakaido due to his intrigue of the Sharingan. Takeru Higashiyama learned it later on due to his Yin-Yang Release training. This technique is a powerful skill and takes a lot of mental concentration and a large amount of chakra to initiate.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/forest_of_the_sh: This is the second technique the In'ei was able to develop, in which she creates a genjutsu world to trap the opponent inside. Her skill with it is proficient enough that she can change the shape, size and scope of the genjutsu world so that it could go from covering one person to an entire village.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/freezing_release: Doujinn sends his victim to an illusionary beautiful snowy mountain range. Then, the ground turns into ice and the victim is instantly frozen. In reality the victim was struck with Freezing Release chakra and are frozen.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/frost_release_ar: By focusing one's own flow of unto the palm of their hands, the user must then cross both arms towards the ground before even attempting to perform the said itself. Once performing the necessary , the said opponent will then become immediately trapped in a powerful .
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/frozen_inferno.d: An unique technique employed by Suisan Yuki, this jutsu allows the Death Guard member to trap for an indefinite amount of time someone inside an ice cube. He uses Yang Release to keep the victim alive, feeding him life saving energies and Yin Release to put him into a genjutsu, in order to keep his mind intact.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/futsunushi_ash.d: Futsunushi (経津主, Haven-Passing Lord) is the first of Kotoshiro's two Mangekyō Sharingan techniques... :More Coming Soon... *Futsunushi (経津主, Haven-Passing Lord) is a Shintō kami of Fire and Lightning, and is a general of Amaterasu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/gambit_zero.desc: This genjutsu was created by both Raido Uchiha and Takenshi Uchiha in order to discourage the use of genjutsu on each other.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/gedo_arts.desc: As a wielder of the Rinnegan, Raido benefits greatly from its abilities. In its own right it allows one to wield the Six Paths Technique, and other various advantages in battle. Raido however after studying in the shrine of the Sage, created a different style that uses the Rinnegans powers and abilities.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjitsumi.desc: This technique is considered the pinnacle of Genjutsu. It is the most dangerous Genjutsu that was used by Junsui. This technique ventures beyond the confines of Genjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu.desc: Genjutsu is one of the main categories of jutsu which use chakra. Genjutsu are employed in the same fashion as ninjutsu, however, the effects of genjutsu are not real, being only illusions experienced by those who fall victim to it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_amano_i: This technique requires the use of the Sharingan and direct eye contact. The opponent is trapped alone in an illusory dimension in which will be put face to face with an incomplete and shapeless version of the Sharingan wielder's Susanoo.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_barrier: Genjutsu Barrier Technique is technique utilized by Asuna Kurama to summon a that serves as a medium to cast . Upon forming the technique specific , the user is capable of conjuring an intangible barrier of varying radius; the size is entirely dependent on the chakra put into the technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_bell_cl: After the opponent has heard the sound of bells, the opponent begins hallucinating that the caster has the ability to duplicate themself causing confusion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_bell_so: Genjutsu: Bell Sound Clone {{JutsuInfobox |image=Bell Ring Genjutsu.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術·鈴音分身 |romaji=Genjutsu: Suzune Bunshin |literal english=Illusion Technique: Bell Sound Clone |jutsu classification=Genjutsu, Clone Techniques |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Mid |related jutsu=Genjutsu:
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_binding: Genjutsu Binding {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu Binding.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術縛り |romaji=Genjutsu Shibari |literal english=Illusion Technique Binding |english tv=Paralysis Genjutsu |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Game }
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_blood_r: The Genjutsu: Blood Release (幻術・血遁, Genjutsu: Ketton) is a technique of Muketsu's that enhances his already significant prowess within Genjutsu. By making contact with an enemy through one of the plethora of weapons he has available through his manipulation over blood, Muketsu can impart his own blood into an opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_blue_ro: This is a technique Ryūza created based off his love for blue roses. Ryūza begins by taking out one of the many blue roses he carries and tossing it at the opponent. All of the petals fly off the rose in a flurry and envelop the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_body_di: This technique is used to slow the target’s movements by placing them under a genjutsu that convinces them their brain is unable to properly send signals to the rest of their body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_burning: After performing the required hand seals, the user casts a powerful genjutsu that causes the target to perceive themselves as being completely surrounded by darkness. Moments later, a seemingly bottomless pit opens beneath their feet, causing them to fall into its depths.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_cloud.d: Developed by Izumi Ito in her time as ANBU, Genjutsu: Cloud has Izumi create an illusionary clone of herself to charge the opponent, which then explodes into a cloud that stays in battle. This is partly to distract the opponent, but also serves to obscure vision on the battlefield.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_communi: Genjutsu Communication {{JutsuInfobox |image1=Genjutsu Communication.png |caption1=The technique depicted in the manga. |image2=Genjutsu Communication Anime.png |caption2=The technique depicted in the anime. |tabber=Yes |named=Yes |kanji=幻術通信 |romaji=Genjutsu Tsūshin |literal english=Illusion Technique Communication |v
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_disinti: This genjutsu requires eye contact to be activated. The illusion traps the victim in a dark empty space where their body is made and begins to disintegrate from toe to head while the user is watching. The technique will make it harder for the target to move properly.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_dissipa: Genjutsu Dissipation {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Genjutsu Dissipation.png |kanji=幻術解 |romaji=Genjutsu Kai |english tv=Release |other names=Genjutsu: Release |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu class type=Supplementary |hand signs=Tiger or Clap Hands |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut=Naruto: A Shin
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_dragon_: Genjutsu: Dragon Assault is a genjutsu created by Agnihem that conjures an illusionary dragon that attacks the user's enemy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_dream.d: A Genjutsu that has two stages: 1.) If the user waves the Ram (Hitsuji) hand seal, similar to the Infinite Tsukuyomi, those under the influence of the Genjutsu: Yume will experience dream worlds where their deepest desires are fulfilled.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_endless: Genjutsu: Endless Storms is a powerful genjutsu performed with the Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu. This is one of the signature techniques used by Asana Uchiha.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_enter.d: Soru can enter another persons Genjutsu by inserting a bit of his own chakra into the targets brain. At first, it caused many to die from overload. But through careful practice and a mastery, Soru was even able to intercept powerful Genjutsu users and save many of his own men.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_eye_of_: This is one of Dezku's most powerful jutsu it is the only jutsu known that is able to intercept or cancel out the famous Uchiha Clan's Sharingan. If they are met with this genjutsu, reality for them will warp and bring forth their deepest fears to reality and it is deadly and has been known to kill.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_five_hu: A long-range defensive genjutsu cast through the Sharingan. The user projects hundreds of overlapping afterimages of their own chakra across the battlefield, creating the illusion that they exist in countless different locations at once.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_flash_b: This Genjutsu is activated after the opponent hears the sounds of bells. After this happens, the opponent begins imagining that the caster is moving at incredible speeds attacking them. In reality, the opponents reflexes are dulled due to the intense sound while the caster is moving at average speeds.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_flesh_d: The is a potent genjutsu originally created by and practiced by the members of the . Simple in execution, the only requirement is that the caster make contact with their target; from there, those affected are pulled into a genjutsu wherein the view their flesh rotting away.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_flower_: Genjutsu: Flower Petal Escape {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu Flower Petal Escape.png |unnamed=Yes |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |hand signs= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game }} When trapped inside of a genjutsu or wishing
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_galaxy_: This genjutsu makes the victim feel like he is getting sucked into a space-time rift, stuck floating in an inescapable portion of space. Because there is no air in space, their body will unintentionally choke itself to death. The jutsu can be broken if the user believes that it is all fake.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_ghost_f: Genjutsu: Ghost Fire {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu Ghost Fire.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術・燐火 |romaji=Genjutsu: Rinka |literal english=Illusion Technique: Ghost Fire |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Fire Release: Flint Yagura Technique |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |hand
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_hell_s_: Genjutsu: Hell's Kingdom this genjutsu makes the opponent seems as if the were in a demon world geting rip to Sherds by diffrent Demons.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_hypnoti: Hypnotic Influencer Is a Genjutsu that Shinobi with the Yin Release and Yang Release can use, it makes the opponent think that the user is someone they look up to and respect, someone like the hokage, the user won't turn into them but the opponent thinks they are that person, requires a low level genjutsu skill, using
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_inner_d: Genjutsu: Inner Demon Lust {| align=center style="background:transparent;" | valign=center | This article, , is property of Jumpy Naruto. |} Genjutsu: Inner Demon Lust (心テクニック：内面的な悪魔欲望) is a jutsu that is both a physical as well as mental attack.The user shoots a large flaming ball of fire at the opponent that resemble
Genjutsu: Kekkai is a kekkai jutsu technique used to erect a field of chakra around the user that is visible only to doujutsu. Once breached, the opponent is immediately trapped in a powerful, incredibly versatile genjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_ketsury: Genjutsu: Ketsuryūgan {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu_Ketsuryūgan.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術・血龍眼 |romaji=Genjutsu: Ketsuryūgan |game names=Illusion: Blood Dragon Eye |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu= |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |debut ani
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_killing: This genjutsu is created by casting a genjutsu while exuding pure killing intention, in a sense creating a more vivid and "malleable" version of the original skill. It is used primarily as a means to mentally torture the victim by showing them several ways the user might kill them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_kitsune: By looking the opponent in the eye while she is in her half transformation, Ayumi can trap the opponent into a genjutsu of her choosing. The genjutsu can have various effects ranging from simple paralyzation or knocking out the opponent to great psychological damage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_loony_t: This genjutsu was created by an unknown person, but he/she was assumed as genjutsu expert and had shown strong hints of being patient of asylum. Its effects on victims are similar to Multi-Personality Disorder, but in offensive version and with sinister twist.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_mangeky: Is the advanced version of Genjutsu: Sharingan, in which it it considered to be ten times more powerful than it's previous stature, instead deployed through the usage of the Mangekyō Sharingan.
Kurenai stands up straight with her head bowed and her hands to her chest. As she stomps on the ground, pink leaves surround her, and the area is enveloped in a pink mist. The opponent is confused as to where Kurenai went.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_mist.de: The user creates an illusionary clone that charges towards the opponent, jumps and then explodes in a cloud of cherry blossom petals.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_monochr: Upon eye contact, Asana activates her Mangekyō Sharingan and plunges the target’s perception into a black-and-white world — stripping away all color, warmth, and emotional resonance.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_mutual_: After letting himself get trapped in a Genjutsu, the user with a simple gesture of the hand casts this technique, while in the illusion world; which by some means correlates to them activating this technique in the real world.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_one_tho: One Thousand Deaths is a dangerous genjutsu capable of inflicting a tremendous amount of pain and suffering. With this jutsu it's possible to make the target suffer the pains from several ways of dying in only a blink of an eye, making it somewhat similar to Tsukuyomi.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_pleasur: Using her Sharingan, Niyo entraps her opponent through eye contact. With the genjutsu, the opponent's negative and hostile feelings towards Niyo are rewired into pure admiration and love for her. After gaining the trust of her enemies, Niyo can then execute them when she pleases.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_protect: Genjutsu Protect {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu barricades.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術プロテクト |romaji=Genjutsu Purotekuto |literal english=Illusion Technique Protect |english tv=Genjutsu Block |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime,
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_rinnega: Using their Rinnegan, the user is able to cast a genjutsu strong enough to take control of the nine tailed beasts simultaneously. Unlike other genjutsu, this technique apparently does not subdue the mind of the victim.

Genjutsu: Rinnegan is a Dōjutsu of the Rinnegan and a much more powerful version of the Genjutsu: Sharingan. It can only be used by those who have awakend their Rinnegan from the Sharingan (people with implanted Rinnegan are unable to use it).

Using his Rinnegan, is able to cast a genjutsu strong enough to take control of the nine tailed beasts simultaneously. Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki stated that Sasuke can use this technique through a single glance. Unlike other genjutsu, this technique apparently does not subdue the mind of the victim.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_sadisti: After looking directly at Raygen's eyes, everything around you will turn black and you'll be strapped on a wall full with rusty spikes. Raygen will ask you a couple of questions or force you to confess.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_seigaio: Genjutsu: Seigaio is the generic use of genjutsu employed by wielders of the Seigaio. By making direct eye contact with someone, the user is able to trap them inside of a genjutsu of their own choosing to achieve different effects.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_seigan_: The user of this threads a hallucinatory world of swords and mechanical gears, making it seem as if the one who executed the had just transported their opponent to another dimension altogether.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_self_co: Genjutsu: Self-Concealment is a special Genjutsu created by Nisshou Fuyutama in order to hide in plain sight. The technique is always active and is unique in that it is able to fool even the Sharingan. It allows the caster to mask their appearance from all those who observe them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_shadowe: Genjutsu: Shadowed Moon: the user affects everyone nearby. Learned from rank 3.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_sharing: Genjutsu: Sharingan {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Genjutsu Sharingan.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術・写輪眼 |romaji=Genjutsu: Sharingan |literal english=Illusion Technique: Copy Wheel Eye |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu= |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive, Supplementary |jutsu range=

This technique is exclusive to Keiji Kunitsu, it involves trapping the opponent in a Genjutsu world and siphoning their chakra. While their chakra is being used for the Genjutsu the user activates a secondary technique placed inside the Genjutsu to siphon the opponents' chakra supply.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_starry_: By gathering chakra in two points of the body, both thumbs, and touching the opponent with both thumbs, Ikido can cast a Genjutsu on his opponent. Once in the Genjutsu, it is difficult to escape by one's self, of course unless this person has amazing chakra control and can sense Genjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_sylph.d: Genjutsu: Sylph a unique method of using Genjutsu developed and used by Akari Murakami. It allows her to trap any who come into contact with one of her Wind Release techniques to be trapped in a Genjutsu of her choosing.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_tenseig: This is an advance genjutsu as employed by Tenseigan wielders. After establishing direct eye contact with the user's opponent/opponents, the user can cast a genjutsu strong enough to control all nine-tail beast along with their jinchūriki completely controlling them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_the_lab: This is an illusion technique associated with the Kazahan Clan. Using this genjutsu, the user creates a mental trap within the victim’s mind in the form of a vast labyrinth of mirrors. The technique begins by creating a disturbing reflection that the victim briefly catches sight of.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_the_sou: Genjutsu: The Sound of Drums is another of Kisui's Rinnegan techniques. By activating the genjutsu via eye contact, the victim's mind begins repeating a simple pattern. Four drum beats in a second by second loop, constantly repeating in their mind.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_torture: This Genjutsu was developed by Zetsumei to damage his enemies brain. He uses it at most of his battles. When he battled Ryuujin Entenka, he used this Genjutsu but failed because it was backfired by Ryuujin's left eye.
lang.ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_trappin: Takara summons a large pink, translucent flower under the opponent that compresses them inside before exploding.
