lang.ability.narutorpg.smell_sphere.desc: The user spits out a purple breath-sphere which forcefully explodes into a stinking cloud, covering a wide area. Anyone who comes in contact with the gas gets paralysed for a short while.
lang.ability.narutorpg.smoke_clone.desc: This technique allows the user to create a clone made out of smoke. When it is hit, it reverts back into smoke.
lang.ability.narutorpg.smoke_dragon.desc: By unleashing a continuous stream of smoke from his wrist launcher, Kihō can use his chakra to shape the smoke into the form of a dragon linked to his wrist launcher. This gives him the advantage of short range attacks, and because the dragon is completely composed of smoke, physical attacks are useless against it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.snake_charmer_techniqu: Orochimaru opens his mouth, letting out a giant snake that slithers its way towards the opponent and rams them. When the snake stops its attack, it dissolves back into Orochimaru.
Using snakes as a catalyst, the user can create a clone of themselves or objects that function similarly to shadow clones. When dealt sufficient damage the clone will revert back into snakes. The snakes can also be used to enter areas that they might find difficult to access otherwise.
lang.ability.narutorpg.snake_jutsu.desc: Snake , also known as , are residents of the Ryūchi Cave that are the signature summons of Orochimaru, his assistant, Kabuto Yakushi, and his students: Sasuke Uchiha and Anko Mitarashi.
lang.ability.narutorpg.snake_mouth_bind.desc: The user traps the opponent and himself in the mouth of a snake. The snake's stomach is very elastic-like as it could even withstand Gamabunta, a creature of similar size, being summoned within it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.snake_mouth_poison_mis: Using his snake-tail, Kabuto sprays a venomous cloud on the opponent, which causes devastating effects when inhaled by the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.snake_reconnection_tec: If Orochimaru is bisected by an opponent, snakes are able to emerge from both halves of his body and pull him back together, seemingly undoing the damage he sustained.
lang.ability.narutorpg.snake_skin_sword_strok: Kabuto slashes his opponent with a chakra scalpel, followed by three strikes with his navel tail.
lang.ability.narutorpg.snake_spying_technique: The user links with their summoned snake to access their point of view, seeing and hearing everything around them. It allows for more discreet surveillance and intel gathering.
lang.ability.narutorpg.snake_steel_net.desc: After using the Summoning: Dual-Headed Snakes, snakes emerge from the summoned snakes mouths in order of two's and from those ones others are summoned through the mouths in a continuous order in an attempt to capture their target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.snake_wild_strike.desc: Anko rushes her target with a series of slashes with a twin-knee-leap in-between followed by another slash into a kunai reap, then finishes by releasing snakes from both wrists.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soap_bubble_ninjutsu.d: Soap Bubble Ninjutsu is a branch of ninjutsu from the of the Water Release nature transformation.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soap_bubble_slime.desc: Utakata blows bubbles, which release a sticky slime when popped, delaying or trapping an opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soaring_bird_crusher.d: Sasuke hits the opponent under the chin with the hilt of his sword. Then he kicks them thrice sending them further into the air. As the opponent plummets to the ground, Sasuke appears where they are about to fall and hits them powerfully in the gut, sending them crashing into whatever's on the way.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soaring_shine_falling_: Fū blinds her opponent with scale powder, grabs them, flies them up in the air, and throws them back down at the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soaring_strings.desc: Kagura shoots numerous knives attached to chakra strings from the ground, like a geyser.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soaring_swallow_steppi: Fū jumps up into the air, slashes her opponent with a kunai, damages her opponent while spinning, and finishes by landing on top of them with both feet.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soft_neck_throw.desc: Orochimaru lengthens his neck and thrusts his head towards the opponent's neck and latches on with a bite. He then throws them behind him with his mouth.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soft_physique_modifica: Before this technique can be performed, the user's body must first be modified to increase its flexibility and elasticity. Once this is done, the user can stretch and bend their body however and whenever they please, extending it to great lengths and retracting it again.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sonic_blast.desc: Dosu grabs the opponent by the throat, releasing a small amount of sound from his device, disorienting them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sonic_shock.desc: Dosu slams the ground hard, releasing sonic waves that paralyse anyone caught in the attack's range and cracking the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soshuga.desc: Sōshūga is the name of a fighting style employing a pair of by Might Guy. Guy wields these with great dexterity, utilising all of his limbs at times, making use of them particularly during situations where direct physical contact must be avoided.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soul_hunting.desc: Soul Hunting #The first, shown in Naruto Shippūden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 2, is of Hidan slashing the opponent with his Triple-Bladed Scythe in a combo.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soulbane.desc: A powerful genjutsu known to be forbidden among the Konohagakure ninja. It targets the mind and causes the target to believe that anyone is a foe. While under the effects of the genjutsu, anyone affected will attack those who they believe to be enemies, even their closest friends.
lang.ability.narutorpg.soulbody_separation_te: With the aid of a tag, the user creates a seal which affects a certain area around it removing the soul of the target from its body. The soul is sealed within the tag. If someone comes in contact with the tag or removes it from its place, the soul will be released.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sound_four_s_cursed_se: Each member of the Sound Four uses a cursed seal. Their seals, however, are not as powerful as the Heaven and Earth seals, although they have similar end results.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sound_four_summoning_f: The Sound Four summons each of their respective summons to barricade their opponents. While the Triple Rashōmon makes escape difficult, the Doki and Earth Prison Golem attack from the front, while Kyodaigumo attacks from above.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sound_wave_technique.d: A technique that allows the user to create a burst of sound waves that upsurge from around their vicinity. This technique was strong enough to not only destroy Orochimaru's lab, but also subdue two Anbu members.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spacetime_ninjutsu_god: Minato throws a Flying Thunder God Kunai at his opponent, hitting them, and then teleports behind them to stab them again.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spacetime_spiralling_s: Minato teleports towards the opponent in a zig-zag manner, and hits them with a large Rasengan in each hand.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spacetime_technique_fo: The Space–Time Technique Formula: Underworld Turnover was a technique designed by Orochimaru for the sole purpose of revenge. It was utilised by the reincarnated Sound Four releasing their hatred within their cursed seals.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spear_attack_shining_h: Using its foremost horn, Chōmei attacks its opponent. Sending the reeling with such force that the victim is left incapacitated by the wind force, unable to react to either protect or defend themselves.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spear_of_heaven_nine_t: After bathing in Ama no Hoko, the Nine-Tailed Naruto Clone's abilities were magnified and it could fire powerful purplish-orange chakra beams from its dragon/snake-like heads.
lang.ability.narutorpg.special_attack_rasenga: Naruto punches the opponent to the ground and creates two clones as one forms a weaker Rasengan in the other's hand that the clone strikes the opponent with.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spider_bind.desc: Kidōmaru spits a web of threads from his mouth, the web's size being adjusted depending on how far away his targets are and how many he intends to trap. On contact, the web pushes targets away from Kidōmaru and wraps around them, trapping them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spider_cocoon.desc: Kidōmaru imprisons a target in a cocoon of spider threads. Because of how tightly around the target the spider threads are stretched, they are unable to move once they've been trapped. Kidōmaru can further constrict the threads by flowing additional chakra into them, to the point of ultimately strangling the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spider_drop.desc: Kidōmaru spews rope made of webs, which he uses to swing around the area.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spider_scatter_techniq: Kidōmaru summons a horde of small spiders to crawl towards his opponent and attack them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spider_sticking_spit.d: Kidōmaru spits a thick rope of webbing from his mouth at a target. The rope is very sticky because of all the webs that are layered together, which Kidōmaru can further increase (or decrease) the stickiness of by altering how much chakra flows into the rope.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spider_sticky_gold.des: Kidōmaru produces a golden metallic substance within his body, which he can gather in his mouth like saliva or secrete from his pores like sweat. It is very malleable when first created, but once it makes contact with the air it hardens rapidly, becoming as strong as steel.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spider_war_bow_terribl: Kidōmaru first creates a war bow by carefully expelling Spider Sticky Gold from his mouth. With it he is able to fire arrows, using his body's eight limbs to boost the bow's tension beyond what normal people are capable of.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spider_web_area.desc: Kidōmaru spreads a network of "touch threads" throughout an area. Kidōmaru constantly sends his chakra along the threads, allowing him to sense anything that comes into contact with them; the threads are sensitive enough to even detect slight disturbances in the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spider_web_flower.desc: Kidōmaru spits several small nets from his mouth at a target or targets; the nets' small size means they can be produced rapidly, increasing his chances of striking his target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spider_web_unrolling.d: Kidōmaru creates a ball of thread which he then expands into a large web using his six arms. He most often uses this while he's in the air, allowing the web to spread over a wide area. Approaching enemies are usually caught off guard by the technique and end up suspended in place by it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spike_rain.desc: The user throws several Spike Bombs at their opponents, their detonation covering a wide area.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiked_human_bullet_ta: This is an enhanced version of the Akimichi clan's Human Bullet Tank. The user first wraps ropes around themselves that have kunai attached to them. Once this is done, they use the Multi-Size Technique and perform the Human Bullet Tank as normal.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spindle_formation.desc: The user has their bugs attack the target in a spiralling motion in order to stop the enemy from retaliating.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spinning_snake_thorn.d: After using Summoning: Dual-Headed Snakes and merging with them by using the Chimera Technique, the user can fire spinning projectiles from the snake's mouths that have explosive impact.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spinning_top_swing.des: Naruto jumps mid-air, creates a shadow clone, and each take turns delivering hits to the opponent, the momentum of their spinning keeping them in the air until the last hit is landed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiral_boruto_storm.de: Boruto creates a shadow clone and delivers a few strikes to his opponent, putting some distance between them. The shadow clone creates a Vanishing Rasengan, and Boruto grabs the clone by the hand, spinning it to create momentum. Boruto lets go of the clone, and the clone throws the Rasengan, giving it more speed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiral_lotus.desc: This technique is exactly like the Front Lotus except Naruto gives it another name when he uses it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiralling_absorption_: Naruto uses his chakra arms while within Nine-Tails Chakra Mode to form a Big Ball Rasengan in his hand, then throws it above his back. He then uses extra chakra arms to grab and smash enemies into the sphere, simulating an "absorption" of the victims into the Rasengan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiralling_bullet.desc: The user gathers chakra with two fingers to condense it into a small Rasengan. It can be shot from a distance at the target and move a blazing speed. To which, it has immense penetrative power, throwing its target off their feet even after piercing through them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiralling_combo.desc: Momoshiki fires three small Rasengan bullets at the opponent, doing more damage than a singular bullet.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiralling_flash_super: This technique was devised by Minato Namikaze and employs the use of the Flying Thunder God Technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiralling_great_fire_: Naruto creates a Rasengan, Sasuke breathes Fire Release: Great Fireball into it. Naruto then slams the flame-covered Rasengan into the opponent which erupts into a fiery blast.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiralling_ring.desc: Menma creates a dark purple Rasengan-like orb of chakra surrounded by a series of white rings of chakra that orbit the main sphere. These rings then align into one disc-like shape around the orb, causing the rings to resemble planetary rings. It matches Naruto's Sage Mode Wind Release: Rasenshuriken in power.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiralling_serial_sphe: The Spiralling Serial Spheres is a double-handed version of the regular Rasengan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiralling_strife_sphe: Naruto, while in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, uses a chakra arm to form multiple Rasengan above his head. He then uses additional arms to hold the Rasengan and hit multiple opponents simultaneously.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spiralling_tower_techn: This technique is devised by Kakashi Hatake as a way to reach 200 kilometres above Konohagakure. His original idea is to create an Earth-Style Wall to reach that altitude, but he doesn't believe he would have enough chakra to make it tall enough. For this reason he recruits Yamato to assist him.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spirit_foot.desc: Shizune spins around and kicks her opponent sending them flying backwards.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spirit_reflection_tech: Malice takes a shinobi's chakra and imbues a puppet with it, creating a perfect copy of the shinobi. These puppets are granted any weapons, techniques, and bloodline techniques they may have. Malice is able to control the puppets from very long distances and without the use of chakra threads.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spirit_transformation_: Dan's soul leaves his body, and enters the body of his opponent. Inside, it destroys their opponent's soul before returning to Dan's body.

This highly versatile technique allows the user's spirit to leave their body. By taking possession of a target, the spirit can suppress and collapse the victim's spirit, killing them, or freely manipulate their actions. This technique can also be used to communicate information or transfer chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spontaneous_tree_summo: A last resort technique which doesn't require hand seals. Using their own cells as a medium, the user creates an entire tree from their body at the cost of a large amount of chakra. In doing so, it can alter the trajectory of incoming attacks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.spore_technique.desc: White Zetsu is able to plant spore-sized parasite clones onto the bodies of others for the purpose of remotely monitoring them. As these clones parasitise their victim's chakra and have no chakra of their own, they cannot be detected by standard sensory abilities.
lang.ability.narutorpg.stagnate_snake_confine: Kabuto expels four white snakes from his mouth on the field, which is stepped on, will have numerous snakes swarm on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.stake_chains.desc: Obito delivers a series of strikes to the opponent with a combination of Kamui, a shuriken and Wood Release: Cutting Technique. Then he creates black receivers which rain on the opponent. Finally, Obito uses Demonic Statue Chains to pick up the stakes and smash them to the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.starch_syrup_binding_r: After kneading chakra in the stomach and converting it to high-viscosity water, the user spits it out, in the form of ropes that restrains the target's movement. Because of the viscosity of the water, it is even more difficult for them to escape its confines.
lang.ability.narutorpg.starch_syrup_gun.desc: The user kneads chakra, along with natural energy and then converts it into large amount of high-viscosity water within their mouth before spitting it outward with an incredible amount of force.
lang.ability.narutorpg.stealth_snake_hand.des: Kabuto lands a series of attacks with snakes and chakra scalpels, before burrowing underground and rising out for a snake-based uppercut.
lang.ability.narutorpg.steam_dash.desc: After increasing their chakra temperature to its boiling point, the user releases boiling steam from their body, after which, they dash straight at the opponent in a straight line, taking the similar approach to a locomotive and creating sounds, which are similar to the ones made by a steam whistle.
lang.ability.narutorpg.steaming_danger_tyrann: The Steaming Danger Tyranny is Gengetsu Hōzuki's .
The user uses Steaming Danger Tyranny, which is capable of forming an axe on one of its hands. The axe can be used for combat purposes.
Gengetsu creates a Steaming Danger Tyranny that body slams the opponent, creating an explosion of steam.
lang.ability.narutorpg.steel_blades_technique: When using this technique, steel blades begin to grow from the ground, which rush into the heights in wave-like movements, growing like tree branches, piercing everyone who gets in the way.
lang.ability.narutorpg.steel_release_impervio: This technique allows the user to turn their body into jet-black steel. Hiruko states that blades do not affect him at all due to this ability, which is demonstrated when Sai's tantō snapped clean in half on impact.
lang.ability.narutorpg.steel_release_steel_pr: The user creates a ball made out of steel. The projectile can be launched a considerable distance at the target, inflicting heavy blunt damage. When in unison with Lava Release, which can melt the steel, it changes into a spiralling-like shape.
lang.ability.narutorpg.steel_release_steel_sh: The user raises a steel shield from the ground, in the form of a defensive wall. The shield is strong enough to ward off large amounts of sand bullets.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sticky_bite.desc: Transformed as Saiken, Utakata bites and chews his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.stomach_reflection.des: Shukaku feigns sleep while the opponent rushes to attack it, only for Shukaku's stomach to bounce the opponent back.
lang.ability.narutorpg.stone_pillar_destructi: Based on the terrain she is in, Sakura will use her enhanced strength to break off a large column of stone and throw it at the opponent. She can also place explosive tags on the column.
lang.ability.narutorpg.storm_release_azure_ea: Darui generates beams of energy that strike the opponent, then jumps and delivers a sword strike with his electricity-charged blade.
lang.ability.narutorpg.storm_release_black_hu: Seemingly using the manoeuvrability of his Storm Release: Laser Circus technique, but employing the use of black lightning instead of normal lightning, Darui sends out several panthers which are guided towards the opponent, slashing them as they pass.
lang.ability.narutorpg.storm_release_laser_ci: This technique creates several beams and shoots them at the enemy. First, a halo of bright energy spreads around the user's hands as this technique is activated, then it encircles the user's hand and from that, the beams are shot out towards the enemy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.storm_release_secret_t: Hiruko uses the Storm Release kekkei genkai he acquired through his Chimera Technique to produce a massive thunder cloud capable of infinitely absorbing chakra to grow in size, strength and ferocity. The amount of chakra it receives will also increase.
lang.ability.narutorpg.storm_release_thunder_: Hiruko uses Storm Release to generate a thick ring of thunderclouds and electricity around him, creating an offensive and defensive ward. He can then use these clouds to fire powerful blasts of lightning at his enemies, and as an electrified perimeter; effectively preventing his enemies from getting close.
lang.ability.narutorpg.strange_mask_exploding: By having his fire and wind masks merge, with or without him, Kakuzu has them combine their fire and wind attacks to create a powerful blast of intense fire. Kakashi remarked that water alone wasn't enough to put it out. It took the effort of a wind-enhanced water technique to fully counter it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.strange_transmission_d: Through an application of Sakon's kekkei genkai, Kabuto is able to use the techniques of anyone whose cells are integrated into his body, including even kekkei genkai and hiden techniques.
lang.ability.narutorpg.strength_of_a_hundred_: The Strength of a Hundred Seal is a jutsu from the Sage of Six Paths era, that requires extremely delicate chakra control.
lang.ability.narutorpg.strengthening_prescrip: The was a dark medical ninjutsu that Yomi's clan had spent generations to perfect just for the night of releasing Mōryō's spirit in the Land of Demons.
lang.ability.narutorpg.string_bean_binding_il: A typical technique amongst the members of the Kurama clan. The illusion shows the user disappear before the opponent is surrounded by several bean vines that bind their body and lift them into the air. A bean pod then rises from the ground which opens to reveal the user, ready to strike.
lang.ability.narutorpg.string_light_formation: This barrier is designed to prevent anyone from leaving its confines. Once within a certain range of the target, the user erects the barrier underfoot, rendering anyone within the seal formula incapable of escaping.
lang.ability.narutorpg.strong_fist.desc: Strong Fist is Guy's and Lee's characteristic fighting style, the purpose of which is to cause external damage and break bones. It is the exact opposite of Gentle Fist which is used mainly by the Hyūga Clan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.strong_spear_tree.desc: Hashirama will form the required hand seal and create two tendrils that emerge from the ground and shoot towards the opponent intertwining with one another before piercing through the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.strong_sword_helmet_br: Hashirama further enhances his chakra enhanced sword, increasing its size. Then, he delivers a straight slash into the ground, dealing a great damage to the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.student_and_teacher_ra: A cooperation ninjutsu used by two Rasengan users, one of whom was the teacher of the Rasengan to the other. They each perform a Rasengan next to each other, and strike together at their opponent, causing twice the damage of what a single Rasengan would do.
lang.ability.narutorpg.substitute_technique.d: The Substitute Technique is a technique unique to White Zetsu. It allows him to assume the identity of any individual for a variety of purposes: though similar in nature to the standard Transformation Technique, it boasts far greater utility.
lang.ability.narutorpg.successive_shots_iron_: Shinki uses his Iron Sand to shoot a multitude of skewer-like projectiles in rapid succession. Being that it is a widespread attack, it is especially effective against multiple opponents.
lang.ability.narutorpg.successive_shots_sand_: Gaara rapidly fires bullet-like sand at the opponent to take them down in one swift motion.
After creating a shadow clone, it will then ingest some explosive clay and explode, creating a diversion that can be used to escape. With a "suicide bombing announcement" the enemy's wariness is heightened and this opportunity is used to switch places with a shadow clone.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sukunahikona.desc: Sukunahikona is a Kokugan technique. It allows the caster to instantaneously shrink themselves or any nonliving matter within their field of vision (or return the same to full size) at will.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sukunahikona_canopy_bo: As Jigen, Isshiki sends the opponent to another dimension, attacks them, and pins them in stakes as he summons a large cube to slam down on them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sukunahikona_chaos_blo: Kawaki slams his hand on the grow, growing numerous stakes around him, as well as larger stakes, damaging at opponent that is near him.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sukunahikona_god_hunte: Kawaki shrinks himself and rushes towards the opponent, returning to full size and punches them with his transformed fist.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sukunahikona_instant_a: The user shrinks themselves to evade their enemy’s sight in order to perform a sneak attack. Due to the speed at which the user shrinks and enlarge, the technique had been mistaken for teleportation.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sukunahikona_mighty_th: Kawaki shrinks himself and appears in front of the opponent, showering down a barrage of rods on them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sukunahikona_rain_of_e: In the air, Isshiki brings out a large bundle of rods, which he separates and showers down in the surrounding area. Isshiki can use the scattered rods to track down a target if the Byakugan's chakra sensing is impaired.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sukunahikona_rapid_suc: The user fires formerly shrunken black rods as projectiles towards the enemy. The speed they can be fired is so fast that even the Sharingan cannot detect them in time, only a feat that Baryon Mode had been able to accomplish.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sukunahikona_scale_fra: Kawaki places shrunken fragments of his altered skin around his opponent and restores them to full size to converge on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_blue_snake_r: Sasuke summons Aoda, who circles around him and spins around, preventing the opponents from approaching.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_crushing_toa: This technique bares some similarity to the Summoning: Toad Mouth Bind technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_demonic_stat: Summoning: Demonic Statue of the Outer Path is a technique used through the power of the Rinnegan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_dual_headed_: The user summons a double-headed, snake-like creature to attack their enemies.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_earth_releas: When, for whatever reason, the user cannot find a target, they use this technique to summon a pack of ninken underground. The ninken use their superior sense of smell to track the target, converge on their location, and then all together burst from the ground and take hold with their fangs.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_fan_dance_dr: After summoning Kamatari, Temari spins it with the kama. It slams the opponent into a giant rock, which splits apart and falls on the opponent like an avalanche.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_fiddler_crab: Tenma summons scissor-like pincers from a scroll that he uses in conjunction with taijutsu. The pincers are very strong, able to cleave clean through solid metal.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_food_cart_de: The user summons a toad in the air, which falls to the ground. On impact, the ground shakes, structures are destroyed, and the user's targets are pinned beneath the toad's weight, preventing them from moving.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_giant_clam_b: Gengetsu summons the giant clam, which creates a mirage of two additional clams surrounding the opponent, leaving Gengetsu to shoot the trapped opponent, creating a large vortex of water.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_ibuse.desc: Hanzō summons Ibuse, who creates a poison cloud in the general area in front of it, poisoning his opponent in it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_ibuse_poison: Ibuse gets out of the ground under the feet of the target and swallows them, poisoning them with poisonous gas inside his body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_impure_world: The Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation is a jutsu that binds the soul of a deceased person to a living vessel, restoring them as they were in the last moments of their lives in order to do their summoner's bidding. It was originally created by Tobirama Senju, some time after which he declared it a kinjutsu.
Orochimaru summons the reincarnated Hashirama and Tobirama, having them use their elemental dragon techniques to attack the opponent.
Ibiki summons a giant iron maneki neko, which appears beneath the opponent from underground, split down the middle. The statue clamps around the target and is then wrapped in chains, which drag it back down into the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_kamatari.des: Temari summons Kamatari, which swirls around her to create a whirlwind that slices any opponents in her vincinity.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_katsuyu.desc: The user briefly summons Katsuyu, which sprays acid at the opponent in front of it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_lightning_fl: This is a special "ninja tool summon" that allows the user to seal ninja tools like swords or kunai into a scroll or their clothes beforehand, allowing them to be called upon when needed. The ninja tools can be summoned in an instant just by touching the sealing "marks" which can be drawn anywhere.
Rin quickly performs a few hand seals, then summons a large rolling log which slams all opponents that are within a short distance in front of her.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_nine_tails.d: The user summons Kurama, who they have under their control, to blast the opponent with the Tailed Beast Ball.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_quick_behead: Temari uses her Giant Folding Fan to create a whirlwind that is powerful enough to travel several hundred metres. As she swings the fan, which has previously been smeared with her blood, she summons Kamatari, which travels upon the winds and rapidly cuts through everything in its path.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_quintuple_ra: While one is already boasted as an absolute defense, the user — without the need of hand seals — instantly summons five Rashōmon gates to neutralise incoming attacks. The user can alter the positioning of all five gates, even if it is to change the trajectory of an attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_rainwater_ga: A form of summoning technique, bringing forth a single gate sturdy enough to withstand a taijutsu-attack by Rock Lee. However, an explosive tag from behind is able to destroy the gate.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_rashomon.des: The user summons a large gate; Sakon and Ukon can only summon it together. The gate itself is designed to look frightening, with the gate's doors having a demonic face upon them; this is to intimidate onlookers, potentially warding them off.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_rashomon_hel: Sakon and Ukon separate and use a combined Summoning Technique to summon the Rashōmon flat on the ground. The demonic gate then opens and swallows the opponent into another dimension.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_rinnegan.des: Through the power of the Animal Path, the user is able to summon people and animals which will come to possess copies of the Rinnegan. As with the Six Paths of Pain and the King of Hell, animals summoned through this technique are visually linked to the user's own Rinnegan, offering them a greater field of view.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_technique.de: The Summoning Technique allows the user to transport a target, most frequently an animal familiar, to their location.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_technique_fa: Nagato summons a giant panda, which drops directly on top of his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_ten_tails.de: Obito slams his right hand to the ground, creating a summoning symbol to call Ten-Tails. The Ten-Tails' fist will then burst from under the ground a short distance in front of Obito, striking the opponent. As the rest of the incomplete Ten-Tails surfaces, Obito stands upon its head, ordering it to attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_toad_mouth_b: Unlike the usual practice of summoning an entire creature, the user instead summons only the oesophagus of a giant toad from . The oesophagus is summoned around a target; if this is done inside a cave or some other structure, it's possible the target will not even notice.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_toad_shop_te: This technique summons a from Mount Myōboku. This toad has the ability to transform into a building and with their chakra, the user gives the building a design they imagined themselves. The target is then lured inside, for example, with the promise of cheap drinks.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_torture_cham: This technique is used by Ibiki to summon an iron torture chamber around himself and the opponent. First, the enemy's arms and legs are captured by four chains, and then the walls of the cage appear flat on the ground, quickly folding together to box them in.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_triple_rasho: The Summoning: Triple Rashōmon is an upgrade to the standard Summoning: Rashōmon, which — as its name suggests — summons not one, but three menacing Rashōmon. The technique requires two summoning seals to be completed, and these gates serve the same function as the single Rashōmon, but with triple the defence.
lang.ability.narutorpg.summoning_true_fire_of: The user summons fire from the Flaming Mountains. Because they're naturally-occurring, physical flames, instead of being chakra-based, Kāma cannot absorb them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_beast_flying_com: Sai creates an ink hawk with Naruto riding high in the air and him and some shadow clones drop down on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_beast_flying_ham: Yamato strikes the opponent with a wooden pillar where Sai's ink hawks attack the opponent in the air and Yamato slams the opponent to the ground with another wooden pillar.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_beast_imitating_: The Super Beast Imitating Drawing is a technique that allows the user to animate ink drawings, which act upon the user's will.
Sai uses his Super Beast Imitating Drawing to create dozens of lions which shower down on the opponent. He then creates a giant dragon, finishing them off.

While flying in the air above the opponent on his ink hawk, Sai uses his Super Beast Imitating Drawing to have multiple ink creatures descend upon the opponent and attack them. He then dives down himself and slashes them with his tantō.
Sai enlarges and unrolls the giant scroll with an image of a dragon that he summons to carry his opponent into the air and slam them into the scroll which the dragon itself submerges in.
Sai creates several ink birds from his scroll to attack his opponent.

Sai uses his Super Beast Imitating Drawing to create three lions and a large hawk. The lions hit the opponent rapidly and send them upward, where the hawk waits and fires a barrage of razor sharp ink feathers at the opponent, covering them in ink and sending them crashing into the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_compression_rase: With Mitsuki's addition of senjutsu chakra and Sarada adding to the force of impact, Boruto's Compression Rasengan's compression and power is increased. Their combined might makes it possible to overcome the near-impervious defences, like Deepa's Carbon Armour.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_excellent_hyper_: Potcha and Mondai put on their football helmets and charge at the enemy with a high speed. The attack resembles Passing Fang, though it is unknown how much damage it causes, since it was only used once and was halted by Lee and Guy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_fang_wolf_fang.d: Man and beast transform into a single two-headed gigantic animal by the Human Beast Combination Transformation: Double-Headed Wolf technique, and just like its parent technique, have their body spin in a violent assault against the enemy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_god_imitating_dr: The Super God Imitating Drawing is a technique usable by those who have mastered the Super Beast Imitating Drawing.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_human_bullet_tan: Chōji jumps into the air where he performs his Super Multi-Size Technique, followed by an enormous Human Bullet Tank to slam into his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_inner_sakura.des: Sakura does a sequence of punches and then she strikes her opponent with a powerful punch that sends them flying. After this, she makes a rapid combo of punches and finishes with a strike with her knee and a powerful kick.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_light_foot.desc: Minato dashes towards his opponent and kicks them on the knee. He then slides behind them and kicks the same knee again in such a way that the opponent fly into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_mini_tailed_beas: While in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, Naruto gathers and balances the necessary black and white chakra to form a condensed, miniaturised Tailed Beast Ball. Upon impact, the ball explodes resulting in a very sizeable blast radius. As with the Rasengan, he can extend the ball forward with the use of a chakra arm.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_multi_size_techn: This is a heightened version of the Akimichi clan's Multi-Size Technique. It is essentially the same as the base version, though the user becomes significantly larger, on a scale comparable to a mountain.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_open_hand_slap.d: After using the Multi-Size Technique to increase their size, the user funnels chakra into their hands, which causes special markings to appear on them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_pressure.desc: While in his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto delivers a series of punches to the opponent before kicking them upwards into the air, and falling down with them via a downwards punch.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_revival_fist.des: The Super Revival Fist is the ultimate technique derived from dark chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_tailed_beast_big: Naruto enters his Nine-Tails Chakra Mode's Tailed Beast form, then proceeds to create nine separate Tailed Beast Ball Rasenshuriken within each of his tails, using the elemental properties of Magnet, Fire, Water, Lava, Boil and Wind Release, as well as Tailed Beast chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.super_ultra_big_ball_r: The Super-Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan is an even more powerful version of the Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan. The impact of this technique can carve a huge crater on the ground. In the anime, its strength was enough to uproot trees in its near vicinity.
lang.ability.narutorpg.superb_turn.desc: Deidara creates two small birds out of clay and they fly towards the opponent and explode. These knock targets back a long distance, and can ricochet off walls.
lang.ability.narutorpg.supercooled_water_tech: The user employs Water Release and Wind Release to create supercooled water. The user can also create weapons out of the frozen water. With enough mastery, the use of Wind Release to supercool the water can be dispensed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.supervibrato_lightning: Supervibrato Lightning Release Swords is a form of chakra flow used by Killer B, often alongside his signature kenjutsu and his preferred blades.
lang.ability.narutorpg.supreme_ultimate_rasen: Naruto merges his Rasengan with Minato's to create a Rasengan that drills through the opponent, causing massive damage. The Supreme Ultimate Rasengan, like the Tornado Rasengan, has several streams of chakra spiralling around the centre, but it has far more streams, completely covering the users' bodies.
lang.ability.narutorpg.surging_fire_wild_danc: This technique is a barrage of taijutsu attacks. The user first attacks their opponent with a kick, which is immediately followed by a punch and another kick from the opposite leg.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo.desc: Susanoo is the strongest ability available to those who have awakened the Mangekyō Sharingan in both eyes, having been passed down through the Uchiha Clan's generations. It manifests as a gigantic, humanoid avatar made of the user's chakra, which surrounds them and fights on their behalf.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_attack.desc: Sasuke lands a punch, followed by a few sword slashes, a kick, and a few more sword slashes before manifesting a Susanoo arm to punch his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_blade_of_yachi: While in his Susanoo, Merz uses Yachihoko to gather chakra from all those who were under the effect of the Engraved Tsukuyomi to increase the size of his sword.
Sasuke grabs his opponent using his Susanoo's hand, and slashes them with his sword.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_chidori.desc: An application of Chidori through a Complete Body — Susanoo, whereby Sasuke produces a massive Chidori with its primary left hand.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_crush.desc: Sasuke grabs his opponent with one of Susanoo's fists and crushes them within it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_dance_of_the_s: Using their Susanoo, the user swipes it blade to unleash a large wave of chakra to slice the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_dance_of_two_s: The user's Susanoo swipes its blades, slashing with numerous waves of chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_destruction.de: Indra in his Susanoo creates a wave by slamming down both swords.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_fist.desc: The user manifests a partially transformed Susanoo arm, which when used, can destroy a wall or repel a large individual.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_great_fireball: Using Complete Body — Susanoo as a medium, the user can fire a multitude of fireballs from the construct's mouth. The fireballs vary in size, capable of becoming as large as a Tailed Beast. As the technique doesn't explode on impact, the fireballs can be repelled with enough force.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_kamui_lightnin: Kakashi throws Kamui-imbued shuriken at his opponent, transporting them to Kamui's dimension, before going there himself. As his opponent falls through the dimension, Kakashi manifests his Complete Body — Susanoo, channels a Kamui Lightning Cutter through its hand, and runs his opponent with it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_lightning_batt: Using Susanoo, Indra brings down five bolts of lightning surrounding the opponent, where streams of electricity surge towards the center, causing a large electric blast.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_lightning_flam: With Susanoo, Indra swipes his avatar's sword, unleashing a fiery twister and leaving the field electrified.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_rotating_flame: Shisui ignites his Susanoo's drilled spear with fire and drills into the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_sever.desc: Madara begins by elbowing his opponent, and follows with a series of six Susanoo Sword slashes and stabs, before manifesting his incomplete Susanoo to deliver a final, downward slash.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_slash.desc: Sasuke has his Susanoo punch his opponent, followed by a Susanoo sword swipe, a Fire Release attack, and two further sword swipes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_smash.desc: Sasuke swats his opponent aside and punches them with a Susanoo arm.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_tear.desc: Madara has his Susanoo swipe the opponent with a sword, throwing them into the air, then manifests its incomplete form to deliver a cross slash with two Susanoo swords as they fall, knocking them further back.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_tsukumo.desc: After Shisui manifests his Susanoo's upper-body, it opens its ribcage to expose its chest before launching a barrage of large, green-coloured chakra needles at an incredible speed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_twin_flames.de: In the skeletal states of their Susanoo, Itachi and Sasuke slash downwards with the Sword of Totsuka and Sword of Kagutsuchi, creating a fiery explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.susanoo_twin_gods_ligh: Sasuke and Itachi activate their Complete Body — Susanoo. Itachi launches his Yasaka Magatama at the opponent while Sasuke slashes at them with his Blaze Release: Susanoo Kagutsuchi, with the resulting flames creating lightning clouds.
lang.ability.narutorpg.swarming_art.desc: Deidara creates many clay spiders which crawl all over the opponent and detonate on them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.swift_release_shadowle: Hiruko uses this technique to move at instantaneous speeds, rapidly striking his opponents at various angles while avoiding any opposition regardless of the opponent's speed or strength. This technique is very effective against strength-based close-combat taijutsu users.
lang.ability.narutorpg.swift_wind_wall.desc: The user summons a swirling stream of wind, encasing the user and repelling incoming attacks. It can also be expanded to protect others near the user.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_combo.desc: With this technique, Yūgao makes a sequence of slashes with her sword and finishes with a powerful slash that greatly injures the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_kagutsuchi.de: By applying shape transformation to the orb of black flames wielded by his Susanoo, Sasuke manifests a blade in its hand for the purpose of slicing and piercing targets, thus setting them ablaze with the inextinguishable flames of Amaterasu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_kagutsuchi_se: Sasuke manifests the arm of his Susanoo, holding an Amaterasu sword, and delivers a single downward slash at his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_kagutsuchi_st: While inside his Susanoo, Sasuke swipes his Amaterasu sword horizontally, proceeds with a downward stab at the ground that causes flame spikes to erupt, throwing his opponent up in the air, where he stabs them, and sends a final pulse of black flames through the sword.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_kagutsuchi_vi: Sasuke attacks his opponent with a string of sword slashes, Chidori, and a black flame sword, the last swing of which sends a volley of black flame spikes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_kusanagi_blad: After restraining the target with a snake, Orochimaru summons several replicas of his Sword of Kusanagi which attacks the enemy from every direction.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_kusanagi_chid: This technique allows Sasuke to channel the Chidori through his chokutō. This makes it nearly unblockable as the radiating and chirping blade can easily cut through steel.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_kusanagi_hawk: Sasuke attacks his opponent with a series of sword slashes and a roundhouse kick, before hitting them with a forward lunging, horizontal slash.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_kusanagi_long: This technique allows Orochimaru to control the Sword of Kusanagi. As he moves his fingers, the Sword of Kusanagi makes the same movements, even to the point of moving in the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_kusanagi_one_: Orochimaru summons a giant snake, which slams the ground with its tail, throwing the target into the air. Then, Orochimaru commands the Sword of Kusanagi to stab the target.
Hagoromo shapes his shakujō into the Sword of Nunoboko, coated in dark, flaming chakra, and slashes the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_totsuka_seria: Itachi uses the Sword of Totsuka for two horizontal slashes, followed by a stab, and finishes it with a fireball.
lang.ability.narutorpg.sword_of_totsuka_slash: Itachi uses the Sword of Totsuka to deliver a diagonal slash, followed by three horizontal slashes, the last of which throws his opponent up in the air, where Itachi hits him with a fireball, sending them further back.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tail_chasing_fang_fang: After the user transforms into a single, three-headed, gigantic wolf with their shadow clone and ninken, the user curls into a ball and rolls at a ferocious speed towards the enemy, as if chasing after their own tail. The ultra-violent rotation created can tear through multiple enemies, rending them apart with ease.
Sasori, while inside his puppet Hiruko, extends the puppet's iron tail to circle around his opponent like a cocoon and then suddenly constricts it, crushing them.
This fūinjutsu employs the use of formulae to bind a jinchūriki before extracting the tailed beast from within them. When extracted, the beast initially takes the form of pure chakra, also causing the host to go into a near Version 1-like state. After being extracted, the beast takes a corporeal form.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tail_sweep.desc: Releasing six tails, Kinkaku extends one of them and attacks opponents like a whip.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_ball.desc: The Tailed Beast Ball is the ultimate technique of a tailed beast, which can also be used by a jinchūriki while transformed, considered the strongest technique they can use.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_ball_rase: With help from Kurama, Naruto converts his Truth-Seeking Ball into a Tailed Beast Ball, and adds wind-natured chakra to create the shuriken-like blades around it before hurling it at the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_chakra_ar: This is an ability a jinchūriki is able to perform when in a tailed form. The jinchūriki will use the raw chakra of their Tailed Beast to form arms, which they can freely manipulate to attack their foes, able to strike an opponent faster than even a Sharingan user can react to.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_combo.des: Naruto, in his Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, and Minato combine their Rasengans and strike the opponent with it. Minato then throws his Flying Thunder God Kunai at the opponent. The two ninja then bump fists, with Minato entering his Nine-Tails Chakra Mode.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_eight_twi: After assuming his full Eight-Tails transformation, Killer B tightly coils the beast's tails around himself, before extending them with an enormous amount of physical strength. This causes him to spin rapidly, resulting in the generation of tremendous gusts of wind that buffets everything in the surrounding area.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_flash_bul: Naruto, while in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, delivers a fast combo of punches and kicks to the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_full_char: All the Tailed Beasts gather together, after which they all head in to attack the opponent in the following order: Shukaku blasts the opponent with a powerful sandstorm (in the game, Shukaku simply punches them), Matatabi slashes them with its claws, Isobu bulldozes them towards Son Gokū, who kicks them, allowing Kokuō
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_heavy_can: The tailed beast or their jinchūriki forms a Tailed Beast Ball which they ignite in the tailed beast's mouth to shoot a massive beam of chakra.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_lariat.de: The is a taijutsu technique, available to the Eight-Tails jinchūriki. After manifesting their Version 2 form, without bones, or while in their Tailed Beast Mode, the user charges at the opponent, striking them with a Lariat.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_planetary: Naruto starts with a wind punch, sending the opponent into the air. He then transforms into his Kurama Mode and prepares a giant-sized Rasenshuriken and a Tailed Beast Ball. He throws the Rasenshuriken, then fires four satellite Tailed Beast Balls, circling around the shuriken.
The Tailed Beast Rasengan is an incomplete technique of Naruto Uzumaki. It attempts to use the Rasengan's form to create a substitute for the Tailed Beast Ball.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_removal_t: After setting up an area, the user can attempt to extract a tailed beast from its jinchūriki. The jinchūriki is bound to a rock table surrounded by a large circular sealing formula with several ceremonial rocks surrounding it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_replicati: Gensui creates a special sealing tag which, if placed on human beings, transforms them into false replications of one of the tailed beasts. Not only does the seal shape the victim into the desired tailed beast, but it also grants them the original's abilities.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_sealing.d: Whenever Naruto Uzumaki entered into a tailed form, the First Hokage's Necklace activated this technique to restrain him.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_seventeen: Killer B and Naruto, in their Tailed Beast Modes, twist their tails to form two twisters with the opponent caught in between them, and finish by shooting Tailed Beast Balls at them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_spirallin: In Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, Minato forms two Rasengan from his hands and two Tailed Beast Balls from his chakra arms, attacking the enemies in front of him and the enemies further out.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_tail.desc: Yugito claws her opponent and then slaps them with one of Matatabi's tails.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_telepathy: An innate skill possessed by all the tailed beasts, which allows them to communicate with one another on a deeper plain of their subconscious minds known as the .
lang.ability.narutorpg.tailed_beast_transfer_: This technique allows one person to transfer the complete chakra of a sealed tailed beast within a jinchūriki into a different person.
lang.ability.narutorpg.taisa_s_transformation: Taisa activates this technique by forming the needed hand seal. Once activated, Taisa transforms into an armoured beetle similar to a kabutomushi. He then gains six legs which are mostly bandaged up, five horns, and orange and violet markings all over his back body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.takamimusubinokami.des: After absorbing his enemies' ninjutsu with the Rinnegan in his right hand, Momoshiki can release those same techniques from the Rinnegan in his left hand, using the chakra he obtains from his pills to amplify their power as many times as he wishes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.takemikazuchi.desc: Sasuke pierces his opponent with Amaterasu flames while simultaneously capturing them inside a Chibaku Tensei which is enveloped by the black flames. Sasuke then jumps high in the air and activates his Complete Body Susanoo and proceeds to fly towards the Chibaku Tensei.
lang.ability.narutorpg.takigakure_style_water: A secret technique of Takigakure that allows the user to manipulate water into the form of a sword. While usually used for close quarters, this technique can, as demonstrated by Shibuki, be used for ranged assaults as well.
lang.ability.narutorpg.takigakure_whirlwind.d: While in midair, the user will come down with a whirlwind-like force flowing around them, punching the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tatami_return.desc: Mifune slashes at his opponent a couple times, jumps up, and upon landing, the impact makes the ground in front of him rise up, with a slab of rock sending his opponent up in the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.team_work_is_outstandi: Naruto, Sakura, and Sasuke kick the opponent in a combined attack. Naruto and Sasuke then rush ahead, delivering a series of hits to the target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tearing_air_heavenly_l: In Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, Minato scatters Flying Thunder God Kunai around the opponent, slashing them each time he warps.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tearing_blade.desc: Orochimaru jumps up high and then comes falling down onto the opponent, stabbing them and then slashing them with his Sword of Kusanagi in the process.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tearing_fang.desc: Akamaru attacks the opponent by jumping and kicking them, finishing them with a weaker Passing Fang.
lang.ability.narutorpg.telegram_flash.desc: With his team lending him chakra, Akaboshi can slam his hand onto the ground and cause lightning to spread from his hand to underneath the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.teleportation_seal.des: The user creates a seal that can teleport anything within its confines to a predetermined location, dispersing into balls of light. Hamura used this technique to travel to the moon he and Hagoromo created.
lang.ability.narutorpg.telescope_technique.de: By peering into a crystal ball, the user can see the current activities of anyone whose chakra signature they know. Users can view subjects from any location, regardless of distance or potential obstructions, making it ideal for intelligence gathering.
lang.ability.narutorpg.temple_of_nirvana_tech: Everybody within an area is subjected to the same illusion: many white feathers fluttering down from the sky. If a given target sees enough of these feathers fall, they will fall into a deep sleep.
lang.ability.narutorpg.temporal_rewind.desc: In preparation of being struck, the user activates their Rinnegan as glowing blue. This technique allows them to warp several seconds into the past. While normally defensive, essentially allowing the user to seemingly teleport away from danger, repeated usage of this technique grants a pseudo-form of clairvoyance.
lang.ability.narutorpg.temporary_paralysis_te: Using this technique causes a target or targets to be physically immobilised, as though they've been tied down with invisible steel ropes. Because it's a relatively simple technique, even genin should be able to perform it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.ten_finger_drilling_bu: Kimimaro parts his fingertips, creating holes that expose hardened finger bones. In volleys (five per hand), he shoots these bone bullets at a target by swinging his hand, causing a loud sound as they're fired. The bullets travel incredibly quickly through the air and take a spinning motion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tengai_shinsei.desc: The user weaves three hand seals simultaneously between themselves and their Susanoo, in order to draw massive meteorites from the upper atmosphere down towards a specific location on the ground.
A smaller scale version of the larger variant, Madara calls forth a shower of small meteors.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tenhojimetsu.desc: Indra, Madara and Sasuke enter their completed Susanoo states. Sasuke traps the opponent in a giant meteorite, but Madara tries one-upping him by summoning a larger meteorite above Sasuke's technique to crash into it, declaring that he alone is sufficient for the job.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tenketsu_blocking_stri: A taijutsu technique that allows the user to disable an opponent by performing a two-fingered thrust at the opponent's tenketsu. By doing so, the user can manipulate the flow of chakra within their opponent, similar the the Gentle Fist fighting style.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tenpenchii.desc: By interfering with the natural energy using its immeasurable amount of chakra, the Ten-Tails is able to simultaneously create a variety of natural disasters that devastate the surrounding area, with itself acting as their epicentre.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tenro_style_ninjutsu_b: The user transforms themselves into a wolf-like creature that enhances their strength and speed. The transformation wears off if the user is defeated. This technique is known only by the members of the Tenrō clan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tenseigan.desc: The is a dōjutsu introduced in The Last: Naruto the Movie. The movie's novelisation explains that the Tenseigan can be acquired when an Ōtsutsuki is implanted with the Byakugan of a Hyūga: this combination of the two clans' chakra transforms the Byakugan into Tenseigan.
The Tenseigan Chakra Mode is a heightened transformation unique to those who possess the Tenseigan.
lang.ability.narutorpg.the_great_sakura.desc: Sakura traps her opponent in a genjutsu in which the giant form of Inner Sakura raises up from beneath the opponent. Inner Sakura takes the opponent into the air and crushes the opponent with both her hands, and the genjutsu promptly ends with the opponent on the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.the_immortals_rushing_: Taking advantage of Hidan's immortality, Kakuzu uses the Fire Release: Intelligent Hard Work and Wind Release: Pressure Damage techniques to engulf Hidan in flames, propelling him towards the opponent, while Hidan slashes them continuously with his Triple-Bladed Scythe.
lang.ability.narutorpg.the_inheritance_of_the: Hashirama, Tobirama and Hiruzen use a combination of wood, water and fire to push away the opponent. Hashirama uses Wood Release Secret Technique: Nativity of a World of Trees to create a forest in which Tobirama and Hiruzen strike the opponent using a fire and water combination.
lang.ability.narutorpg.the_red_hot_habanero.d: Kushina, while in her awakening state, delivers a series of powerful punches to the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thick_steam_flow_techn: This is a cooperation ninjutsu where one Fire Release user attacks the enemy from one side and a Water Release user attacks them from the other. The collision of these two naturally opposing natures create a devastating attack as well as a great deal of water vapour.
lang.ability.narutorpg.third_eye.desc: Gaara creates an eye out of sand that hovers in the air wherever it's created. Gaara connects the eye with his optic nerve using chakra, allowing him to see whatever is in the Third Eye's field of vision.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thistle.desc: Kimimaro slices upward with a sword made of bone and then extends his bones from his back to throw the opponent into the air violently.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thorn.desc: Kimimaro delivers a series of slashes to the opponent with two bone swords until he sends them flying into the air, where he delivers a series of slashes at lightning speed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thorn_explosion.desc: The user punches the opponent and follows up with impaling them with their modified flesh.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thousand_bee_stings_te: The user summons bees that shoot their poisonous stingers at their target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thousand_flashes_behea: The user slashes at the opponent with very sharp senbon exactly a thousand times in multiple different directions, leaving the opponent with plenty of slashes and senbon pierced into their body.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thousand_flying_water_: The user creates a thousand long needles from the nearby water, which surround the target. The user carefully aims the needles at the target and fires them at rapid speeds. Targets who are struck by the needles suffer significant injury.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thousand_hands_manipul: The Thousand Hands Manipulation Force is a technique which is used through the puppet of the Third Kazekage.
Sasori attacks his opponent using his Third Kazekage puppet, causing multiple arms to erupt from seals in its left arm, reaching for a mid-air opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thousand_needles_of_de: Kin Tsuchi controls a vast amount of needles at once using strings, and attacks the enemy. When shown in the game, this technique resembles a white version of Haku's Thousand Flying Water Needles of Death.
lang.ability.narutorpg.threaded_tree.desc: Hashirama creates two rising wood pillars that intertwine with each other from the ground and lift the opponent into the air. He then creates two more pillars of intertwining wood, striking the opponent further into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.three_colouring.desc: Kurenai Yūhi releases a pillar of cherry petals at the opponent sending them flying.
lang.ability.narutorpg.three_demon_gods.desc: Momoshiki grabs his opponent, throws them up in the air, and consumes a chakra edible, changing his appearance. Transformed, he sends five dog avatars which converge at his opponent, biting at them, before a fire pheasant crashes through them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.three_jewels_suction_c: This technique is a performance by puppets 6, 7, and 8 of the Chikamatsu Collection. The three puppets get into a triangular formation and by opening the mechanisms marked with "Buddha", "Dharma", and "Sangha", respectively, they invoke this technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.three_seal_barrier.des: Similar to the Five-Seal Barrier technique, instead the user places three sealing tags around their location. If any one manages to enter through a secret entrance of the protected hideout, a deep mist is created and the only way to get rid of it is remove the tags around the protected area.
While in his three-tailed form, Naruto creates a shadow clone that charges a Nine-Tails-enhanced Rasengan that implodes in on the enemy who is attacked by it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.three_tails_chakra_rel: Due to his mysterious connection to the Three-Tails, Yūkimaru is able to at least partially control the Three-Tails. At first, Yūkimaru can only make an apparition of the beast appear, after taking some of Kabuto's pills.
lang.ability.narutorpg.three_tails_mini_clone: When the Three-Tails devours anything, its body produces thousands of smaller clones of itself with its gut. These antibody-like clones attack and devour the invading organism, presumably to aid in digestion and destroy any potential hazards.
lang.ability.narutorpg.three_tails_rampage.de: Isobu takes over Rin Nohara, causing her to manifest a chakra cloak, and slam the opponent with a chakra tail. Isobu fully manifests itself, slams the opponent underwater, and sends a Tailed Beast Ball their way.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thrusting_shark.desc: While merged with Samehada, Kisame forms a water shark around him and charges at the opponent, with the shark biting down on them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thunder_laser_scan.des: While in flight mode, Mecha-Naruto scans the area with a special blue laser, identifying its target.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thunder_of_the_dead.de: Orochimaru summons snakes, with Sasuke using Chidori Current on them, that spiral around them both hitting anyone nearby.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thunder_sabre.desc: Thunder Sabre is a technique utilised by Ranke by drawing energy from the Stone of Gelel.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thunderclap_drill.desc: Sarada delivers a Lightning Release-enhanced, super strong punch on her opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.thunderswords_techniqu: This technique allows the user to manipulate Kiba independently from afar. This allows the user to keep their hands free for combat and also attack from multiple angles at once. The user can also manipulate the blades to strike in a variety of manners.
Holding the Kiba swords over their head like birch rods, the user summons a bolt of lightning from the sky to shock anyone in their immediate vicinity.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tiger_lily.desc: Kimimaro, when in his cursed seal level two form, attacks the opponent repeatedly with alternate strikes from his hands and tail and then finishes them off with a powerful strike from his backbones.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tight_binding_golden_c: These chains formed by a member of the Uzumaki clan are used offensively rather than the ones used for sealing purposes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.time_release_technique: By placing a mark on a person in a ritualistic method, this technique will activate as timed even if the person is tortured or put under a trance. This is meant to catch an enemy when their guard is down.
lang.ability.narutorpg.time_reservoir.desc: A member of the Ōtsutsuki clan can manipulate the mental space of an individual to send their conscience to a certain point back in time. The user creates a doorway which will enable an indictable to travel to the past.
lang.ability.narutorpg.time_reversal_techniqu: This technique is used by the Anbu to pull out forgotten memories. After forming the appropriate hand seals, the Anbu will put the target into a state of reverse hypnosis, allowing them to remember details that they otherwise would not.
lang.ability.narutorpg.toad_flatness_shadow_m: The user first infuses a target's shadow with their own chakra. The user then flattens themselves to paper-like thinness and merges with the target's shadow, giving them complete control over the target's mind and body. The user must hold their breath in order to maintain this control.
lang.ability.narutorpg.toad_oil_bullet.desc: The user converts their chakra into an extremely sticky oil and spits it out as a huge mass or as a barrage of small bullets. Those caught by it will find it difficult to move, and simply washing the oil away with regular water won't be easy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.toad_smoke_technique.d: The user produces a burst of a smoke from their body, forming a thick smokescreen to mask their movements. It can also produce a denser smoke within shaped like the user for an additional distraction.
Koji links with his artificial toad to access their point of view, seeing and hearing everything around the toad. This can be done via special software or through Koji directly, in which the latter case his pupils will become toad-like. It allows for more discreet surveillance and intel gathering.
lang.ability.narutorpg.toad_sword_beheading.d: A toad, using its naturally strong hips and legs, leaps precisely at a target. Toads can cover a great distance by doing this, shifting from a remote location to close range suddenly in order to catch targets off guard.
lang.ability.narutorpg.toad_three_slashes.des: The user coats their weapon with chakra and swings it at the target, releasing three sharp crescent-like waves.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tongue_tooth_sticky_ac: Katsuyu releases an acidic paste from the mouth that, because of Katsuyu's size and height, is spread over a wide area. The acid's concentration and density is great enough to melt stone.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tonton_combo.desc: Shizune transforms Tonton into a copy of herself who uses chakra scalpels to stun their opponent. Tonton changes back and jumps up as Shizune slices though the opponent, side-to-side with two chakra scalpels herself. However, she caught the tip of Tonton's tail while the pig was doing a flip; the opponent collapses.
lang.ability.narutorpg.top_transformed_buddha: After creating a gigantic wooden statue that possesses hundreds or thousands of hands, the user utilises all of these hands simultaneously to deliver powerful blows to the target. Due to the sheer volume of the punches involved, defending against the entirety of them is nearly impossible.
lang.ability.narutorpg.torii_seal.desc: When Naruto first obtained Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, his previous seal's outward appearance had changed into a shape of a magatama, along with a swirl design that resembled Uzushiogakure's symbol.
lang.ability.narutorpg.torn_castle.desc: Zabuza kicks his opponent, delivers some side slashes with Kubikiribōchō, kicks them once more, and finishes with a forward stab, knocking his opponent far back.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tornado_high.desc: Boruto and a shadow clone string a series of attacks at an opponent, finishing by creating a small tornado that lifts the shadow clone as it performs an upper kick.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tornado_of_water.desc: This is a technique that utilises water to create a spinning water vortex around the user. The water vortex acts both as a barrier and an attack mechanism. The power of the vortex is enough to knock an opponent unconscious.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tornado_of_water_techn: Gengetsu forms and sends out a vortex of water, then shooting a bullet of water to massively increase the size of the vortex, swirling around the area.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tornado_rasengan.desc: The Tornado Rasengan is a Rasengan formed from the released chakra of Kurama. The Rasengan formed is red similar to the Demon Fox Rasengan from Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel, but with several streams of red chakra spiralling around the sphere.
lang.ability.narutorpg.torpedo_nails.desc: The user throws nails into the air. Upon impact on the ground, they dig themselves into the earth. When the opponent walks over the ground where the nails dug themselves in, nails pin their feet stopping their movement. Then, the user forms a hand seal and hundreds of nails shoot out of the ground at the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.torrent_hydrification_: Suigetsu transforms into a wave of water which crashes into the opponent. He then rushes behind the opponent with the lower half of his body still being waves and slashes them in half with the Kubikiribōchō.
lang.ability.narutorpg.torsion_flower.desc: Kimimaro (when in his cursed seal level two form) attacks the enemy repeatedly with alternate strikes from his hands and tail and then finishes off with a powerful strike from his bone drill, knocking the enemy backwards.
lang.ability.narutorpg.towards_the_setting_su: Lee opens several chakra gates and dives into the opponent. He carries them through several mountains before focusing his remaining chakra to brutally drive them through a valley wall.
lang.ability.narutorpg.tracking_technique.des: Upon activation, the user's pupils glow yellow. This allows them to see the lingering energy traces left from a person's footsteps.
lang.ability.narutorpg.transcription_seal_ama: This is a technique that seals the technique Amaterasu within the Sharingan of another person. After being sealed within the person, it is involuntarily activated (indicated by the person's Sharingan taking the form of the sealer's Mangekyō Sharingan) when the eye sees its target, which is predetermined by the user.
lang.ability.narutorpg.transcription_seal_iza: This is a Mangekyō Sharingan technique that seals the technique Izanagi within the Sharingan of the target. After being sealed within the person, it is involuntarily activated when certain requirements, which are predetermined by the user, are met.
lang.ability.narutorpg.transformation_adamant: The user transforms into a staff for their summoner to use as a weapon; Enma's staff form was the preferred weapon of Hiruzen Sarutobi, whose heavy use of it through decades of warfare contributed to his reputation as a "God of Shinobi". The staff is as hard as diamond, making it very destructive.
lang.ability.narutorpg.transformation_techniq: The Transformation Technique allows the user to take the appearance of whatever they choose.
lang.ability.narutorpg.transmission_wood.desc: After turning a wood clone into a seed, the seed can be used to track a target by either planting it on them or having them ingest it. Only the user of this technique can detect the seed's transmissions.
lang.ability.narutorpg.transparent_escape_tec: This technique has never actually been seen in the manga, but it allows the user to spy on others without being noticed. It was invented by Jiraiya during his youth to allow him to spy on girls bathing without the risk of being caught.
lang.ability.narutorpg.trinity.desc: Obito uses Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Technique and Minato throws Flying Thunder God Kunai at the opponent. Kakashi then forms a Chidori and Obito activates his Sharingan and Minato teleports them to the opponent using Flying Thunder God Technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.triple_strike_breaking: Asuma delivers three powerful blows to the enemy with his chakra blades, after which he releases a cloud of ash that explodes and burns the enemy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_chibaku_tensei.de: The user claps both hands together, forming a black sphere between them, and launches it. The black sphere will then expand and encase a large area. Upon which, it draws in a large quantity of the earth around, effectively creating a "moon" that hovers high in the sky with the consumed area inside.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_eight_trigrams_si: Neji leaps forward and strikes the opponent several times in the back before dashing in front of them. He strikes several more times until using an Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven-like strike to launch the opponent into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_fire_of_samadhi.d: This Fire Release technique appears to be initiated remotely upon placing the target in contact with a physical object such as a kunai or even a small toad, and can cause the target to spontaneously burst into flames.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_rasengan.desc: An enhanced version of the Rasengan, where the user draws more power that lasts for a longer period of time. The Rasengan increases in size to a bigger larger version. When used, the user slowly moves around the area dealing damage to any target in his path. In addition, it absorbs chakra from the user.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_reverse_lotus.des: After unlocking the sixth of the Eight Gates, Lee pummels his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_sand_waterfall_fu: Gaara encases himself in a huge amount of sand, thus creating a giant clone of himself out of sand that will do everything that the engulfed Gaara does. The giant Gaara holds the opponent down and implodes, crushing them. The implosion is so great that it sends a shock wave through the battlefield.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_several_thousand_: Using a massive wooden statue, Asura generates several Amenomihashira on its many hands and unleashes them upon his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_shadow_seizing_te: Sending his shadow towards his opponent, it will then crawl up the opponent's body until a shadow-hand reaches the opponent's neck, and breaks it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_sickle_weasel_tec: Temari summons Kamatari, who then creates a stronger and larger version of her Sickle Weasel Technique. The wind vortex can reach opponents farther away from her than her original technique.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_supreme_ultimate_: Naruto hits the opponent with a Rasengan, with Minato and Kushina adding their chakra to Naruto's palm to enhance the strength of his Rasengan which pushes the opponent far away, resulting in an explosion.
lang.ability.narutorpg.true_tailed_beast_rase: Naruto punches his opponent with a tailed beast chakra arm, sending them up in the air and putting some distance between them. He fully manifests Kurama, and creates nine shadow clones, each creating a different Rasenshuriken.
lang.ability.narutorpg.trump_card_of_pair.des: Naruto creates several shadow clones to charge towards and beat the opponent before kicking the opponent into the air. Naruto and Sasuke each form a Rasengan and Chidori that they both use on the falling opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_ball.des: Truth-Seeking Balls are orbs of malleable black chakra, which can alter their form and characteristics in various ways. Though only the size of a fist, each hides within it the power to obliterate an entire forest.
lang.ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_ball_cyc: The user encases themselves in a Truth-Seeking Ball shell to protect them from any incoming attack. They can also control the shell to ram enemies around them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_body_fli: Obito forms one or two blades from his Truth-Seeking Balls attached to his hands and instantly passes through the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_chaos_bu: Hagoromo uses his Truth-Seeking Balls to shoot bright blue bullets of chakra at the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_kick.des: Naruto combines his Truth-Seeking Balls and kicks the single large ball towards the opponent with great force.
lang.ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_pure_sha: Obito encases himself in a Truth-Seeking Ball shelling, which he uses to hit the opponent numerous times.
lang.ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_ruined_e: Madara sends out three Truth-Seeking Balls in front of him to shoot beams of chakra at the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_saving_l: Obito fires a Truth-Seeking Ball at the opponent, which lights up and expands, releasing a large explosion. Once released, the ball returns to him.
lang.ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_scorched: Obito merges his Truth-Seeking Balls into a single sphere in front of himself, and unleashes a beam at his opponent.
