Asuma quickly jumps into the air himself, delivers two slashes in the opponent's face and one final slash to send the opponent back into the ground.
The user hits the opponent with a series of punches and slashes, finishing with a rising uppercut that lifts the opponent into the air.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wolf_river.desc: After transforming into a two headed wolf, Kiba and Akamaru leap forward and bite the opponent with both heads sending them flying.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_clone_kick.desc: Yamato makes a pillar of wood come out of the ground and hit the opponent, knocking them backwards. A clone then flips over the pillar and slams his leg into the opponent when they are on the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_clone_technique.d: A clone that is created by using chakra to alter the user's own cells into vegetation. The clones can be as simple in function as a wooden dummy for use in the Body Replacement Technique or completely mobile and able to perform jutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_pillar_climb.desc: Yamato makes a pillar of wood come out of the ground and hit the opponent, knocking them backwards.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_pillar_sky_kick.d: Yamato attacks his opponent with a series of punches and kicks before turning their left arm into a pillar of wood that is extended into the ground and lifting him into the air towards the opponent, and kicking them backwards.
Yamato makes a pillar of wood come out of the ground, takes hold of the pillar and then begins spinning around with his leg hanging out to kick the opponent multiple times.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_adamantin: Hashirama uses this technique to make some thick tendrils of wood surround him. This can be used to defend against close range attacks or to strike an opponent when they are near.
Hashirama enhances the physical strength of Wood Release: Wood Human Technique, which jumps and smashes the opponent with its fist, dealing great damage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_advent_of: Taking advantage of the innate properties of Wood Release which allows the user to force trees to grow on any surface at a rapid pace, the user creates a dense forest of flowering trees.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_all_creat: Hashirama causes multiple wood tendrils to rise up from the ground, weaving into a wooden wall around the opponent's limbs binding them in place. He then concentrates his chakra into his fist and then strikes the opponent, breaking them free of the woven wooden wall.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_beams.des: Yamato causes several wood beams to erupt from the ground and reach high into the sky. They spread out and turn back down, crashing down at the opponent. They end up looking like a willow.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_circular_: Yamato creates wooden pillars in a circular formation to trap and crush the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_complete_: Yamato traps his opponent in a wooden dome, and sends several wood beams crashing at it, destroying the dome and hitting his opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_cutting_t: A versatile technique where the user can produce sharp wooden spikes from their body to either fashion short-range weapons akin to a makeshift sword, or use them as projectiles, where the branches' growth can be triggered remotely, skewering the enemy as a result which will usually see the target dying.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_cypress_n: Yamato impales the opponent with Wood Release: Great Forest Technique and hammers the wood with a giant wooden mallet that crushes the opponent to bits.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_firmament: Hashirama slams the ground with his fist, releasing large trees from which rise from underground and capture the opponent, allowing him to finish them off by punching them down through the trees, and into the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_foo_dog_h: A technique designed to be used to absorb a tailed beast's chakra. The user produces the kanji on their palm and creates a series of wooden pillars, which are engraved with what resemble foo dog faces and have lit wicks on top of them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_four_pill: By sending chakra into the ground, the roots of the plants are converted into raw materials. This technique allows for a building to be constructed, by forcing accelerated growth. Just like with the Four-Pillar Prison Technique, the size and shape of the building are taken from the user's imagination or memories.

The user converts chakra into timber under the ground and lets it grow rapidly while forming it into a wooden prison. The size of the prison is based on the user's imagination. From an insect cage to a great prison, one can make it into whatever they want by regulating the amount of chakra used.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_great_for: The user makes trees grow rapidly under the opponent, stabbing them and throwing them quite distantly.

A technique that changes one's own arm into big trees. Using chakra, the tissues are transformed into trees at the cellular level. Then, by activating the trees, stimulating them to grow rapidly, they lengthen at high speed and fork into many branches.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_great_spe: Obito brings up several thick roots from the ground, and uses them to crush his opponents.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_great_tre: Hashirama attacks the opponent with thick tree branches growing out towards the opponent.
Hashirama summons tree branches to lift himself up in the air towards the opponent and punches the ground beneath them, causing trees to grow underneath and strike them away.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_great_woo: Yamato creates a wood clone with a giant wooden hammer as a hand, which jumps at the opponent and clobbers them with it.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_hand_tool: Using Wood Release, Yamato manipulates his hand to form into a tool, such as a key or a shield.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_hobi_tech: Quickly creating a dome-like structure in the form of a dragon's face, the user is completely surrounded. Taking advantage of the nature of Wood Release, this fūinjutsu substantially weakens incoming attacks whilst protecting the user inside.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_hotei_tec: The user creates a number of gigantic wooden hands that erupt upward from beneath the ground, which then encircle and attempt to restrain a chosen enemy. The size of each of these hands is around the size of a tailed beast.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_kakashi.d: Yamato traps the opponent in a wooden vice, after which he uses carpentry tools to carve a giant head of Kakashi Hatake out of the resulting vice.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_nativity_: After forming the necessary seals, Yamato is able to turn an area into a vast forest in a matter of mere moments complete with trees and grass growing out of any terrain he is on. This technique is very similar to Hashirama's signature technique, albeit on a somewhat smaller scale.
Yamato strikes the opponent with Wood Release: Great Forest Technique and makes the wood that struck the opponent form into a tree.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_pillar_cr: Yamato traps the opponent in a wooden prison and turns his wood clone into a giant pillar that ultimately crushes the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_revolt_of: Obito skewers his opponent with wood tendrils, punches and kicks them upwards, followed by a knee to the face. He then phases through them on the way down, and brings up several roots to impale them.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_ruptured_: Hashirama launches an attack across the surface of the ground, causing roots to sprout underground, destroying the battlefield.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_secret_te: Hashirama Senju creates a dense growth of trees, controlling how it grows using his chakra. The trees' life force is immense enough to split the earth as they sprout and further pierce through any other obstructions they encounter.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_serial_pi: A larger scaled version of the Wood Release: Four-Pillar House Technique where instead of creating a single house, Yamato creates multiple houses at once. Because of the sheer volume of structures created with this technique, it appears to exhaust him rather quickly.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_smotherin: By transforming their arm into a tree, the user can then create multiple branches which will rapidly grow around the target, immobilising them. This technique is strong enough to restrain a giant squid.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_stocks.de: Yamato creates wooden stocks to restrain a target. These stocks also have the added effect of suppressing the target's chakra, rendering most captives unable to retaliate.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_thousand_: Using the giant statue as a medium, Tobi smashes the opponent with a giant wooden hand, and while the enemy is trapped under its giant hand he impales them with wooden spikes.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_transform: Yamato performs the necessary hand seals, then wood emerges and covers his entire body with a puff of smoke or chakra, covering up the transformation. Once the technique is done, the transformation is complete. It acts more like a costume than a transformation, as he is able to leave it behind if necessary.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_tree_bind: This technique lets the user summon a tree around their opponent to bind them. This technique is relatively powerful and holds opponents much more gracefully, with less of a strain on the user, because the user sinks them into the ground. Afterwards, the user can enclose the opponent so that their body is crushed.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_tree_of_f: Yamato kicks the opponent into the air before summoning a bridge of wood that carries the opponent away. Yamato then jumps behind them and uses a beam of wood to run them through the wood bridge and force them to the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wild_pick: Yamato places his hands on the ground to bring forth three cylinder shaped branches to attack the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wood_drag: The user creates a gigantic wooden dragon, which they can use for a multitude of purposes including restraining a target, or for offensive purposes. The dragon that the user creates can vary in terms of appearance.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wood_fett: Yamato creates a spiralling pillar of wood rise up from the ground beneath the intended target causing them damage whist throwing them several feet.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wood_huma: After forming the required hand seals, the user creates an enormous statue-like creature out of wood. This humanoid creature with a full body and an oni-like face is usually created with a wooden dragon wrapped around its torso, and is generally used in battle as an avatar.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wood_lock: An extremely versatile move, this technique uses chakra to activate the roots in the ground and, using the user of the technique as a reference point, makes wooden pillars appear from left and right. The wooden pillars join together in a dome-shape with the user at the centre.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wood_spik: The user creates a semi-circle of wood around a captured target, and then form spikes within the ring, pointing at the target, preventing them from making any sudden movements.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wooden_ma: Yamato creates several pieces of wood from the ground that shoot out and pierce the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wooden_sp: After a taijutsu combo, Hashirama summons a large tree branch to send the opponent flying in the air, jumps at them and punches them down.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_release_world_of_: The user creates countless wooden branches that grow at high speed from the ground. The branches interlace to form a wide, net-like wall with an impressive defensive power.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wood_stab_palm.desc: Yamato strikes the opponent with a series of punches and kicks leading to him jumping into the air and releasing a wooden spear from his palm that is directed into the opponent and used to drive them into the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wooden_men_possession_: This technique forces two opponents to fight each other through wooden training dummies, with the intent of tricking them into fighting each other until all but one of them is defeated.
lang.ability.narutorpg.wooden_puppet_manipula: By placing a charm onto the puppet beforehand, this technique allows the user to control its movements through will alone. Alternatively, the puppets can attack the opponent on their own, though the ability to react to their opponent's movements is limited. If the tag is removed, then the technique can then be disabled
lang.ability.narutorpg.wrapping_flame_cat_fir: Transforming into Matatabi, Yugito runs towards the opponent in a fiery tackle.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yachihoko.desc: Yachihoko is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yachihoko_dazzling_fla: Using Yachihoko to boost her abilities, Hikari dashes around slicing the opponent with her kunai, kicks them up in the air, spews a a fireball and Amaterasu, causing it to burst into towering pillars of blazing fire and black flames.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yachihoko_no_kami.desc: Kaguya opens numerous small portals to shoot hazards from her dimensions at the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yakusaikazuchinokami.d: Momoshiki first calls forth several lightning bolts to strike the ground before him, then releases a powerful tidal wave of water over the area, forming a large, electrified whirlpool.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yasaka_magatama.desc: Yasaka Magatama is a technique that Susanoo users can use from any of its hands. Due to its structure, it acts in a similar manner to that of a shuriken when thrown by Susanoo — rapidly spinning towards the intended target — and results in an explosion upon impact.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yasaka_magatama_tailed: This Cooperation Ninjutsu is a collaboration technique using the user's strongest long ranged techniques including Naruto's Wind Release: Rasenshuriken, Itachi's Yasaka Magatama, and Killer B's Tailed Beast Ball.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yellow_flash_jutsu.des: Minato blasts the opponent into the air with a Rasengan and then proceeds to throw one of his Flying Thunder God Kunai behind them. As he teleports behind them, he strikes them in the back with another Rasengan that expands to a larger size before exploding and sending the opponent back to the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yellow_flash_naruto.de: Channelling Kurama's chakra, Naruto performs an enhanced Body Flicker Technique to instantly cross vast distances.
Minato kicks the opponent in the air, throws his Flying Thunder God Kunai, teleports to them, and kicks them again, ending the combo with a Rasengan while on the ground as the opponent falls down on the attack.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yin_healing_wound_dest: Kabuto analyses an opponent's facial expression, movements, and the properties of their jutsu to anticipate where and how he will be attacked. He then gathers chakra to the area of his body where the attack will strike, preemptively starting medical treatment in order to minimise the damage he'll receive.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yin_seal_release.desc: The Strength of a Hundred Seal - which takes the form of a diamond on the user's forehead - is used to gradually build up and store the user's chakra over time. Yin Seal: Release opens that seal, giving the user access to the accumulated chakra.
Obito uses Truth-Seeking Balls to block an opponent's attacks, shaping the Truth-Seeking Balls into a different defensive shield each time.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yomito_s_transformatio: Yomito activates this technique by placing the mask he keeps strapped to his right arm on his face. Once activated Yomito transforms into an oni-like creature. His body greatly grows in size and becomes very muscular, his skin becomes grey and his hair becomes crimson. The only clothes that remain are his pants.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yomotsu_hirasaka.desc: Yomotsu Hirasaka is a kekkei mōra technique used by members of the Ōtsutsuki clan, which is said to be the progenitor of all space–time ninjutsu.
lang.ability.narutorpg.yosaku_cut.desc: Using his giant axe, Sabu strikes the opponent with a low, lateral blow.
lang.ability.narutorpg.you_won_t_get_away.des: Kushina jumps and delivers a series of strikes with her frying pan, chasing the opponent. Then, she hits her opponent with a pan, knocking them into the ground.
lang.ability.narutorpg.young_lightning.desc: Kakashi whilst in the air will drop down on his opponent with a lightning-charged hand strike.
lang.ability.narutorpg.young_spirited_embrace: Guy punches the opponent aside, only to apologise and embrace them, fracturing the opponent's back and doing liberal damage.
lang.ability.narutorpg.youth_full_power.desc: The user begins with kicking the opponent into the air. Once airborne, the user will then kick the opponent in the face before finishing with a powerful drop kick that will send the opponent back down to the ground, emitting a light of "youthful" energy.
lang.ability.narutorpg.youth_leaf_lotus_attac: Lee activates the Eight Gates, delivers a barrage of punches and kicks, and delivers one final kick on the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.youth_roar.desc: Guy lets out a loud shout, made to intimidate opponents and invigorate teammates.
lang.ability.narutorpg.zelkova.desc: Kimimaro knocks the opponent into the air and then appears above them before extending a large number of spikes from his arm to stab the opponent.
lang.ability.narutorpg.zero_tails_sealing_tec: This technique is a unique form of sealing which was passed down in the Land of the Sky and used to restrain the Zero-Tails.
lang.ability.narutorpg.zeus.desc: The technique consists of striking the opponent into the air with a Lightning Release-infused uppercut palm attack.
